paras: Shah Husamuddin, light of the stars, is desirous of the starting of the fifth volume. O Zaiulhaq Husamuddin, you are the master of the masters of the knowledge of esoteric matters of heart. If the people had not been hidden from facts and hard to understand, and if the throats had not been narrow and weak, I would have fulfilled my duty of finishing your praise, and would not have opened my mouth for anything else than this. But the food of the falcon is not for a sparrow. Inspite of this, I have to present water as oil to the people. Praising you before the prisoners of worldly greed is showing cruelty to you. Yet I speak out, not for them, but for those belonging to the group of spiritualists who may understand. Explaining about your virtues before the worldly people amounts to misappropriation. I speak of the clear apparent aspects and hold the secrets of love hidden from them.

However, praising you and making the people know of you is like tearing the curtains of ignorance, as the sun is not in need of introduction and explanation. One who praises the sun actually praises himself to make the people know that both his eyes are healthy and bright as they are seeing it. So also condemning the sun amounts to self-condemnation establishing that both the eyes are blind, lightless and vicious. People certainly call such a fellow as blind. Leave that to the people. However, you may pardon him who is jealous of the grand sun in the world. Nobody can hide the sun not only from the eyes but also from its impacts of freshness caused to plants and fruits.

sections.heading: The Jealous Harm Themselves
paras: Those jealous of the sun can neither reduce its light nor stand up against it to cause reduction in its grade. Anyone jealous of the affairs of the world gets nothing; but pulling oneself into total death. So also, the one who is jealous of you as you are a world in yourself. Your state is far above the comprehension of mind; and any wisdom trying to elucidate your points can only blabber nonsense. Though wisdom is incapable of explaining, yet it should resort to explain in a humble manner. It should be known that what cannot be got in full cannot be discarded in full. Efforts must be made to get it to as much an extent as can be available. Though a thirsty man cannot drink all the water poured by the rain yet drinking cannot be given up. So also, the entire water of the river cannot be dragged, but as much as needed to quench thirst must be dragged and tasted.

sections.heading: A Little Knowledge Also Helps
paras: You may not be able to understand Husamuddin in full, yet you may take a little rind of his fruit and refresh yourself. Due to your lack of understanding him in full, what you get may be just of the worth of the rind, but for the understanding of others, it is pulp. The sky is below the empyrean (‘arsh) in comparison, but it is very high from the earth’s point of view. I praise you with the object of guidance for the people well before they feel regret for losing it in full. You are the light of God and a puller towards God’s light while people are immersed in darkness of doubts and suspicions, and your light can provide confidence to them.

You are a master, and discipline and respect for the master is a precondition for a disciple to learn from the master. With this only these blind disciples can get the eye-black to brighten their eyes. It is only one putting hard efforts, who can get the light. Therefore, put efforts as you are not like a rat which is a lover of darkness. Put efforts and get the light if you are not a rat. Do not waste your life in darkness. Those with weak sight like the rats are the roamers during night. They cannot circumambulate around the Ka’aba of faith. Such of those who have no capacity to understand the intricate matters of religion find these to be very difficult and hard against their nature as religion has become dark for them. So long as they do not arrange the warp and weft of their capacities, they cannot open their eyes to look at the sun of Husamuddin. They cannot grow branches of their trees and simply grow on a single stem like the date palm. They go on burrowing holes under holes in the mud like the rats.

chapters.title: Tearing of Four Birds
chapters.subtitle: Exegesis of: Take four birds; tame them to turn to you; put a portion of them on every hill, and call to them. They will come to you, flying with speed. Then know that God is exalted in power, wise: Fakhuz arba’atan min altairi fasarhunna ilaika: (Baqara: 2: 260)

paras: There are four qualities of man which squeeze his heart. These four are the “four nails” for the wisdom. (Char Maikh: four nails, that were struck upon to which the hands and feet of a criminal used to be lied as punishment). These four nails immobilize him and hold him tightly. This was a punishment prevailing in those days. The instruction: “Take four birds….” was a command given to H. Ibrahim.

[This came about for the reason that H. Ibrahim asked God to show him how He gives life to the dead. He was asked: ‘Do you not believe?’ He replied: ‘I believe, but I want to satisfy my understanding. He did what he was told and he placed single birds on the hills and called out, and they came back — Translator]

[The four birds to be slaughtered are: duck, peacock, crow and rooster. By these four birds are meant four vicious qualities of man, which come in the way of man’s understanding of realities. If man gives up these qualities, he becomes man in reality. By duck is meant greed for food; by peacock is meant the desire for pomp, pageantry and ostentation; by crow is meant common desires; and by rooster is meant carnal sexual passions — Qazi Sajjad Hussain].

O Husamuddin, the bright sun of consciousness? You are the Ibrahim of the present days. You may also kill these four birds which are looting our higher qualities. Each one of these birds is upon the instinct of the crow, which is capable of attacking and snatching away the eyes of the wise. It first attacks the eyes of the dead bodies. These qualities will first make the wise blind. All these qualities of the body are like the birds referred to H. Ibrahim. Slaughtering them provides the path of progress to the soul.

sections.heading: Four Birds with Vicious Traits
paras: O Husamuddin in the form of H. Ibrahim! You may cut off the heads of these birds to release the feet from shackles so that there may be relief to all good and bad people. You are all in all, and all others are your part. Remove the chains of their feet, as their feet are your own feet. Because of you, the world has become one of spiritual values and spirits. The strength and valour of one cavalry man gives strength and support to a hundred armies. Because this body of man is a place of four qualities and their name is “four birds in search of mischiefs”. If people went to get everlasting life, the heads of these four vicious birds must be cut off. And, after killing them, you may give them also a different kind of life and protect them from their mischievous conduct which have made the hearts of the people as the territory of their country. When you become the leader of the hearts of the people, you will be the vicegerent of God in these days.

Cut off the heads of these four birds and make the mortal humans immortal. Duck, peacock, crow and the cock are the four examples of the birds occupying the souls of the people. Duck is greed for food and the cock is for sexual passions, peacock is desire for pomp and pageantry and the crow is desire for long life. The crow creates desire for long life and permanence. The greedy duck has its beak in the dry and wet soil searching for the hidden things in it. Its throat does not remain at rest even for a moment. It does not hear any command of God other than the command ‘eat’ (kuluu). It is engaged in filling its belly like the dacoit who digs up the house fast and fills up his bag with all possible good and bad things, whether grains of food or pearls, with the fear that if he delays and goes slow, another dacoit may come and fill up his bag with dry and wet things. He fears that there is very little time and opportunity and without any hesitation fills up his bags without thinking of anything else. He has no trust upon his Provider and fears that some other dacoit may come and commit the loot.

sections.heading: Faithful Are Slow and Cowered
paras: This attitude is against the faithful who believes in another life, collects things slowly and little by little. He remains without anxiety about another competitor’s coming as he is aware of the wrath of his King upon his enemies. He is also contented with his friends and colleagues that they will not interfere in his pursuits and snatch his gains. He looks into the justice of his King and remains confident that no one will go and cause cruelty to anyone else. Inevitably, he does not hurry and remains satisfied that the share allotted to him will not be snatched by anyone.

Thus, he resorts to patience, slow pursuit and continuous work. He is contented, and clean-hearted in giving preference to others. This is for the reason that slowness is a shadow of the benevolence of God, and hurrying is a Satan’s act. This is for the reason that Satan is afraid of poverty and deprivation and cuts off the feet of those carrying the burden of patience.

sections.heading: Fear of Poverty: Satan’s Weapon
paras: Hear this from the Quran that Satan uses the weapon of poverty to frighten you as has been said: Satan threatens you with poverty: Al shaitanu ya‘idukum al faqra: (Baqara: 2: 268). He frightens you of severe poverty, so that you may eat bad things and make bad earnings in hurry and give up manners, patience and righteousness. Inevitably the infidel eats food of seven stomachs. He has strong stomach but very weak faith, and heart.

chapters.title: Gluttonous Eating
chapters.subtitle: Reasoning behind the Prophet’s saying: Infidel eats for seven intestines and the faithful for one intestine

paras: Some pagans came as guests of the Prophet in the masjid one evening, and said: “O king, we have come here as guests as you are the host of all from one horizon to the other. We do not have anything and come from a long distance. Please sprinkle the light of benevolences upon our heads.” That generous king turned his face toward his friends as he was the helper of all kings and slaves and said: “ O my friend! Please take each one of them to your house, as you all have the same concern and conduct as I have.”

sections.heading: Soldiers Have King’s Soul
paras: Bodies of all soldiers of a king contain the body of the king within them. That is why they swing their swords upon the enemies of the grandeur of the king. You set your sword in motion upon the enemies because of your king’s anger for them as you do not have enmity for them, because they are also soldiers like you and professional brothers. You do not have any reason for anger with them. Without there being any hate for them, you hit them with a ten maund heavy mace. The king is a single soul, but his army is full of many souls. Soul is like water and body is like the stream. If the water of the king’s soul is sweet, all the streams (soldiers) will be full of sweet water, because subjects follow the faith and rules of the king. This is what the noble Prophet has said.

Each of the Prophet’s companions selected a guest as his guest. Among them there was a gluttonous, mischievous fellow, with a very bulky body, and nobody took him along. And he remained in the masjid like the thick residue at the bottom of the cup. The Prophet took him along. There were seven milky goats in the flock, which were left at home for being milked at the time of eating. Bread and soup, and milk of the seven goats were eaten away by that starving famished fellow who was like the gluttonous Auj bin Unaq of the Turkish Tribe of Ghuz, who were dacoits and gluttonous eaters. The other members of the family were upset as they were expecting to drink the milk of the goats. That gluttonous fellow swelled his belly like a drum and alone ate away the food meant for eighteen people. After eating, he went into the room and sat there. The maid who was angry with him, shut and latched the door from outside in extreme anger and pain.

sections.heading: Bad Effects of Overeating
paras: That infidel from midnight to the morning felt disturbance in the stomach and needed to go to nature’s call. He got up from the bed and went toward the door, but found it shut. He tried very much to open it in various ways, but it did not open. His urge to attend to nature’s call went on increasing and the house appeared to be very narrow to him. He was worried, anxious and helpless. At last, he went into sleep and found himself in a ruin in the dream. As his inside also was like a ruin, he found such a place in his dream also. Finding himself in a ruin and under intense pressure of the bowels, he defecated instantly in the bed.

He woke up and found his clothes full of filth and out of mental tension, he found himself as though mad. There were hundreds of sighs from him as he was in such a shameful situation which could not be hidden under the mud. He said to himself: “My dream is worse than wakefulness. My goodness is worse than my viciousness.” He started shouting: “What a deadly situation” as the infidels would shout on the doomsday (Furqan: 25: 14). He anxiously waited as to when the morning would come so that the sound of the door’s opening might give some relief, so that he could fly away like the arrow from the bow, so that nobody might see him in his condition. The matter is quite lengthy, but I shorten it. The door opened and he got rid of his pain and sorrow.

chapters.title: Opening of the Door
chapters.subtitle: Opening of the door by the noble Prophet himself and hiding himself so that the guest might not see the opening and feel ashamed and run away outside without any hesitation

paras: The Prophet came in the morning and opened the door and provided the way for that misguided person to find his way. He opened the door and hid himself so that, that man in trouble might not feel shy. So that he might come out without seeing the face and back of the one who opened the door. Or, he stood behind the wall, or God himself hid him from others. Many a times, God’s color hides things or puts a nonphysical curtain upon the onlooker. So that he may not see his enemy right by his side. God’s might in such matters is above all other’s might.

The Prophet was observing the affairs of the guest, but God had prevented him from offering any help; so that he might be provided with escape at dawn, to avoid his falling into a well of disgrace. There was a reason behind all this and a decision of the heaven that he should see himself in that condition. There are inimical acts which, in fact are friendly; and there are many destructions which result in constructions. When the infidel found the door open, he stealthily ran out in silence.
Prophet washed filth

A simpleton brought a cotton sheet full of filth knowing well about its cause, before the Prophet and said: “Please see what your guest has done.” The mercy of the worlds (Prophet) smiled and said: “Bring a pot of water to me so that I may wash it with my hands.” Every one present there jumped and said: “ For God’s sake! May our lives and bodies be ransomed for you! You may leave this dirt for being cleaned by us. This is the job of ordinary hands and not of the great hearts like yours. God has sworn upon your life and addressed you as life itself, saying: verily, by your life (O Prophet), in their wild intoxication they wander in distraction to and fro: La ‘amruka innahum lafii sakratihim ya ‘mahuuna: (Al Hijr: 15: 72). He has made you His vicegerent and seated you upon the throne. We are living to render service to you; and instead of this, if you start rendering service, what is there for us to do?”

He said: “I know this, but this is a time, in which washing by me alone is the most reasonable.” They waited as it was the Prophet’s statement, to know as to what the secret behind it was! The Prophet continued to wash not to show but with a special command from God. His heart was telling that he alone should wash as there were layers upon layers of reasonings upon it.

chapters.title: Prophet Washed the Guest’s Filth
chapters.subtitle: Reason for the return of the guest to the Prophet’s house at the time when he was washing the bedsheet with his prosperous hands. His feelings were highly ashamed at what happened, he started crying and tearing his clothes and became a Muslim

paras: That lowly infidel had a memorable idol with him, which he found to have lost, and became very perturbed. He said to himself: ‘ I have left that idol in my ignorance in the room in which I had slept last night’. Though he felt ashamed to return, but the greed to get back that idol put an end to it. Greed is not an ordinary thing but a large-sized python.

sections.heading: In Order to Get the Idol Back He Came to See It in the Prophet’s House. He Saw That the Prophet’s Hands, Like the Hands of God Were Engaged in Cleaning His Filth. May God Protect His Hands from Evil Eyes. Looking at This, the Thought of the Idol Went Out of His Mind, and There Was a Loud Noise in His Inside Which Made Him Tear Off His Shirt. He Started Beating His Face and Head with Both Hands and Dashing His Head on the Wall. This Made Blood Flow from His Nose and Head, and the Prophet Felt Pity for Him
paras: He started crying and shouting and people gathered around him, and he said: “O people! Be afraid of opposing him.” He beat his head calling it as foolish and beat his chest saying: “ O repository of the entire world! I am only a part of you and I am worthless and ashamed. You are obedient to God in entirety and fallen before Him in all humility under His command; and being only a part, I am cruel, rebellious and misguided. You consider yourself to be totally humble before God and shiver before Him, and being a mean part, I am opposing and going away from Him.” Every moment he looked at the sky and said: “My face is not worthy of looking at the Prophet’s face which is a center of attraction for the whole world.” When his shivering and pain went out of limits, the Prophet took him in his arms, pacified and graced him. He opened his eyes and gave him the sight to identify things.

sections.heading: Benefits of Crying
paras: So long as the clouds do not cry and fall as tears, gardens do not smile. So long as the child does not cry, milk does not collect in the breasts. Even a one day’s child is aware of this method that he should cry so that the noble wet nurse may come to him. Yet, inspite of being a grown up one, you do not know that God, the wet nurse of all the wet nurses, will not provide milk, on His own, unless you cry. He has said: “Let them weep much”. Keep this in mind as stated in the Quran: Let them laugh a little and weep much: Falyadh hakuu qaliilan wa walyabkuu kath(s)iran: (Tauba: 9: 82). So that the mercy of God may flow milk.

sections.heading: Clouds Cry for the World
paras: Weeping of the cloud and burning of the sun are the two pillars which are the cause of the freshness of the world. Had there been no burning of the sun and the tears of the rain, our bodies would not have developed and grown bigger. The four seasons and their products would not have come about, if the cries and burnings had not been the foundation of life. Weeping of the clouds of this world and the burning caused by the sun provide comforts and pleasures of life.

Keep the sun of wisdom on fire and make the eyes shed tears like water from the clouds. You need the crying eyes like those of a child. Eat that bread which should not cause disgrace to your honour. Because of the bread, the tree of your body is evergreen, but the twig of your soul is always in autumn and fall. Body’s freshness is the cause of the soul’s autumn and fall; and therefore, reduce the body and thereby develop the soul. Give a loan to God from out of the body’s wealth and reduce its size, so that the garden of the soul may grow well. That is what, God said: lend unto Allah a beautiful loan: Wa aqridhullaaha qardhan hasanan: (Muzzammil: 73: 20).

sections.heading: Give a Loan to God
paras: Give a loan of your body to God by eating less, so that what is not seeable by the eyes may make itself visible to your soul. When the body is cleansed of the filth of faeces it gives you relief. If it is cleansed of filth of vices, you will fill it with the pearls of dominance, and fragrance of musk. You will get rid of all uncleanliness and get perfect cleanliness and your body will eat its fruits, as has been said: Allah’s wish is to remove uncleanliness far from you, O folk of the household, and cleanse you with a thorough cleansing: Innamaa yuriidulaahu liyuzhiba ‘ankumur rijsa ahllahbait wa yutahhirukum tathiiran: (Ahzaab: 33: 33). This was a specific advice to the Prophet’s family. Devil will frighten you and incite you not to give up bodily pleasures saying: “this will make you sorrowful and displeased. If you give up these pleasures and weaken your body, you will ultimately feel ashamed and sorrowful.”

sections.heading: Through Food Satan’s Misguidance
paras: He will point out to you of the tastes and benefits of many things and ask you to eat them. They will act both as food and medicine. They will prevent sicknesses and provide profits to you. He will convince you that the body is a vehicle for the soul. It should not be weakened, rather strengthened. If you try to reduce the intake of food to benefit the soul, he will warn you to be careful and not to change your regular habits saying that it will cause you losses. This will create hundreds of sicknesses for the brain and heart. In this manner, that mean devil will warn and frighten, and cast hundreds of spells upon the people. He will present himself as the great physician, Galen, before you so that your sickly self is cheated to fall in his trap, saying that these foods are good to keep your sorrows and pains away. This is how he had cheated H. Adam by talking about the benefit of wheat. He will say so much with such persuasion that his words will act as the rope tied around the mouth of the horse which is tied while putting shoes on its hooves. You will be totally silenced like the horse. All this, he does to show ordinary stones as rubies to you.

sections.heading: Food Increases Greed and Treachery
paras: He catches hold of your ears like the ears of the horse and drags you toward greed and wrong earnings. He puts the horseshoes of suspicions on your legs. With the pain caused by this, you will stop proceeding on the way. The horseshoe of suspicion is by two ways, by making you think whether to do this or do that. Be careful to do what the Prophet said and not what a child or a lunatic does. The Prophet has said: “The paradise is wrapped up with unpalatable things.” Therefore, do not be reluctant with unpalatable things.

The devil has a hundred designs and magic spells with which he puts a python in a basket. He stops the flow of water and laughs at the great scholars of the times. He smashes and scatters a mountain like scraps of grass and demonstrates his might upon it. In order to protect yourself, you must couple your wisdom with a wiseman’s wisdom, and act on the way of those “whose affairs are a matter of counsel”: wa amruhum shuura baimahim: (Shura: 42: 38).

chapters.title: Consolation to the Guest
chapters.subtitle: The Prophet’s grace and grants upon the arab guest and consoling him for his cries and anxieties which he had, due to shame, disgrace and the fire of despair upon him

paras: That was a lengthy affair with no end. That Arab was in a state of shock at the graces shown by the Prophet. He was about to go mad; his wisdom having gone off. But the wisdom H. Mustafa pulled him back. He told him to come near him; and he came just as a person who moves about after getting up from deep sleep. He said: “Do not be mad! Be careful! Come to our senses as you have got to do many great jobs.” So, saying, he sprinkled water on his face. And the Guest said: “O witness of God! Present to me your evidence, so that I may recite the article of faith and come out of the mess. I am fed up with life and I want to enter into the forest of truth.”

sections.heading: Presentation of Evidence
paras: We are standing at the door of the judge of fate, due to our answering to God: “Yes we do!” when He had asked us on the day of Alast whether He was not our Lord. [The day of Alast. Its meaning is already explained earlier]. As we have said: “Yes, we do testify that You are our Lord, we have to present our acts and words to establish our case. Why should we stand in silence at the door of the judge? Have we not come here to give our evidence? How long are we to stand at His door? You have been called here to present your evidence and do not hesitate and avoid. You are sticking to your quarrelsomeness with your lips shut and folded hands. O witness! Unless you give your evidence, you cannot go from here. It is a job of a short time; do it and go back. Do not lengthen a small job. Whether it is a short time or a century, pass on the trust and get released.”

chapters.title: Evidences of Inner Light
chapters.subtitle: To Explain that salat, fasting, hajj and all other apparent acts are evidences of the inner light

paras: Salat, fasting, hajj and jihad are all evidences of faith. Zakat, charity and avoidance of jealousy are also evidences of the inner qualities. Feeding and hospitality are meant to show our sincerity. Giving presents, gifts and offerings are evidences of the fact that we are pleased with the recipients. What is one’s spending money, or praying for the good of others? This is to show regards that he has in mind. This is to show that one is so generous and disciplined, that zakat is given and fasting resorted to. Fasting says that when even permissible food is denied, there is no scope for impermissible food at all. Zakat says that when one gives to others out of one’s own possessions, one cannot steal things belonging to other faithfuls.

sections.heading: Showing Good Acts
paras: If both these good acts are done only for the purpose of ostentation, they will cross-examine him before the court of God suggesting that the hunter spread grains not as a token of generosity and mercy but for the purpose of hunting. Cat appears to be fasting and pretending to be asleep only to catch its prey. Such pretending people have brought disgrace to hundreds of communities and to the genuinely generous and fasting people. Yet, inspite of their ostentation, God’s grace, cleanse them of this defect. His mercy is far ahead of his wrath, and He grants them such light which is brighter than the full moon. God washes and cleans their good acts of the mingling’s of vicious feelings. His mercy bathes them to clean their mad feelings, so that His forgievance coupled with His generosity may come about. All their sins are compensated with graces.

chapters.title: Cleansing of Dirt by Water
chapters.subtitle: Cleansing of the dirt by water, and God’s cleansing of dirty water later, establishing the fact that God is absolute in cleanliness

paras: God fells water from the clouds to rid the unclean of their dirt. When water becomes useless due to pollution and foulness, man’s senses run away from it. Then, God pulls it back into the ocean for purification process, cleans it in full with His grace. In the next year, the same water returns in all cleanliness, having been in the ocean as though with the noble ones. It says: “I had gone to them with filth but returned fully cleansed. I have put on the royal apparel from there and returned in pomp to the earth again.”

sections.heading: Water Has Godly Qualities
paras: It warns and tells: O unclean fellows, come to me, as I have adopted the conduct of God. I shall cleanse you. I shall take all your vicious qualities. I am capable of giving the character of angels to devils. Upon washing them, when I become dirty again, I return to earlier place of the real cleanliness. I remove my dirty clothes in that clean place. There, God grants me another clean apparel. That is His job, and this is mine! I clean and become dirty, and He cleans me of dirt. He is the caretaker and beautifier of the world. Had there been no dirt in us, there would have been no great quality of cleaning of water. It steals the wealth of water from other places and goes in search of the poor to give over to them and falls as rain on the well grown grass and washes the faces of all the unwashed ones. It carries the burden of others like a coolie on its head in the form of the limbless ships, in the oceans. Lakhs of medicines are there in it, as because of water only they develop in the plants of the world. This water is the medicine of all pains and the soul of every grain. It enters into the root, seeds and leaves and makes them pharmacies. Orphans of the earth are taken care of by it and it provides strength to walk to the persons immobilized with thirst.

chapters.title: Water Cleans and Gets Cleansed
chapters.subtitle: Seeking of support by polluted water and God’s granting of support

paras: When water loses its worth by getting polluted, it becomes worried and roams about on earth like us. From its inside, it laments and says to God: ‘O God! What you had given to me was given over by me to others. And now I have become a destitute. I have flowed my wealth on all the clean and unclean: and O king of wealth, grant me still more.” Upon this, God tells the cloud to take water to a good place, and to the sun, to go forward to drag it above. He takes it towards various ways and ultimately it is taken to the boundaryless Ocean.

sections.heading: Saints Cause Cleanliness Like Water
paras: This is an example of the water of the saintly friends of God who wash you of your dark deeds. After washing the dirty people, when their soul gets polluted; it goes toward the empyrean that grants cleanliness again. From there, it returns with its lapel full of huge, thick, clean, drops of water like pearls. All the people who were in temporary cleanliness with mud (tayammum), become fully clean to attend to their prayers. They had been reluctant to mingle with others due to their sense of uncleanliness. Upon the influence of the saints, they go in search of mental peace as the Prophet used to get through H. Bilal upon his calling of Azn. To get that relief, the Prophet used to tell H. Bilal: “Provide relief to me, O Bilal, stand beat the sweet drum of marching with your pleasing tone.”

When one stands up for prayer, one’s soul proceeds on journey toward God and when the prayer ends, it comes back and says ‘Salaam’: may peace be upon you. This is like an illustration and illustrations are required for the understanding of common folk to understand matters. How can anybody enter into fire other than the samandar, which is not in need of any protection. [Samandar, as per the prevailing common folk belief was a large rat-shaped animal which is born in and lives in fire, and dies upon its coming out of fire, and also an oceanic animal with feathers which do not burn in fire]. For ordinary men a bath is a place of warmth and pleasure which is kept hot with fire. When you cannot enter into fire like H. Ibrahim Khalilullah, you should make him as a protector for entering into fire with water. Quenching of hunger is done by God, and bread is a means for it and without bread, this object is not achieved. So also, pleasure is given by God, and a garden is a means for it. These are the requirements of the body. If one can achieve these objects without means, one becomes great like H. Musa, to keep a bright moon in his pocket.

chapters.title: Words and Acts Speak of Inside
chapters.subtitle: Evidence of the apparent words and acts to prove inner consciousness and light

sections.heading: Acts and Words Exhibit Man’s Inside
paras: The property of water of cleaning dirt and itself getting cleansed gives an evidence that its inside is full of the light of God. In similar manner, acts and words are the witnesses of heart. And with these two, you may infer the inside of men. If your inside cannot travel into and observe the inside of others, you may learn to assess their, inside by observing their urine just as the physicians do. For them, urine is an indicator of the patient’s disease. The words and behavior of the patients also appear like urine to them to diagnose sickness. But the physicians of the hearts (saints) penetrate into the souls and through them into their faith. They do not need to observe their words and acts. They are the spies of the heart and be careful about them. On the contrary, you have to understand the saintly through their acts and words to know whether they are streams connected with the large ocean (God). Acts and words of those connected with God are evidence of the connections of the streams with the ocean. Carefully observe their acts and words in order to know of their inner, hidden qualities, as to how much and of what kind is their inner light. Whether their words and acts are like the grains spread out to catch birds or real acts of generosity. Be away from one, if found to be a bird-catcher and do not ever be taken over by his words, acts and spells. Do not ignore him, if you find him to be sincere, so that through his stream, he may take you into the ocean.

chapters.title: Inner Light of Saints
chapters.subtitle: To explain that the light of God exposes itself from within the gnostic without his words and acts. It is far above the need of the gnostic’s acts and words. It is like the Sun which upon rising, does not need the crowing of the rooster and the muazzin’s proclamation

sections.heading: Substantial Light
paras: Let it be known that the light of the knower of God, which has gone beyond limit, fills the deserts and forests with itself. It does not need any witness to prove itself in bold and formal ways. When his light comes out of him, it is like a substance, on its own, and not his accident. It is free from the arguments in favour of substance and accidents. [Substance is something in existence of its own, like paper which exists whether something is written or drawn on it or not. But what is drawn or written on it is accident, which cannot come about without paper]. The knower of God becomes light as a substance and does not need the accidents of words and actions to keep itself.

sections.heading: Difference Between Substance and Accident
paras: Therefore, do not go in search of his acts and words to know him, because both the material and spiritual worlds are fully bloomed flowers because of him. You should know that the purpose of evidence is to demonstrate what is hidden: whether it is by words or by actions. The gnostic is visible, on his own, without the aid of words and actions. The job of accidents is to prove the existence of substance. Even if accident vanishes, the substance continues to exist. The mark of gold upon the touchstone, speaks of gold’s worth, but vanishes thereafter, but gold remains with its glare without doubt. These salat’s, fasting’s and Jihads do not continue to remain, but their impacts on the soul remain, because the soul exhibits these acts and words and puts scratches on the touchstone of substance declaring that faith has been perfect, and these acts come out of it.

sections.heading: Defects of False Words
paras: But witnesses are not always true and certain. They have to be examined in the court for their truthfulness to be fully informed of their sincerity. In the case of evidence by words, there has got to be carefulness about the words, and in the case of evidence by acts, the promise that is made at the time of alast (oral declaration before God) must be tested. The oral witness using wrong words and actions going in crooked manner requires to be rejected. Both words and actions ought to be without contradictions in order to be accepted by the world. Your efforts are different and full of contradictions as has been said in the Quran: Verily (the ends) you strive for are different. Inna sa ‘yakum lashattaa: (Lail: 92: 4). You stitch during the day and tear off during night. Nobody will believe contradicting evidence. But the Benevolent God may accept.

Words, and acts express the secrets of the heart. Both expose the hidden secret. If your evidence is clean, it will be accepted; as otherwise, if it is not fluent; it comes under suspicion. If you go on arguing on the basis of suspectful evidence, they fall into the command of God, given to the noble Prophet: Turn away from them, and wait: they too are waiting Fa-a ‘ridh anhum wantizhir, innahum muntizhiruun: (Sajda: 32: 30).

chapters.title: Offer of Article of Faith
chapters.subtitle: Offering of the evidence of the article of faith by the Prophet to his guest

paras: Let us skip this discussion and proceed: the Prophet offered the article of faith to his guest, and he accepted it. That is the article of evidence, full of prosperity, which opens up the knots that are tied around things. He became a faithful and the Prophet told him to be his guest on that day also. He said: ‘By God! I shall be your guest forever, wherever I may go and wherever I may settle. I am a slave of your door after having been given a new lease of life and freed from slavery of others. Both in this and the other world. I am always at your dining sheet. Whoever chooses a dining sheet other than this, will at last, get his throat torne by a bone. Whoever goes to a dining sheet other than yours, may be considered to eat and drink with devil as a co-diner. Whoever goes away from your neighborhood, will certainly go into the neighborhood of devil. If someone goes on a long journey without you, he will have devil as his co-traveler and co-diner. If he sits upon a good horse without you, the jealous devil will sit behind him.”

sections.heading: Satan’s Participation
paras: If his wife bears a child, devil will participate in his upkeep. God has said in the Quran that Satan way join with him in his wealth and his children from the start itself of acquiring them. He will share with their wealth and children and make promise to them: wa shaarik-hum fil amwaali wal aulaadi wa ‘id-hum: (Asra: 17: 64).
The Prophet, under inspiration from the hidden world has spoken of certain strange states to H ‘Ali.

sections.heading: The Neo-Convert, His Guest Continued to Say: “O Prophet of God! You Have Shown All the Messages of God in Full Clarity, as Clearly as the Sun on Cloudless Day. What All You Have Done Has Not Been Done by Two Hundred Mothers. H ‘Isa Had with His Prayer Given Life to One, ‘Aazar, Who Had Died Forty Years Back. After Coming to Life for Some Days, He Again Died. the Life Given to ‘Aazar by H ‘Isa Was Temporary. but You Have Given Me a Permanent Life. My Life Has Now Been Saved by You from Death. but ‘Aazar Got Life and yet Again Died.”
paras: The Arab became a guest of the Prophet for that night also. He drank half milk of a goat and shut his mouth. The Prophet told him to have some more milk and bread. He said: “My belly is full now. I swear upon God: I am telling the truth. I do not need any more food. I am not showing any formality or hesitation. Nor I feel ashamed or show any design to stop eating. I feel that my belly is fuller now than it was yesterday.”

sections.heading: Food of Faith
paras: All the household people were surprised that this large lamp is full with one drop of oil. Food sufficient enough of a small bird like ababil has filled up the stomach of an elephant. All men and women were whispering: “This man with the bulk of an elephant is eating food as little as a mosquito eats.”

Greed and suspicions of the days of infidelity fell flat. A python’s hunger was satisfied with an ant’s food. That beggarliness and thanklessness went away from him. Delicious food of faith strengthened and fattened him. That sickness of hunger that always kept him craving for eating was cured. He ate the fruit of heaven like H. Maryam who had stopped eating material food during pregnancy. Fruits of paradise came running toward him and his hell like stomach was fully contented. The truth of faith is a great grant and delicious food. This cannot be understood by those who have only oral faith and not spiritual faith.

chapters.title: Food of Soul
chapters.subtitle: That light which is the food of soul becomes food for the bodies of the aulia and also becomes a friend of the soul; as the Prophet has said: my Satan has become a Muslim at my hand

paras: Though the truth of faith is the food of the soul, it is a good food of the body also. If Satan of the body were not to feed upon this spiritual food, the Prophet would not have said that the “Satan of my body became a Muslim at his hand”. His spiritual attainments impacted upon his body also. Had not devil of the body eaten the spiritual food that gives life to the dead, he would not have become a Muslim. Satan of the body is a blind and deaf lover of the material world. The backbone of one love can be broken by another love. Love of one thing can be replaced only by love of some other thing. When a person tastes the wine of God’s love from the stock of God’s provision house, love of God slowly penetrates into him.

sections.heading: Food of Body and Soul
paras: O greedy of the food for belly! Change of the body can be brought about by food alone. O sick of heart! Turn toward the treatment to regain the equilibrium of your humours (four bodily fluids: blood, phlegm, choler or yellow bile and melancholy or black bile). O pledger and prisoner of food, turn toward the food of soul in order to get permanent relief from hunger. There is plenty of food in hunger. Search for it and hope for it and do not run away from it. Get the food of light and become like the bright eye, become better than humans and develop consonance with angels.

Like the angels make total obedience to God taking obedience itself as your food so that you may also get delivered of all earthly problems like angels. Though Jibra’iil does not at all eat, yet he is much stronger than the vulture. Though the elephant is so large, and as such slow in its movement, but it cannot protect itself from the mosquito. The food of light is also kept in the world along with the food for the body, but it is hidden from the eyes of mean fellows.

chapters.title: Food for the Body
chapters.subtitle: Refusal of the food of soul by the gluttonous eaters for the body and their devotion for bodily food

paras: Even if the entire world becomes a grand garden of all types of food, the share of the rats and snakes is nothing but mud. Their share is only mud both in spring and autumn. Know this: you are the lord of the world. Why do you like muddy things like the snakes? Wood worm tells the wood: “Who else has the fortune of tasting such a nice, sweet dish.” A small worm in the mud says: ‘None in the world can have such delicious food.’ The dung worm feels fully satisfied with the filth of the dung and knows nothing of any other food. The crow recognizes nothing other than rotten flesh and that alone is the light and lamp of its eyes.

O God, the Uncomparable! Grant to us other things also. When you have granted ears to us, grant also the capacity to know your secrets and wisdom. Catch hold of our ears and drag us into the gathering of those who are enjoying the pleasure of drinking pure, soft wine of your gnosis.

Upon providing the fine fragrance of musk to us, O lord of the faith, do not shut the mouth of the musk container. All males and females are having their drinks only from You, as granter; You have no limits in supplies. You are the acceptor even of the unsolicited prayers and opener of the doors of hundreds of expansive fields every moment. You have written down for us some letters out of many by falling in whose love many hard stony hearts have become soft like wax.

sections.heading: Pre-Creation World of Ideas (‘Adam)
paras: You have shaped the letter Noon curved like the eyebrows, eyes like Swad and Jiim like ears. These beautiful shapes designed by You have become a trial and problem for hundreds of consciousnesses and wisdoms. With these letters, wisdom has become very keen and sharp. You are a good writer; and write well more and more for us.

sections.heading: ‘Adam Dominates Created World
paras: Non-material existence of Pre-creation times has dominance upon all thoughts and ideals which goes on providing fresh, beautiful ideals every moment. It is from these unseen, non-material, not-verbal world that thoughts ideas and shapes come about which assume the shapes of words and sketches and bodies. These are strange words written upon the tablet of imagination in the form of letters resembling eyes (Swad), ears (Jiim) and eyebrows (Noon). All things have originated from the shapeless, non-material world of pre-creation times (Mulk-e-‘adam), and I am in love with this. Because, that world is everlasting, and its products do not decay as those of the material world. This beloved never betrays and is always devoted. O God! Make our wisdom capable of reading these letters, shapes and sketches so that they may wrap up our plans, aims and objects.

chapters.title: Different Ways from Single Center
chapters.subtitle: Comparison of our wisdom with Jibra’iil’s and its observing of the hidden matters like Jibra’iil’s reading of the protected tablet (Lowh-e-Mahfooz)

sections.heading: Low-E-Mahfooz (Protected Tablet)
paras: Wisdom, like the angels, learns the lessons of daily needs from the protected tablet (Lowh -e-Mahfooz). Look at those writings of the pre-creation time (‘Adam), which are very clear for the wise, but the black colour of those writings adds confusion to the confused. Every fellow has become a fool in search of the wealth of that wisdom of the (tablet), which is as rich as “Ganj gao” the wealth of the cow (Ganj Gao). [Ganj Gao was a great treasure from among the treasures of emperor Jamsheed of Persia, which was hidden within a large underground cellar. The treasure consisted of cows and other animals made of gold studded with gems. Because most of such animals were on the model of cows, it was called wealth of the cow (Ganj gao). When it was found out during the reign of king Bahram Gaur, he broke these models into pieces and distributed the gold pieces and gems among the beggars and needy]

sections.heading: Different Acts and Thoughts from Same Source

Those Who Take Different Ideas from the Protected Tablets Behave Differently. One Person with His Ideas Ran Towards the Mines in the Mountains. Another, with Another Idea, Took to Great Struggle Turned Toward the Oceans to Find Out Pearls. Another Went to Religious Centers (Monasteries: Church, Synagogue, Temple) to Resort to Deprivation of the Pleasures of the Body Like Food, Sex and Resorted to Physical Torture to Become a Monk. Another to Meet His Worldly Greed Went Toward the Farmland for Agriculture. Another Became a Dacoit and Went to Commercial Centers to Loot, While Another Became a Soothing Balm to Save the Injured from Pain. Another Got His Heart Lost in the Art of Magic Spells to Call Fairies in Physical Form, While Another Put His Steps on the Stars. One Is Going in a Ship to Earn Profits. Another Is Busy Committing Sins, While Another Is Devoted to Noble Acts. Cursorily These Appear to Be Different Ways Because of Their Different External Colours and Thoughts. Everyone Is in Astonishment as to Why These Different Approaches Are. Everyone Is Pleased of What He Does and Rejects the Pleasures of Others. When All These Ideas Are from the Same Source, Then Why Are the Ways and Approaches Different? This Is Because: All of Them Have Hidden Themselves from the Center of the Soul of All These. Everyone Is Looking Toward a Particular Side, Ignoring the Central Point

chapters.title: Different Ways and Thoughts
chapters.subtitle: Resort to different ways and thoughts to identify Qibla (Ka’aba at Makka) by the worshippers in darkness is like the presumption of divers to dive into seabed for pearls

paras: All these acts are like the presumptions of the worshippers who turn toward different directions in the dark night presuming them to be Qibla. But when Qibla appears clearly in the morning, it becomes clear to them as to who was right and who was wrong. Or like the divers under the sea who quickly fill up their bags with whatever they can put their hand upon, presuming them to be pearls. When they come out from the depth of the sea, the holder of the precious pearls becomes clear to them, so also the collectors of small pearls and beads. “In this manner We will test them in the field, which is a time of great disgrace.”

sections.heading: Everyone Appreciates His Thinking
paras: In similar manner, every community in the world is flying around a single lamp like moths. Everyone is felling upon fire by moving around it. They all think that they will be fortunate like H. Musa to get the fire which makes the tree greener and fresh. Every group has heard of the excellence of that fire and understood the worth of its sparks. But when the bright light of the morning appears, all will come to know as to what lamp it was. The moth that got its wings burnt with successful results will be rewarded with seventy wings by the lamp. Those who do not use their wisdom and blindly fall upon the lamp of vicious qualities of false gods get their wings burnt and fall down burnt out and dead under it. That community will suffer with shame and injury and start sighing upon the eye-stitching desires. Their lamp (false god) will simply tell them: “I am myself burned down. How can I give you relief?” It will weep and say: “My head itself is burnt out. How can I provide light to others?”

chapters.title: Misguided and the Guided
chapters.subtitle: Exegesis of ayat: Ah! Alas for My servants: Yaa hasrattan balaal ‘ibaad: Yasiin: 36: 30

paras: The burnt out fellow will say: “Ah! I got misguided by your face. I recognized you very late. Our false god of viciousness and desires as our lamp died. Its appealing beauty had trapped us, because of our disgraceful blindness. Profit became loss by way of fines, which complains to God for his blindness. Congratulations to the pious brothers and sisters who are all Muslims, faithful and supplicating and worthy of appreciation.”

sections.heading: Trained and Free Birds
paras: Everyone has turned his face in some direction. Only they are successful and honourable who turned their faces toward the directionless God. Every pigeon has been trained to go in one direction and it flies in it. These successful souls are like these pigeons. But other souls turned in different directions and flew in those directions. Every falcon flies from one place to another and it has a directionless flight and is a free bird. We are neither the domestic and trained birds nor free birds. Our grain is a grain of grainlessness. We are free birds having no concern for any particular direction. That is why our provisions are so wide and large that our loss is also our gain. Our tearing off of our apparel is like stitching. We do not depend upon apparent means but maintain reliance upon God for everything. We believe in the statement of God: And if anyone puts trust in God, God is sufficient for him: wa man yatawakkal ‘alaa Allaahi fahuwa hasbuhu: (Talaq: 65: 3).

chapters.title: Give Up Old Things
chapters.subtitle: To explain why Farraji was called as Farraji; that is expanded loose apparel, jubba

paras: A Sufi tore off his shirt in the days of his distress. After this he found good times. He called this torne shirt as Farraji. (One that brings prosperity); and because of the good person’s connection, shirts came to be called as “Farraji.” This name became popular, and its inner meaning was known only to that Sufi.

sections.heading: People Go by Words, Not Meanings
paras: People took only the name and were left only with the residue left in the wine cup. In this manner they ignored the inner meanings of all words and took the meanings only as hard, physical and residual. One attracted to mud and material caught hold of the left-over residue; and those looking into the meanings were estranged and walked away leaving the material to the people.

The Sufi said that the left-over residue requires to be cleaned. This will lead to the clarification of the meanings of words and all other things resulting in the cleansing of the heart. Residue is thick, hard and troublesome, and filtered wine in clean, clear and sparkling like a clean, ripe date which has left off its rawly state as left-over residue and given it up. There is prosperity along with adversity. Be assured of it and do not lose hopes. Through this death-like situation of adversity, you can find a way to life. O my son! If you want a new, clean shirt, tear off your old shirt so that you may get a new one. Give up your thoughts of sensory observations and their pleasures. This will clean your heart and take you to truth.

sections.heading: Who Is a Sufi?
paras: Sufi is one who searches for clarity and purity, and not the one with garments made of wool, stitched in a particular way with special markings. It has become an easy means for the mean fellows with branded dresses and homosexuals to become sufis and get secured from criticism. Putting on colorful dresses, talking words of clean heartedness and possessing the names of great men may be good. They are good if you do this as a starting point and march toward truthfulness of matters, just as the cat goes toward the bread upon its smell. Because smell is a guide to lead a lover toward the beloved just as it had given eyes to lead H. Yakub toward H. Yusuf.

sections.heading: But It Is Also Like the Doorbash (the Two-Pronged Spear Studded with Gems on Its Stalk Carried Before a King to Warn the People About His Oncoming). Mischievous Thoughts Keep You Away from Truth and Act Like Curtains for the Observance of the Grandeur of God as Though They Are Your Doorbash. the Same Vicious Thoughts Keep Others Also in Vicious Thoughts. It Has Tied Up Every Such Searcher and Kept Him Confined in the Darkness of Night. Every Thought Stops at This Level and Does Not Proceed Further. the Exceptions Are Those with Sharp Hearing and Consciousness, Who Get Support from God’s Armies, and Reach from Material Thoughts to Spiritual Thoughts. They Go Out of the Confines of Thoughts, and Without Any Fear Show the Arrows of Royal Significance and Get Out. One Who Carries the Arrow of the King, Finds Out the Way and Reaches the Inner Court
God’s Graces Falling and Beautifying All
paras: O Eternal Grace, Knower of all secrets! We are helpless on our way to You and under trials. Grant the means of success to this confused heart. Grant an arrow to these twice bent bows, which have become worthless due to too much bending. You have spilled some drink from your cup on the earth and it is well known that even mud receives drinks from the cups of the generous. Marks of this drink are seen on the tufts and faces of dust, making even king’s lick the dust. This good earth is beautiful because of a sip of the beauty of your drink, consequent upon which everyone licks it with all heart and soul, day and night. When a sip of your material drink, mixed up with mud makes one mad like Majnn, what all cannot happen when it is a sip of your pure, spiritual drink.

sections.heading: Efforts Needed by Man to Be Blessed
paras: Everyone is standing before a lump of mud in all humility with torne clothes, as that lump of mud has taken a sip from the drink of your beauty. A sip has fallen upon the sun, moon and the constellation of Taurus. Another has fallen upon the Empyrean, Throne and Saturn. Whatever you may call it a sip or an alchemy! With its impact mortality becomes immortal. O man, master of arts! This impact is in need of great efforts from your side. This cannot be touched other than with intense efforts of austerities and meditation and spiritually journey. None other than the spiritual cleansed can touch it.

There is a sip fallen on ruby, gold and pearl, and upon wine, accompanying snacks and fruits. One sip has fallen upon the faces of frail beauties. When all these material bodies have been beautified so much, imagine what would be the impacts upon the souls which have purified themselves of the gross materials. When you go crazy for the material beauties, imagine what will happen to you if you see that beauty cleansed of gross materials. Just see what happens, when that sip of beauty goes out of the lump of the muddy body at the time of death.

That beauty has gone away and what is left is the gross material body, which you immediately think of burying getting surprised, as to why such great beauty was with this ugly, degraded body till then. When the soul shows its beauty directly without this dead body and you look at it, there is a pleasure, which cannot be explained.

sections.heading: Beauty Compared with Gross Materials
paras: When moon shows its brightness uncovered by clouds, there is no standard of measure to explain its clearness and beauty. Only in comparison with gross things, that its beauty can be assessed by sensory looks. Think of the original beauty and deliciousness. How great is that kitchen full of the deliciousness of sugar and honey that produces food which the kings lick forgetting their great status. How great is that godown of grains of faith, kept in an isolated desert, every ear of which is snatched by other ears. How great is that river of life without sorrows as against which, all the seven oceans are just like dew.

sections.heading: Never Satiated Greed of Man
paras: When the provider of the drink of Alast (God, who has taken the promise of obedience from all the humans, well before the creation itself), spilled a sip upon the lowly barren earth, it stood up in great enthusiasm, and because of this we are in great enthusiasm. O God! Give us another sip as we are without strength. If we are justified in lamenting upon our weakness and crave for another sip we shall do so, and if not we shall keep quiet.

All this is a narration of the greedy, lowly, perverse, duck of man. Learn the lesson of slaughtering this duck from H. Ibrhm Khalillullah. There are many other good and bad things in this duck. I am afraid; if I engage myself in explaining these good and bad things, other matters will remain untold.

chapters.title: Hunting and Getting Hunted
chapters.subtitle: Character of the peacock and the reason for H. Ibrhm’s slaughtering it, may he be in peace

sections.heading: Threats and Awards for Self-Projection
paras: Now, we have come to speak about the peacock of duel nature, which is projecting itself proudly for name and glory. Its intentions are to trap the creatures through good and bad means. It is unaware of the results of its acts. It is as ignorant of the design of the hunter as the net is, as the net is not aware of its being spread out. It has nothing to do with the profit and loss caused by its spreading. Its ignorance of being spread out is astonishing that it is used by the hunter for his own gains, and the net becomes a factor for his gains inspite of getting nothing for itself. Similarly, my brother, you also elevated many of your friends with hundreds of pleasing acts and later left them out. Right from the day of birth, this is what you have been doing to catch them in the nets, or by giving them grants, using both these opposite methods. This you do out of your love for grandeur.

You should think that with this hunting process and efforts, ultimately you get nothing. No warps and wefts of the net will reach you if you put your hand in it. Much of the time has passed and unexpected time has come, but still you are engaged in hunting. You catch hold of one and leave off the other. Like mean fellows you leave off this one and keep yourself engaged in this job which gives no profit. You play in this manner, like the children in a strange manner.

sections.heading: Net Results, Destructive
paras: The night of your life arrives, and you remain without any prey in the net. Your net gives you nothing but headache and self-imposed imprisonment. You got trapped and became a prey of your own net because you got imprisoned in this game and ultimately got nothing. Can there be such a foolish hunter in the world like you who becomes a victim of his own net? Catching hold of the common people in the net of your self-pride and ostentations is like catching a pig with so much hardship and finally to find that its flesh is prohibited for eating.

sections.heading: Love Cannot Be Caught in Net
paras: The only worthy thing to be caught is love, but it does not get caught in anybody’s net. But you can catch it by getting caught by it. Therefore, give up your net and fall into the net of love. Love whispers slowly into my ears: “it is better to be hunted than to be a hunter. Make yourself a fool and fall in love. Forget to become the sun but become a particle. Give up your own house and fall upon my door. Do not try to be a lamp but become a moth, so that you may know the taste of life and see kingship hidden within slavery. It is here that you see the real pleasure of life.”

sections.heading: False Names and Titles
paras: The way of the life is strange. They call a man on the gallows as a king. They put a rope around his neck and put a black hood on his head and call it as a crown and the people look at him as though he is a king. In similar manner the exterior of the graves of infidels is covered with precious fabrics, and inside there is the wrath of God of Grandeur and honour. Their graves are plastered with mortar and lime and curtains of false pride are hanged. Your worshippers are decorative in nature and like the palm made of wax which is only to look at but not to get any leaves and fruits.

chapters.title: Victims of God’s Designs
chapters.subtitle: To explain that everyone knows of God’s graces and His wraths. Everyone avoids His wrath and is linked with His grace. But God has hidden his love in wrath and wrath in love. This reverse process is done by God as a trick so that the sensible and seers seeing Him through His light may be kept as distinct from those who see Him without sense but only in appearance, as God has said: That He might try you, which of you is best in conduct: Liyablu wakum ayyukum ahsanu ‘amalaa: (Hud: 11: 7)

paras: A darvesh asked another darvesh: “What did you see of God?” He said: “I saw Him as resembling nothing and uncomparable. But to explain it, I shall give a small example. I found fire on His left side and the fountain of kauth(s)ar on His right. On his left is fire capable of setting fire to the world and on his right a nice stream. A group of people extending hands toward the fire and another group moving toward the stream in full pleasure and joy. But it is difficult for each group to go on the opposite side. [Those going toward fire cannot go toward water and vice versa]. This is so for them whether you consider them as good or bad. One who went into fire and flames, brought out his head from out of the stream; and the one who went toward water was instantly fire found in fire. One, who went on the right waterside, brought his head from fire on the left side. So also, the one who went to the left, fireside brought out his head from the right.

“Very few people came to know of this secret situation and therefore very few went into fire. The exceptions were those upon whose head fortune played its role, which rid them of water, and they entered into fire.”

[A little explanation of this is that there is no absolute good or absolute bad. Those who start with good may end in bad and vice versa. Similarly, providing of comforts of life and yielding to bodily pleasures will not provide spiritual attainments. On the contrary, spiritual attainments come about through deprivation of the pleasures of body. It depends upon how one takes. Difficulties of life symbolised as fire produce good results symbolised as stream.]

sections.heading: Gains, Profits and Losses
paras: People go only after profits and gains taking them as God, but actually they are getting into losses. Group by group, rank by rank are all in greed and fastness. They try to avoid fire and go toward the stream and raise their heads from fire. But can they simply run away from it first because they do not like it. Fire calls them: “O foolish fellows! I am not fire to destroy you. I am a lovable fountain. Do not be blind. You have been blindfolded. Come into me and do not be afraid of my flames. Become one like H. Ibrhm and see that there are no flames and smoke here, excepting the smoke and magic of Nimrod. “If you come into it like the well informed H. Ibrhm, fire is water for you, even when you like to fall on fire like the moth. The soul of moth cries out: “I have lost my wings. How good! Had there been thousands of wings of mine, so as to get burnt with fire. This is due to the impact of love that moths have for fire who are only unidentifiable, unconnected, have blind eyes and hearts. A fool with his donkish nature feels pity on me, but I feel pity for him out of my wisdom.”

sections.heading: Life for One, Death for Another
paras: We consider fire as the cold life of water. What the moth considers is different from what we consider. The moth sees light in fire and falls for it. It loves light, not fire. It goes toward light mistaking fire for light. But a faithful person knows well that fire is fire, and it is by passing through it that he can see light. He knows the difference between fire and light. Fire is only a medium for him to reach toward light. This is the type of game that the grandeur of the Lord played with H. Ibrahim to set a model to see who among his progeny is his real follower. He gave the shape of fire to water and placed a fountain of water within it.

sections.heading: Everyone Bound by God’s Designs
paras: A magician exhibits the grains of rice in a plate as worms to the gathering of people. He shows a house full of scorpions with his magic spells though there are no scorpions in it. When magic can show hundreds of such things, just think over, as to how great the designs of God the creator of magic can be. Inevitably with the magic of God, men and women have fallen into the deep well of glamour for each other for which there is no rope to bring them out. Magicians are also like His servants and slaves having been caught in His net like wag tails (tiny birds). No magic is of any worth before Him. Read in the Quran, see how the permissible magic of God turned their magical plots upside down, which were such as to shake the hills: wa in kaana makruhum litazuula minhul jibaal: (Ibrahim: 14: 46).

sections.heading: A Particle of Wisdom, Better Than Salat and Fasting
paras: I am not like Pharaoh to go toward the river Nile, I am like H. Ibrahim to go toward fire. [Pharaoh went into Nile finding it dry but sank, while H. Ibrahim went into fire but was saved]. In the case of Ibrahim, it was not fire but flowing water and in the other case, because of plotting, it was a river of fire. The noble Prophet has very well said that a particle of wisdom for you is better than fasting and salat; because your wisdom is a substance and these two are accidents, which depend upon the substance of wisdom. These have been made duteous in order to perfect your wisdom. So that the mirror of your wisdom may be polished to shine better, because worship brings about cleanliness in your breast. But if the mirror is defective from the beginning, the polish becomes effective very late.
Therefore, a master should choose such disciples who are smart and intelligent, who can be polished well with little efforts.

chapters.title: Wisdoms Are Different
chapters.subtitle: Difference in wisdom is inherent as against the claim of Mu‘tazila who say that wisdom of everyone is the same and its increase or difference is due to teaching, efforts and experience

paras: Know this, there are many inherent grades of wisdom, as many as from earth to the sky at their individual levels. There is a wisdom as bright as the tablet of sun and there is another lesser than Venus and shooting star. There is one wisdom that is stable and contented like a lamp and there is another hot like fiery star. These are shrouded by clouds. When the clouds go away from them, they get the light to see God. Wisdoms of all are the reflections of the wisdom of God. His wisdom is like musk and wisdom of the creatures is like its fragrance.

sections.heading: Total and Partial Wisdom
paras: Total wisdom and total consciousness are possessed by the men of God. They are very much related to the Empyrean (‘arsh) and the throne (Kursi). They may not be considered as separate from them. The essence of a man of God is an exhibitor of God. Search for God from him and not from others. Partial wisdom brings disgrace to total wisdom, inspite of the fact that it originates from total wisdom. Indulgence in the pleasures of the world makes a man useless and aimless. Total wisdom indulged in the love of God, made itself a prey in His net, submitted itself in entirety, and acquired the qualities of God; while partial wisdom tried to trap other creatures in its net, but got itself trapped. It put itself into the sorrows of a trapped prey. The total wisdom rendered service to God and His creatures and got the pride of place of mastership, but partial wisdom tried to make others subservient to it, but itself became subservient and lost its honour. Partial wisdom with its pharaonic attitude became a prisoner of water while the children of Isra‘iil upon becoming the followers of H. Musa got released from the prison and became lords. This game is going in a perverse way because of the narrow crossways of the bishop on the chessboard. There are many such things which do not depend upon your efforts and designs. Therefore, do not entirely depend upon your designs. There are many matters of fortune and fate. Do not think of tying your wrap on the basis of your thoughts and expertise. God has no concern for all these, and He does not show the path to treacherous.

sections.heading: Humble Service Gives Mastership
paras: You may show your designs in the path of good service, so that through this, inspite of being among the followers, you may become like a prophet in conduct and character for his followers. Use your wisdom and resort to proper acts so as to be rid of your own plots. Put efforts to get rid of and separated from jealousies. Use your wisdom and designs to become lowest of the servants because as a reward for this lowliness, you will become a master. Resorting to lowliness, provides mastership. You are behaving like an old wolf by resorting to treacherous service to the people with the intention of becoming their master by ostentatious means. Stop doing this.

As against this, run toward fire like the moth in your love for your people. Do not do acts to fill your bag with gold, but resort to good behaviour. Do not show your superiority but resort to humility as God’s mercy moves toward the weak and humble. If you make yourself humble, you will get His mercy, and search for His mercy in your humbleness and weakness. Exhibition of the thirst of a thirsty man in distress is real, but its pretention by way of false, cold, humble sighs will not lead to objectives. Brothers of H. Yusuf also cried before their father. But it was treacherous, as their inside was full of jealousy and mental sickness.

chapters.title: Miscalculated Preferences
chapters.subtitle: Narrative of a bedouin, whose dog was dying of hunger when his bag was full of bread; but he was lamenting upon the dog, reciting verses, crying and beating upon his Head and mouth. He was hesitating to give a little bread to the dog. A passer-by’s questioning him and his answer

paras: A dog was dying but its bedouin master was crying, shedding tears and telling: “What a calamity! What am I to do? What way is there for me? How can I live after you have gone away?” A passer-by asked him: “What is this crying for? What is the matter for your lamentation and grief?” the bedouin said: “I have a dog and it is of very good conduct. Now it is dying on the way. It used to hunt for me during the day and guard me during night. You may know my young man! It was not a dog. It was a male lion, with sharp eyesight, a chaser of the thief and catcher of games. It used to run behind a game fast like an arrow. It used to hunt for me and guard me. It would not allow a thief to come near me. It was of patient nature, free, sharp-witted and chaser of the enemy, and of very good conduct, sincere and a well-wisher.”

sections.heading: Tears Cheaper Than Bread
paras: The passer-by said: “What sickness or injury he is suffering from?” The bedouin said: “it is suffering from a never satiating hunger which is called the dog’s hunger”. The passer-by said: “Have patience on this pain and grief, as God rewards the patient ones.” Thereafter, he again asked: “O independent man! What does this bag contain which you are carrying on your back?” He replied: “It contains my bread and good meal for tomorrow, which I am carrying to provide energy for my body.” That man said: “Why don’t you give bread and food to your dog?” He replied: “I don’t have so much of love and generosity for the dog. On the way I do not get bread without paying money; but the tears of both my eyes are free of cost.” Then he said: “O goatskin full of air, may dust fall on your head! A piece of bread is better than tears in your view! Tears are made of blood that get converted into water with grief. O senseless fellow: blood is not of the worth of dust.” The bedouin degraded himself like Iblis. He is a part of the devil as a part is the same as the whole. So also, his tears.

sections.heading: Surrender Your Designs to God
paras: I am a slave of the one who does not sell himself to anybody other than to that King of benevolences and generosity. I am a slave of a person upon whose cries the sky would cry, and lament upon whose lamentations. I am the slave of that courageous copper, which would not submit before anything other than alchemy. When such a person rises his hand for supplication in pain, God’s graces fly toward that hapless one. (As stated earlier), if you want to get released from this narrow well of the world, you may walk upon the fire of worship and austerities without any hesitation. Surrender yourself to the designs of God and do not cheat yourself with your designs. Know this well, that God’s designs put to shame all the designs of all the wicked fellows. Such being the case, when you design gets lost into the designs of God, you will find that strange difficult paths become easy passages for you. These strange difficult paths will have very lowly existences before you and you will always be on the path of progress and prosperity. Therefore, put your efforts to get this path of progress, so that you may feel the fragrance of the knowledge that comes from God alone (Ilmi-Ladunni) and from no other source. When you come to know of the circumstances of your prosperity and progress, you will be able to know well as to what is the best for you.

chapters.title: Impacts of Evil Eyes
chapters.subtitle: To explain that no evil eye is as destructive as a look of self-esteem, excepting the one that is changed with the light of God as has been said: He hears through my ears and Sees through my eyes and gets lost from himself

paras: Do not look at your beautiful peacock feathers but look at your ugly feet, so that evil eyes may not cast their spell. (So also, with regard to your qualities. Do not look at your merits but at your defects). Because with evil eyes, even hills get upset. Read this clearly in the Quran that you will be upset as stated: And the unbelievers would almost trip you up with their eyes: wa in yakaadu liyaz liquunaka bi absaarihim: (Qalam: 68: 51). The Prophet, so strong like the mountain slipped down because of evil eye on a way in which there was no rain and slush. He was astonished as to with what that he slipped, and he did not think that this happened without there being a special reason. At last, an ayat was revealed to him and informed of the reason that it was due to an evil eye and enmity. It was also told that, had there been anyone other than him, he would have instantly died. A victim of evil eye gets into destruction. Therefore, know the meaning of evil eye and read the ayat starting with “in yakaada”. But the shirt-pulling protection came to protect him from falling as this slipping was for the purpose of revealing of something very esoteric and important. This is to further tell you to see that when a strong mountain like person like the Prophet could be affected by evil eye, you of the worth of a scrap should not be careless.

chapters.title: Craze for Domination
chapters.subtitle: Exegesis of ayats: And the unbelievers would almost trip you up with their eyes when they hear the message; and they say: “Surely he is possessed.” But it is nothing but a message to all the worlds. (Qalam: 68: 51 and 52)

paras: People told the Prophet: “O Prophet of God! There are such people in this valley who cast a spell with their evil eyes on vultures. With their eyes, skull of the lion in the bush would split compelling it to cry in pain. One puts deathly evil eye on a camel and then sends a slave telling him to buy the fat of that camel and bring it. He sees the camel walking on the road as dead. That is how he is sure of the end at death of the camel due to the impact of his eye. That camel which can compete with a horse in race falls sick with its cut off head. Definitely, with jealousy and evil eye, the sky reverses the motion and speed of things. Impact of the evil eye is apparent, but it is due to the programme set up by God, as in the case of water wheel, which is visible, but water is not, even though it is water that sets the wheel in rotation.”

sections.heading: How to Counter Evil Eye
paras: The treatment to nullify the impact of evil eye is a noble eye as of a godly person, which crushes the evil eye under its feet. Mercy of God is on the forefront and evil eye is a product of God’s wrath and curse. His mercy is dominant on the prophets, and His wrath is dominant upon their enemies. That is why every prophet dominates upon his enemies, because the prophet is a product of His mercy and its opposite, wrath goes with the ugly enemies.

sections.heading: Desire for Domination
paras: Greed of the duck is unascertainable, but it is just at one level in comparison with the greed of sensual passions, which are like snakes; and the desire for domination and honourable status is like a python. Greed of the duck is connected with its gullet and sex, but the love of domination is twenty times more. Domination and love for honourable status involves a participation in godliness and boasting, and it is such a greed and sin that cannot be pardoned. Adam’s disgrace was due to his inclination toward stomach and sex, but that of Iblis was due to the sense of superiority and domination. That is why Adam realised his wrong and repented soon, but the accursed Iblis had an arrogant approach for repentance. Greed related to the gullet and sex is physical, but craze for domination is mental as it is opposed to humility and submission. If I have to say about its roots and branches, I shall be in need of another volume.
