Therefore, whatever you sow must be sown in a good land so that each seed may give a hundred thousand.

sections.heading: Of Course, Planning Is Good, But…
paras: Of course, I agree that the seed that you sow is in the land that you consider to be the cause of increase. But what can you do if the crop does not come about for two-three years, excepting offering your praises and prayers to God by spreading your hands. You will beat your forehead with your hands before God as your hands and head are evidences of the fact that food is provided by God only. This is to make you know that He alone is the root of food. Every searcher of food seeks from Him alone. Seek food from Him only, and not from others. Seek intoxication from Him and not from wine and marijuana. Riches is from His love and not from wealth and property. Seek support from Him and not from your maternal and paternal uncles. In the end, you will be separated from them. And then, who else can you call for support? What you have to do then, may be done now itself. Call for His support only and not of others, so that you may be an inheritor of the rule of the world. Be sure of the day when a man will run away from his brother; and the children will run away from the father, as has been stated: that day shall a man flee from his own brother, from his mother and his father, and from his wife and children. Each of them, that day will have enough concern (of his own) to make him indifferent to others: Yawma yafirrul mar ‘u min akhiihi, wa ummihi wa abiihi, wa saahibatihi wa baniihi. Likullim ri’an min hum yaoma’izin shaanun yughnihi; (‘Abasa: 80: 35-37). Children will run away from father.

sections.heading: Friendship Is Not Permanent
paras: Every friend at that time will be an enemy of the friend, as he was your idol and your preventer from your path. You turned your face from the Maker of your face and fell in love with the face of that friend that He made. If your friends become your opponents in this world itself, run away from you and become inimical to you, you may consider this as fortunate for you that what had to happen later has happened now itself. The trouble that you will have to face in the next life is faced by you here itself. That, people of this world by opposing you in this world have become an advance payment for you for that world. This has happened well before the completion of your life and spending of the whole life with them in this world itself.

You should think: “I had purchased a defective material and I am thankful that its defect was found out in the morning itself as there was a scope of returning it. Otherwise, had it been known later, I would have incurred loss. I would have lost the material and also my life as well as my capital. It would be like paying in cash for buying counterfeit gold and going back to home well pleased. It is a thanksgiving situation that it appeared to be counterfeit before the loss of much of the life. This gold would have remained around my neck for ever. I would have regretted long for the loss of life. But as its counterfeit quality became known in the morning itself, I can return it and go back soon.”

sections.heading: Better to Lose Selfish Friends
paras: Do not grieve if a friend expresses his enmity, jealousy and meanness for you and attacks you. Do not complain of his turning his face away from you and do not make yourself a fool and dullard. But be thankful to God and give charity in thanks that you got rid of an old troublesome bag of burden. That you came out of the burdensome situation early which would enable you to search for the True and Everlasting Friend. A friendship that will be thrice blessed for you after your death. He is the Great Elevated King or a saint, beloved of the King and an intercessor for you. You got saved from the sweet-speaking-treacherous-rogue and came to know of his ignorance and inability well before your death. So also, the troubles given to you by the worldly people may not be taken as misfortune. They are a treasure of hidden gold. The worldly people will make you one of bad character, and helplessly take you on the wrong path. Be sure that all will become opponents, enemies and mischievous for you in the end. You will remain grumbling and lamenting in the grave pleading helplessly to God, not to leave you alone, telling that troubles from the people are better that the sincerities of the good people. What all others have given are also a great grant from You.

sections.heading: Advice, Useless Without Receivers
paras: O possessor of the harvest! Hear this from your wisdom itself to pass on the wheat given by God’s earth, so that it may remain protected from the thief and worms. Kill the devil with white ants who tells you to hoard the grains. He always frightens you of poverty and loss. Hunt him in the way, the falcon hunts the pigeon. You are the beloved successful falcon of the king. It is disgraceful for you to hunt upon a sparrow. The noble man advised his sons very much on these lines. The seeds of his advice were not of any avail as the land of their heart was unfertile. An adviser may have a hundred useful points, but they need the ears that can take and protect them. You will advise in hundreds of soft and convincing ways, but he will avoid all your advice. One stubborn, quarrelsome, non-accommodating fellow with these qualities, can make a hundred wise men humble. There have not been better advisers in sweet ways than the prophets, as their words penetrated into the rocks and stones. Such of the words that became effective on rocks and mountains could not be understood by those unfortunate fellows. Their arrogant hearts had qualities harder than the rocks: they became like a rock and even worse in hardness. Fahiya kalhijaarati an ashaddu qaswatan: (Baqara: 2: 74).

chapters.title: God’s Grants Not Dependent upon Abilities
chapters.subtitle: To explain that grants and authority by God are not dependent upon the recipient’s abilities like the grants of the people, which are based upon abilities; for the reason that God’s grants are eternal; and abilities are created. Granting is the quality of the Majestic and Grand God and ability is the quality of the people. And eternal is not dependent upon the created

sections.heading: No Precondition of Laws and Principles for Grants
paras: The heart that is harder than the rock can be treated and changed by the Changer of hearts with his benevolence. There is no pre-condition of ability for the grants by Him. When He wishes, He brings about such changes in the heart also, that it gets the ability to accept changes. That is: the pre-condition of ability is also His grant, as grant is the pulp and ability is the rind of the fruit. [ The grants and graces of God are of two kinds: faiz-e-Aqdas (absolute grace) and Faiz-e Muqaddis (Purified, rendered holy grace). Faiz-e-Aqdas is the one that reaches into well settled principles and laws. It is self-possessing. There is no need for ability and capability in this. They are inbuilt. The other kind, Faiz-e-Muqaddis, reaches the souls from the well established principles of ability and capability —Qazi Sajjad Hussain]

This is in the case of H. Musa that his staff became a python and the palm of his hand bright like the sun. They were self-possessive and in built. There are such thousands of miracles of the prophets which cannot be understood by the treasure of our wisdom. They have come about not on the lines of the established principles and laws, but exclusively on the basis of God’s grants. Such capacities cannot be possessed by destructible creatures. Both capacities to bear, and the burden of great gifts, are given by Him.

sections.heading: Exceptions to Rules and Principles (Causes)
paras: If abilities of the recipients were necessary for the carrying of the jobs of God, no existent could have come into existence. As neither it existed, nor its abilities. But God has let open ways, principles and reasons to creatures like us under the blue roof of sky for those who search for. Most of the things come about as per these principles (or causes); and sometimes the authority of God commits a breach of principles. He has kept pleasing principles and habits for events to occur and has made the breaches as miracles for some occasions. We may not get honourable status, without reason. But God’s authority is not incapable of suspending all the reasons. Therefore, the one held up in the obligations of reasoning must come out of it and should not have suspicions upon the Creator of causes and the suspender of causes.

sections.heading: Causes Generally Followed, but Not Always
paras: The Creator of causes does whatever He desires and His absolute authority is not dependent upon causes. He can tear off all causes. But generally, he goes according to the causes so that the seeker may also learn to seek his objects according to them. What way can a seeker go after when there are no causes? That is to say, that the cause comes about to show the road to follow. These causes are hidden behind curtains from the eyes and cannot be found by all as everyone is not competent to understand them. A keen sight that can create holes in the causes and penetrate into them is required so as to be able to remove those curtains from the roots and foundations. [This keen sight is seen in the cases of great scientists, investigators, searchers and researchers who have torne the causes well known by the people and brought forward new, unknown causes to fore. There is a continuing process ever since man started thinking and will continue — Translator]. So that, he may be in a position to see the Creator of causes right from the time When nothing existed, and subsequently, and realise that his own efforts, causes and proceedings are useless without Him. Every good and bad thing comes from the Creator of causes and not form the causes and means. The thought other than this is wrong. However, even this wrong thought is given by Him only, [as in the case of earlier thinkers —Translator] so that a man may pass through a period of thinking about it for some time and later realise the correct version, so that he may develop faith in the Unseen and His excellences.

chapters.title: Collection of Mud for Adam’s Body
chapters.subtitle: At the time of the making of Adam’s body, God gave a direction to Jibra’iil to go and bring a handful of mud. And according to another version, to bring a handful of mud from every place.

paras: When the Creator desired for the creation of man to test him for good and bad, He told the trustworthy Jibra’iil to collect a handful of mud from earth. That obedient, prepared himself and came upon the earth to undertake the command of the Lord of the worlds. He stretched his hand toward earth, but earth kept itself away from him out of fear. Then, it opened its mouth in flattery saying: “For the sake of the honour of that Great One, and in His name, you may leave me, go away from me and pardon my life. You may turn the reins of your horse from me and do not put me in trials and troubles. Leave me alone and do not drag me inside (Earth knew that this mud was to be used for the making of Adam’s body which would undergo great trials).

Please do this in view of the extra-ordinary concern that God has for you by elevating your status among others. You have the knowledge of the contents of the Protected Tablet (Laowhe-mahfuuz) to such an extent that you became the teacher of all angels. You are always in conversation with God. You will also be the ambassador for the prophets. You are the soul of the life of inspiration (wahii) and not of the body.

sections.heading: Other Angels Compared
paras: You are better placed than Israfiil for this reason only that he is the life of the body, you are of the possessor of the soul. His bugle blown by his breath is for the raising of the dead bodies, but your breath gives life to the living heart and soul. The pulp of the body’s life is life of the heart. The grant to the soul is greater than that to the body. Thus, your grant is greater than that of Israfiil.

Further you are also greater than, Mikaa’iil who provides food only to the body, but your job is to provide food to the bright hearts. He fills the coffers of the people limited by measures, but what you provide cannot be measured by any scale. So also, you are better than Izra’iil, who is in charge of death and destructions. You are better, just as God’s mercy goes far above in betterment than His wrath.”

“All these four are the bearers of the Throne and you are the king among them because of the great Informations that you have. On the doomsday, you will see the bearers of the Throne as eight in number and then you will be the best among the eight, as has been stated in the Quran: And eight will, that day bear the throne of your Lord above them: walmalaku ‘alaa arjaa’ihaa wa yahmilu ‘arsha rabbika fawqahum yawma’izin th(s)amaniatun: (Haaqqa: 69: 17).”

[Angels represent manifestations of divine glory. The number eight has perhaps no special significance, unless it be with reference to the shape of the “Throne”. The oriental throne is often octagonal, and its bearers would be one at each corner. Or, if it a square throne there might be for bearers, and four in relief at any given time, making eight in all — the whole description is symbolical, as representing the majesty of God most High. — Abdullah Yusuf Ali: The Holy Quran: Page 1599]

In this manner, earth was counting the great points of Jibra’iil and crying. It had realised the purpose of the seeking of a handful of mud. Jibraa’iil was a mine full of shyness and modesty. These swearing’s prevented him from doing his appointed jobs. The earth made many pleadings and swore, and he went back to God and said: “I was not slack in doing your job, and You know very well as to what all that happened. She took that name of Yours with the fright of which the movements of all the seven heavens stop.

When she swore upon Your name, Your mercy, benevolence and love in common and great, I felt ashamed, because of your name, as otherwise what is the worth of the transfer of a handful of mud, as You have given that might to the angels which can tear and split apart the heavens. What is the worth and strength of a handful of mud in my lifting it up. But Your mercy dominated the situation.”

chapters.title: Despatching of H. Mikaa’iil
chapters.subtitle: God’s sending of Mikaa’iil to lift a handful of mud from earth for the making and organizing of the prosperous body of H. Adam, father of all humans, vicegerent of God, the prostrated one by the angels and their teacher and Prophet, may praises and peace be upon him.

paras: God told Mikaa’iil to go down upon earth and be bold enough to lift a handful of mud. When Mikaa’iil reached the earth and stretched his hand, earth shivered and avoided his hand started and flattering him and shedding tears. With a burnt heart she praised him and tried to persuade him with tears of blood from her eyes and swore: “I plead in the name of the unmatchable, soft natured God, Who has made you a bearer of His grand throne and made you a measurer of the wealth of the provisions of the world, and provider of the water of His graces to the thirsty. Your name is derived from the word “kiil” meaning measuring, and you are the one to give food to the people on allotted and measured basis. Please give me relief and keep me free. You may see that I am talking to you fully drenched in blood. Angels are the mines of mercy of God.” Mikaa’iil said: “How can I sprinkle salt on the wounds like the devil who is the mine of calamities, who has put the children of Adam in sorrows and pains. Mercy is much before wrath. And benevolence is a dominant quality of God. His servants also possess this quality. Their goatskins are full of the water of His stream. The truthful Prophet Muhammad has said that the people follow the religion of their King.”

Miikaa’iil went back to the Lord of his guidance with empty hands and sleeves and said to Him: “O knower of the secrets and the King of guidance! Earth started flattery and crying and sighing. Her humbleness and cries defeated me. That yellow faced with fear cried very much. Tears of the eyes are very honourable before You. I could not remain unaffected by her cries. Crying and weeping are very much honoured by you. I could not ignore the sight of the cries and weeping. Eyes with tears are very respectful before You. How could I go against that aspect?

“There are invitations for cries five time in a day which invite Your servants for prayer and cries. The muazzin says: “come towards safety and security by crying before God. Whomsoever, You wish to be kept in trouble and sorrows, you close the way of cries and sighs for him; so that calamity may fall upon him without hindrance as there is no need of intercessor for cries and sighs. And you indulge one in cries and sighs whom you wish to protect from calamities”.

sections.heading: Those Who Do Not Cry Suffer
paras: It is said in the Quran about the people who met with great calamities as to why they did not weep and cry so as to chase away calamities: the ayat is what the sufferings reached them from Us, why then did they not learn humility? On the contrary they became hardened: Falaow laa iz jaa’ahum baasunaa tadhara ‘uu walaakin qasat quluubuhum: (An‘aam: 6: 43). And as their hearts were hardened, they found sins as worship and prayer. So long as a rebellious fellow does not consider himself as a criminal, tears will not flow from his eyes.

chapters.title: Submissions to God, Change Course of Nature
chapters.subtitle: Narrative of H. Yunus to explain that humility and crying prevent heavenly calamities. And as God is Absolute in authority, humility, crying and honouring Him, are always beneficial. Philosophers say that God acts as per His own nature and not for any reasons other than this; and humility and submissions do not change nature

sections.heading: Impacts of Cries Before God
paras: When the community of H. Yunus fell as a victim to calamity, a cloud full of fire got separated from the sky. It was raining lightnings and setting fire to stones. It was thundering, and the faces of the people were pale. All of them were sleeping on the terraces of their houses, when this trouble appeared from above. All of them came down from the terraces without their headgears and ran toward the forest. Mothers took their children out of homes and all the people cried loudly. From the evening prayer time till the morning, those people sprinkled dust upon their heads. Due to excessive crying their voices choked. And mercy of God came upon this quarrelsome community. After a time of hopelessness and the sighs of impatience, the cloud started moving away in a slow manner. This narrative of the community of H. Yunus is very long and this has come only as a passing reference. The subject matter of the topic relates to the taking of mud from earth. This had to be narrated, as crying and suffering have great concern for God. Their worth is not so much in other places as before God.

sections.heading: Cry, to Get Pleasure Later
paras: Therefore, take care! Have hopes on this fact and hold on to it. If you cry before Him, you will stand up with pleasure afterwards, and this pleasure is everlasting. Cry and take long sighs before him to be happy later. Cry: so that you may laugh even without your mouth. Your pleasure will be so much that all parts of the body will express it and not only the mouth. The Honourable King has kept as equal in worth, your tears as of the blood of martyrs. A Hadith(s) says: “Nothing is as lovely for God as two drops. One drop of the tear that falls down in God’s fear and a drop of blood that falls in the path of God.”
That community of H. Yunus cried and shed the tears from the eyes resulting in the coming forward of mercy and going away of calamity.

chapters.title: Sending of Israafiil to Bring Mud
chapters.subtitle: God’s sending of Israafiil to earth to bring a handful of mud for making the body of H. Adam, the Prophet, may honour and peace be upon him

paras: God told Israafiil to go and bring a handful of dust from that heap of mud. Israafiil also came toward earth, and it again started crying, saying: “O angel of the trumpet and the ocean of life! You are the one with whose breaths, dead bodies get back to life. You will blow a loud sound in the trumpet resulting in the decomposed bones to be collected into living creatures on the doomsday. You will blow into the trumpet and call the martyrs of Karbala to get up saying: “O those who died with the hitting of swords, raise your head from the ground like the branches and leaves of the trees. With your mercy and all-embracing breath, this world will get filled up with the living bodies. You are the angel and demonstrator of mercy. You are the bearer of the throne of God, and the centre of justice.”

sections.heading: Streams of Water, Milk, Honey and Wine
paras: God’s throne is the mine of justice and equity, with four streams of clemency and forgievance flowing underneath it — streams of milk and of never exhausting honey, of wine, and the river Tigris of flowing water. All these streams go from the throne to the inner regions of Paradise, which get exhibited into this world also, though all these are polluted in this world with the poison of the unpalatable destruction. A mouthful from all these rivers was sprinkled by them upon the mud of Adam, which resulted in a great turmoil. This was done to enable his children to go into the search of their origin, but these incapables remained satisfied with what they already got. Stream of milk was provided in the mother’s breast to feed babies making every women as a fountain of milk. In order the eliminate anger and worries a stream of wine was flowed from the grapes of the vineyards. Honey is a medicine for the sick and the bee’s inside was made into a fountain of honey. And water provided for the roots and branches of trees, and for common man for drinking and cleaning. All these were provided to you to find out their origin, but you remained foolishly contented with them.

Now, you may hear about the affairs of the heap of mud (earth) as to what it said to Israafiil, the one who put her into action. It became bitter faced before Israafiil making hundreds of designs of flattery by swearing upon the name of God. “In the name of the Absolute Holiness of God, do not consider this cruelty as permissible upon me. I am getting hints of the loops being around my neck. My mind has started sufferers. You are the angel of mercy and exhibitor of mercy. You are like the bird Huma that does not harm anyone, but feeds upon dry bones. You are the medicine and relief for the sufferings. You may do only that which the other two angels did who had come earlier to you.”

Israafiil returned to God and sought His pardon and narrated what all that happened, and said: “On one side, You directed me to bring mud and at the same time You put into my heart to have pity of the earth’s pleadings. You gave a command to my ear and advised my wisdom not to be harsh.”
God’s mercy has no limits and is uncountable. He is wise, generous and benevolent. His mercy is dominant upon His wrath. He is the initiator of strange and good acts.

chapters.title: Izraa’iil Does the Job
chapters.subtitle: God’s sending of Izraa’iil, the one with strong determination and smartness to get a handful of mud to make H. Adam’s body, with wisdom and ability to do right work. And H. Izraa’iil’s not responding to the earth’s pleadings and cries

paras: God told H. Izraa’iil to go fast and look at the earth full of so many thoughts. “Go to that old, weak cruel woman and lift a handful of mud from her and come back soon”. Izraa’iil the soldier of death left to meet the demand toward the sphere of mud. As usual, earth started her lamentations and swore before him and of so many other swearings. She said: “O special servant of God and bearer of the Throne, and the leader, and the one obeyed by everything in the heavens and earth! Go away for the sake of that Unique master of benevolence and mercy. Go away for the sake of One who is so Benevolent to You, for the sake of that King none other than whom is worthy of worship. In whose court nobody’s sighs and cries are rejected. In consideration of the rights, we have upon that Rightful Authority, leave me alone! You are the one to have got innumerable grants from the Absolute Truth.”
H. Izraa’iil said: “With all your spells and pleadings, I am not the one to turn my face from the apparent and hidden commands of God.”

The earth said: “See that God has given the command and also told you to be kind and considerate. Both these commands are before you and you may adopt one of them according to your learning and knowledge.”

sections.heading: Troubles from God, Contain Good
paras: H. Izraa’iil said: Such a thing would be interpretation or speculation. Do not try to create doubts in a clear and direct command. It is better, on the contrary, to interpret your own thoughts as against interpretation of the doubtless, clear matters. Your flattery is setting fire in my heart. Your tears are filling my chest with blood. I am not merciless in comparison with the three angels who had come earlier to me. Rather, I am clearer than any of them. O suffering one, I feel more pity for you. If I give a slap on an orphan’s face, and some kind person gives him sweets, my slap may be considered as better than that sweet. The orphan’s getting cheated by that sweet will be regrettable for him. My liver is burning upon your grievances, but God is giving me a lesson to be oppressive, as within His oppressions, benevolences are hidden. There are precious gems hidden along with pebbles. God’s wrath is better than a hundred kindnesses from me. Trying to save life from God is troublesome like drawing soul out of the body. The worst of His wrath is better that the kindness of both the worlds. Whatever given by the Lord of the worlds is better than any kind of support from others. Many benefits are hidden within His wraths. Giving your life to Him increases your lifetime. Therefore, give up your bad suspicions and misguidance. Convert your head into your feet and go over to His callings. His callings will take you to higher levels. They will provide you with pleasure, companions and soft beds. I cannot loosen or strengthen His lofty command even to the slightest extent.”

The lowly earth did not care for all these words. Her suspicions had created obstacles in her ears. Thereafter, the lowly earth resorted to another way of flattery by way of prostrations like a semi-unconscious.

sections.heading: No Escape from Obedience
paras: Then H. Izraa’iil said: “Get up! There will be no loss of any kind for you. I pledge my head and soul and bail you out. Do not think in a perverted manner and do not resort to flattery to anyone, other than to the Just and Merciful One. I am a slave of the commands. I cannot ignore the commands of the One who raised dust from the sea. I shall not hear of any good or bad thing from anybody else other than that Creator of ears, eyes and head. My ears are deaf to the words of anyone else other than Him. His command is better than my sweet life. Life comes from Him and not that He comes out of life. He provides life lakhs free of cost. What is the worth of life that I should prefer it to that Generous One? What is a flea’s worth that I should set fire to my blanket to get rid of it? I do not know of anything good other than the one from Him. I am deaf, dumb, and blind to all others than Him. My ears are deaf to the cries of the criers, and for their sake, His command cannot be ignored, as I am like a spear in His hand. He only operates the spear.

chapters.title: Look at the Hand: Not the Tool
chapters.subtitle: To Explain that: when you are troubled by the people, they are only tools, A well-knowing person is one who turns toward God and not toward the tools. And, if he turns toward the tools, it is only to show with full knowledge and not out of ignorance but with a well-intentioned purpose. This is like the saying of H. Baayazid (may his secrets be holy): for many years I did not talk to the people nor heard from them, but the people thought that I talk to them and hear them, as they did not see that Great addressee. They are like the echo in my view. A wise man does not cast his attention upon the echo as there is a fine saying: the wall told the nail: “why do you tear me?” And the nail said: “Look at the one who is striking me”

sections.heading: Only Tools of God
paras: Izraa’iil continued to speak to earth: Do not be foolish and get cheated by expecting mercy from a spear. If God tells you to go into the mouth of a python, do so. Do not search for mercy from the sword’s blade but seek from him in whose hand the sword is. Why do you flatter the spear and sword, as they are in the hands of that Great One? He is like Aazar, (H. Ibrahim’s father) in making idols and I am like an idol. I become any tool that He makes. If He makes me a cup, I become a cup; and if He makes me a dagger, I become so. If He makes me a fountain, I flow water and if He makes me fire, I spread heat. If He makes me rain, I create harvests and if He makes me an arrow, I pierce into the body. If He makes me a snake, I spill poison and if He befriends me, I become kind to others. If He makes me sugar, I become sweet; and if He makes me aloe, I become bitter. If He makes me a devil, I become arrogant; and if He makes me hot, I become fire. I am like a pen in His fingers, and I never hesitate to render service to Him.”

With all this talk, H. Izraa’iil kept earth engaged and lifted a handful of mud from the heap of the ancient mud of earth. He flew with mud like a tricking magician, when earth was semi-unconscious due to his talks. He took the foolish mud to God just as a runaway boy is taken into the school.

sections.heading: Appointed as Angel of Death
paras: God told him: “I swear upon my bright knowledge. I appoint you as an executioner to carry on the sentence of death upon the people”. He said: “ My Lord, people will consider me as an enemy, when I choke the throats of the people. O Great Lord! Do You think it reasonable to make me hateful with an inimical face by the people?”

God said: “I shall impose causes of death upon them by way of fever, intestinal disorder, epilepsy, lost breath, choking of breath, loose motions, thirst, breakage of bones, tuberculosis, physical injuries, pneumonia, snake bite and heart attack, so that their attention is misdirected from you toward diseases and multifarious causes.”

H. Izraa’iil said: “My Lord, there are yet many bondsmen of yours, who tear off the causes and go beyond them. Their eyes would go beyond visible causes with Your graces upon them. They apply the eye-black of unity with you, who are beyond the impacts of causes and also never bother about causes. They do not look at fever, intestinal disorder and breakage of bones. They do not allow these reasons to penetrate into their hearts. This is because, for every sickness, there is a medicine. If the sicknesses do not receive the impacts of medicine, the result is taken as God’s job.”

sections.heading: Every Sickness Has a Medicine
paras: Be sure that every sickness has a medicine. The Prophet has said so: Likulli daa’in dawaa’un. This is like a leather coat for the trouble caused by cold. But when God wants that man should shiver, coldness will pass through hundreds of leather coats. If creates such shivering in the body which cannot be reduced by fire or smoke. It creates such coolness in the body which cannot be prevented by warm clothes and fire. When death comes and knocks, the physician becomes a fool. His prescriptions fail to cause any relief and cure.

Nothing remains hidden from the eyes of a man with insight, but the dullards continue to engage themselves in ignorance. Perfect eyes look at the root of things; but one with squint eyes sees shoots and branches.

chapters.title: Izraa’iil Hidden Behind Causes
chapters.subtitle: God’s answer to Izraa’iil: the eyesight that does not fall on causes, diseases and wounds inflicted by the sword, will not fall upon you also; because you are more hidden than these causes. It is possible that this may not be hidden from the sickman because We are nearer to him than you, but you do not see: Nahnu aqrabu ilaihi minkum wallakin laa tubsiruuna: (Waqi‘a: 56: 89

sections.heading: Those with Deep Sight Welcome Death
paras: God said: “One who sees the source of actions, may not see you in between. Though you hide yourself from the common people, but for those with bright inner sight, you are only a curtain. They see the causer of actions. For them death is sweet like sugar, because their eyes are intoxicated with the wealth of the next life. Death of the body is not bitter for them as they feel that they come out of the prison of the well into the spacious garden. One who gets released form the turns and twists of life, does not cry over the loss of this worthless place. A prisoner does not regret if the prison is pulled down by its guards, saying: “How regretful that a building made of fine marble is broken down. How great were these stones for the prison? Only that prisoner will feel, who is to be deprived of his life and soul on the scaffold. A prison is better for him than death. In his view those soft and fine stones would be friendly and suitable for the prison. The prison guard who pulls down the walls of the prison to make way for the escape of prisoners will be required to be punished by breaking his hands. Such a statement will not be made by any of the prisoner, excepting the one who is taken to the scaffold for execution. How can this breakage be disliked by a person who is taken away from poison of the snakes toward the sweetness of sugar? This is how the faithful feel. They are like those who are taken away from the troubles and callings of the body and relieved of them. Their soul moves with the feathers of heart and not with the feet of the body. They are like those prisoners in the well who get into sleep during night and see gardens in their dreams. They will say: “O God, do not keep us confined in the bodies so that we may go out and enjoy the pleasures and grandeur of the garden.” God will tell them: “your prayer is accepted. Do not go back. Remain here itself.” And God is aware of all right matters.

sections.heading: Sufferings Here for Pleasures There
paras: See, how pleasing are these dreams. A man goes into the paradise during lifetime itself, well before death. Can a body held up in a well regret upon waking up from sleep and losing the sight of those beautiful dreams? You are a faithful. Come into the ranks of the battlefield as a grand gathering is organized for you in the heavens. Stand up and wait on the way of hopes for going to the upper world before the niche for prayer, like the candle. Shed tears and burn like the candle with its head cut off, for the whole night to demand your share in the next world. Put an end to the activities of the lips and mouth to eat and drink in this world and go toward the dishes spread out for you in the heaven. Have your hopes upon the heaven every moment and always be in dance in the heavenly winds like the willow branches. Every moment water and heat reach you from the heaven which would increase your food and needs.

sections.heading: Heaven: Place of Residence for Soul
paras: It is not strange that you are dragged toward the heaven. Do not think that you are being dragged because of your weakness. Think of your demands that you will meet there. This sense of demand in you is a gift from God as everyone has a demand to meet something of importance for him. By creating a demand for God in you, God has already kept something ready for you to meet your demand. Try to increase this demand, so that your heart may come out of the well of your body. In such a case, when you die, people will say that you died but you will say: “no, no, you are uninformed fellows! I am not dead but living”. You will tell them: “My body is lying alone like a person in sleep, but eight paradises have come into my heart with all pleasing things. What harm is there for the soul when the body is lying in dung and the soul is sleeping in the midst of fragrant flowers. Such soul in sleep does not bother about the body whether it is lying in a garden or in a furnace. The soul announces in pleasure from a cool place, of paradise: “Ah me! Would that my people knew (what I know): Yaa laita qawmsii ya ‘lamuuna: (Yasiin: 36: 26). If it is not true that the soul cannot exist without the body, you will have to ask, of what thing is the heaven made as a place of residence? If your soul cannot exist without the body, then for whose purpose is the sustenance provided in the heaven. As stated in the Quran: And in heaven is your sustenance: wa fissamag ‘I rizqukum: (Zariyat: 51: 22).

[“Sustenance”, here as elsewhere, includes physical sustenance, as well as spiritual sustenance. Similarly, heaven or sky has both the physical and spiritual meaning. The physical sustenance grows from rain from sky: the spiritual sustenance comes from divine aid, grace, and mercy and includes the good news and the warning which come from Revelation about the Hereafter — Abdullah Yusuf Ali: The Holy Quran: pg. 1423]

chapters.title: Food for Stomach and for Thought
chapters.subtitle: To Explain the unsuitability of fat and sweets of the world and their coming in the way of the food from God, as has been stated: Hunger leads to food from God with which the bodies of the truthful sustain. O hungry man, God, the Magnificent and Grand, provides the food; as has been stated by the Prophet: I spend my night with God and He feeds me and provides drink. And God has said: they are provided with sustenance. They rejoice in the bounty: Yurzaquuna, farihiina: (Al-Imran: 3: 169-170)

paras: Protect yourself from the lowly, weight-causing-food so that you may get the tasty food of nobility. Even if you take thousands of measures of this food of nobility, you will not become heavy in weight and continue to be weightless and fast moving like the fairy. This food will not cause gas and pain in your intestines, nor any stomachache.

sections.heading: Eating and Its Effects
paras: As regards the heavy fat food; if you eat less, you will continue to be hungry like the crow. If you eat more, it will cause belching so as to cause heaviness of brain. Eating less results in impatience, dryness and weakness, but eating much causes indigestion and loose motions of the body.

Reasonable intake of food as if from God, neither less nor more, creates pleasing situation as though you are sailing on a boat. While fasting, you will have patience, and expectation of food providable by God; as God is the hearer of all slow and loud callings and provides grants to those who wait for them. A well-fed man does not care for bread, whether it comes sooner or later. A destitute is always in search of food to meet the demand of his hunger.

sections.heading: Food for Soul
paras: Whether you are well-fed or not, you should always be in wait for the spiritual food, in which case, you will get seventy times of what you need. Therefore, be an impatient, waiting for the food from the heaven, but with constant courage and hope. Every hungry person, ultimately gets his food, be it for the stomach or the soul. The sun will shed its light upon him. It depends upon how you resort to feeding yourself. When a guest eats a little with pleasure and satisfaction, the host provides more and insists upon him to eat more, excepting a poor mean host. But your Provider (God) is generous; and do not have any suspicion upon Him. Keep your head aloft like a hill, as it is upon the hilltop that the sun sheds it light first. The top of the hill always remains in wait for the morning sun’s light. The food from heaven is of very high quality as against the food of this lowly world.

chapters.title: Death, a Boon for the Righteous
chapters.subtitle: In reply to the dullard who said: How good this world would have been, had there been no death; and how happy the world would have been if it had no decline; and similar senseless talks

paras: One foolish fellow said: “This would have been full of happiness, had there been no feet of death in it.” Another said: “Had there been no death at all, the world would not have been of a scrap’s worth. It would have been a crop grown in a forest; useless, uncleaned and discarded.”

sections.heading: Death, Not an End
paras: You consider death as the end of life, because you have sowed your seed in an unfertile land. Death is only a turning point, and it takes life to another side. Your perverted wisdom sees things in a perverse manner. It is madness to consider death as the end of life. I pray to God to show things in their reality, as immature wisdom shows things in an obverse manner. No dead man ever feels sorry of death. His feels sorry of his deficiencies of things required after death as possessions for the next life. One who leads a pious life feels that he was in a narrow well and has now entered into an open field of wealth, luxury and happiness. He has come out of a place of sorrows and narrow sheds and entered into a wide-open field. This is a place of truth and not a palace of lies. There is euphoria of special wine and not the dullness of buttermilk. He sits in a place of truth along with God after getting rid of the furnace of the world of mud and water. This is what has been said in the Quran: As to the righteous, they will be in the midst of gardens and rivers, in an assembly of Truth, in the presence of a sovereign Omnipotent: Innal muttaziina jannaatin wa nahar, fii maq ‘ada sidqin ‘inda maliikin muqtadir: (Qamar: 54: 54-55).
On the contrary, if you have not spent a righteous, shining life so far, a few breaths are still remaining with you. You may be a bold person to make use of them, even now.

chapters.title: God Grants When All Hopes Are Lost
chapters.subtitle: To explain about the hope for God’s mercy, Who gives His grants, well before entitlement, as stated in the Quran: He is the one that sends down rain (even) after (men) have given up all hope: wa huwallazii yunazzilul ghaith(s)aa mim ba ‘adi maa qanatu. (Shuuaa: 42: 28). There are many far off things, which result in nearness. And there are many sins, which become righteous, from which come about many prosperities as against expected punishments. This is for them to know that God will change their evil with good: yaubadiila sayyiiaatihim hasanaat (Furqan: 25: 70).

paras: It is has come in hadith(s) that on the doomsday every physical body will be ordered to get up. Blowing of the bugle will be upon God’s command telling: “O ants, raise your head, from out of mud.” Life will come back to every dead body just as waking up of everybody in the morning, when every soul identifies its particular body and enters into it in all brightness. Each soul will find out its body and enter into it. The soul of a goldsmith cannot go to a tailor. Soul of a scholar goes toward the scholar and of a tyrant toward the tyrant. This is for the reason that God has given to each soul the capacity to identify its body, just as a lamb identifies its mother, in the morning. Each foot of a man recognizes its shoe in darkness. When such is the case my dear, how can the soul remain without identifying its body?

sections.heading: Each Morning Is a Minor Doomsday
paras: You may know, O seeker of refuge, morning is like a minor doomsday, and you may consider the major doomsday in similar manner. Just as the soul flies toward the mud of the body, the record of each man’s acts also comes to him flying from his right and from his left. Records of his generosity and miserliness, of his good and bad acts which he had followed as per his usual habit will be given over to him. This is just like his recalling to his mind of the previous day’s acts and thoughts in the morning when he wakes up from sleep. If he had worked hard and rectified his habits, its result will also come before him upon his getting up. If he had been immature, vicious and unguided on the previous day, the record of his black deeds will find a place in his left hand. If he had been clean, virtuous and faithful earlier, he will find the record of these good deeds in his right hand. Our sleeping and waking up are two evidences of the happening of the doomsday.

sections.heading: Records of Good and Bad Acts
paras: Minor doomsday of the morning after waking up shows to us the affairs of the major doomsday. Sleep is a minor death and waking up is a minor doomsday. Death is a major sleep and doomsday is a major waking up. The record of acts is like the thoughts and memory as a mental process, hidden from sight; and these will be visible on the doomsday. This thought process is hidden here, but its impacts will assume physical shapes there. Like the ideas of an engineer for the construction of a house in his mind. They are hidden in his mind just as a seed in earth. These ideas of the engineer come out in the form of physical buildings just as plants sprout from the seed. Any thought that remains settled in the heart will come out in a physical form on the doomsday, just as the ideas of the engineer, or the plant sprouting from the earth that has accepted the seed within itself. I have narrated about these two doomsdays in the form of a story, but the faithful consider it as a part of their faith.

sections.heading: Each Morning Is a Minor Doomsday
paras: When the sun rises on the doomsday, all good and bad men will get up from out of mud. All will run toward the court of justice and the metal of their good and bad acts put into furnace. The metal of the good ones will make them joyous and proud, and the metal of vicious will start melting and they will be in anxieties and fears. There will be trails moment by moment and the secrets of their hearts will be visible from their bodies, just as the contents of a lamp whether they are oil or water. Or like the earth which grows and shows plants upon it. There will be plants of onion, saffron and poppy as in a spring season that stand erect on the earth, declaring that they are fresh due to their piety. And there will be those with bowed head like the violet flower, and the creepers attached to earth. Eyes will protrude outside due to fear spreading out ten times their size looking in anxiety waiting to see that the record of deeds may not reach from the left side. Eyes will be turning around toward the left and right to see that the weight of the record of the right side may not be lesser. Eyes turn on the right and left to see that the fate of the record may not give a shock.

sections.heading: Record of Evil Acts
paras: A record will reach the hand of one, which is black with crimes and sins. There is not a single good act or inclination toward good. It contains of the injuries caused to a heart of faithful person obedient to God. From this end to that end, it is full of vices and sins and the acts of making fun of the noble persons and clapping at them with ridicule. Nothing other than the acts of treacheries, thieveries, arrogance and self esteem like those of the Pharaoh. When that fellow reads his record, he feels assured the only way for him is toward the prison, and that he will be sent to the scaffold to be hanged like dacoits. The crime is well established and there is no scope for pardon. All the thousands of his arguments and persuasive words are struck like nails upon his mouth. The Quran says: That day shall We set a seal of their mouths. But their hands will speak to us. And their feet bear witness to all they did: Alyawma nakhtimu ‘alaa afwathihim wa tukallimin aydiihim wa tashhadu arjuluhum bimaa kaanu yaksibuuna: (Yaasiin: 36: 65).

sections.heading: Hesitation to March Towards Hell
paras: Stolen articles as found out on his person and in his house have established the crime of theft. There is no need for further proof. He will be made to march toward the prison of hell as there is no other place for thorns. The angels appointed for him, who were hidden from him on his front and back, appear like the police officers before him. They will take him to be put into torture saying: “O dog! Get into the filth of your own.” He will drag his feet back at every step on the way feeling that perhaps he may jump away from the deep well. He halts to wait in silence and turns behind in fond hopes. He sheds tears like the rain of the autumn season which yields no results. What else other than a dry hope can he have? Every now and then he looks behind to the holy Court of God.

Then a voice from that great continent of light will come: “Tell that empty-handed naked denier! What are you waiting for, O mine of mischiefs! What do you turn back to see, you senseless fellow! Your records of acts is the same which you have in your hand. You are on enemy of God and worshipper of devil. When you have seen your own record of acts, do not look behind now, and look toward the reward for your acts. Why do you exhibit senseless hesitations! What hope of light can you have in this dark well. You do not have any record of visible acts of obedience, nor of any hidden good intentions. Neither you have done any acts of worship and meditation during the night, nor you did any act of piety and fasting during the day. Neither you have controlled your tongue to avoid injuring any one by mouth, nor you have seen behind and in front of you to take lessons. The lessons from the front were the oncoming death of yours and consequent troubles. And lessons from behind were the deaths of your friends who have met death earlier to you. You have not repented and taken long sighs for the sins committed by you. You have been treacherous like a seller of millet in the name of wheat. When the balance of your acts has been faulty and treacherous, how can you expect the balance of good rewards to be just and proper. When you are a man of a crooked body, you cannot expect a straight shadow. Your shadow also will be crooked. O fellow with a crooked body, your shadow also is crooked.
Many such harsh addresses will come to him, which would make even a straight mountain a hunchback.

sections.heading: Expectations of the Sinful
paras: The sinful bondsman of God will say: “I am a hundred times more than what all You have said to me. Yes, I am a hundred times more than a hundred times and further hundred times. Out of Your Own Grace, You have kept hidden many other worse crimes, as you are aware of with your own knowledge of my disgraceful acts better than what these records reveal. By keeping aside my efforts and my acts, virtues and vices, rejection of faith and religion, my own humbleness and expectations, or other hundreds of my thoughts and speculations of not only myself but also of hundreds like me, I have hopes only upon Your mercy and benevolence whether they are for my good or rebellious life. I have full hope upon Your selfless generosity and grant and grace not as a reward for good acts but as unrelated, absolute grace. I turn my face toward You only in expectation of Your grace. I am not looking at my acts. I turn my face toward You as it were You who initially brought me into existence which itself is a very great grant. You have given me the dress of life without any price whatsoever. I have always been keeping my hope on that grant.”

sections.heading: God’s Mercy Responds
paras: When that sinful man would count all his sins, God’s absolute, holy generosity will start its activity by telling: “O angels, bring him back to Us as his eyes and heart are full of expectations from Us. We have no care for anything. We shall set him free. We shall draw a line of pardon on the list of all his sins. It is permissible for everyone who is careless and unconcerned about anybody’s good or bad. We shall create a pleasant fire of grants, so that there may be no sign of few or more crimes and faults. A fire, a little spark of which would burn out every wrong whether it is a product of fate or free will. We shall set fire to those dwellings of human beings which bring about sins and wrongs. We shall convert thorns into spiritual gardens. We have already sent this declaration from the ninth heaven as the formula of reformation of the bad acts. We have said in the Quran: “O you who believe! Fear God and (always) say a word directed to the right: that He may make your conduct whole and sound and forgive you for your sins: Ya ayyu allaziina aamanuuttaqa llaaha wa quuluu qawlan sadiidan yuslih lakum a ‘maalakum wa yaghfirlakum zunuubakum: (Ahzaab: 33: 70).

sections.heading: Man’s Responsobility of Acts
paras: What is the grandeur and glory of the authority of H. Adam, the father of humanity before the permanent light of God? [What men do is an exposition of the names and attributes of God, put as a light into them. It is God alone who does everything. But as these occur in accordance with the intentions of man, they get qualified as good and bad. When God, with His grace, wipes out the intention and authority of man in this regard, His light becomes manifest, and the acts cease to be good or bad. — Qazi Sajjad Hussain.]

A piece of flesh (tongue) of man is an instrument of talking for him. A piece of fat of the eye is an instrument to see for him. Two pieces of soft bones are his instruments to hear. To drops of blood of heart are the instrument for his cognition and knowledge. This is all the worth and value and reality of man. All these are instruments of God for His own purpose but, temporarily given to you for partial use. Otherwise, you are a worthless worm full of filth, but with these temporary and partial grants you have created a hullabaloo in the world. You are created out of filthy semen. Remember this and give up your self-projection, pride and ego. O Ayaz! Do remember that old torne leather coat of yours!

chapters.title: Do Not Forget Humble Beginning
chapters.subtitle: Narrative of Ayaz, who had kept a room for his old torne leather coat and sandals; and the suspicion of his Companions that he has kept a treasure in it, well protected with the strong lock; and his frequent visits to it

paras: [Ayaz was a slave of Sultan Mahmood of Ghazni, who gradually got elevated to higher levels and finally became the sultan’s most beloved minister. Inspite of reaching that high level, he did not forget his lowly beginning. He is considered as a model of sincerity, faithfulness, honesty and obedience in Farsi literature — Translator]

That Ayaz was a man of extraordinary wisdom. He had kept hanging his old, torne leather coat and sandals in a separate room where he went every day to remind himself to say: “These are you lowly sandals, worn by the wild tribes. Do not forget them after your going to high state.” The other ministers told the king: “He has a special room, where he has kept gold, silver and pots full of gems. He does not allow anyone to enter into it, and always keeps its doors shut.”

The king felt surprised as to what made the slave to keep anything hidden from him. Then he directed a minister to unlock and go into that room at midnight. Whatever you get there is your prize money and reveal his secrets to your colleagues. Inspite of so many of our grants and graces, he keeps gold and silver hidden from us in his meanness! He exhibits his love, sincerity and enthusiasm for us, yet he is a seller of millet in the name of wheat. Whoever gets a life in love, will consider anything other than the slavery of love as infidelity.”

The minister decided to open that room along with his thirty confidents at midnight. These brave men took torches in their hands and went toward the room in all pleasure as the king has ordered to loot whatever found in that room, thinking that each one of them could take a bag of gold. One was telling: “What is the worth of gold? Speak of rubies, pearls and Yemani gems. He is the closest to the king and chief of the treasury. Rather, he is so close to the king as though his life and soul. What value do rubies, yaqoots (multicolored gems), and emeralds and other gems have before a beloved.”

The king did not have any suspicion on Ayaz but was only making a trial for fun. He considered him to be clean of all defects and tricks. He considered any doubts about his honesty as heart shaking, fearing that Ayaz might feel sorry at that. He was not willing to put him in embarrassment. He did not think that Ayaz would have committed the alleged acts. And even if he were to do so, it was alright for him as he was his beloved and being so, he was entitled to do whatever he wanted.

sections.heading: Ayaz Was Beyond All Suspicions
paras: He thought: “Whatever my beloved does is what I myself do. He is me and I am he, even if I am hidden behind a curtain. What is alleged is beyond his character and conduct. Such suspicions about him are mere misgivings and imaginations. It is impossible and far far away from him, as he is an ocean which has no bottom.

“All the seven oceans are within his single drop. All living things are a particle of his love. All oceans receive cleanliness from him. Each drop of him is a maker of clean glass. He is an emperor, rather a maker of emperors. In order to protect him from the spell of vicious eyes, he is named as Ayaz. He is so good that even good eyes are vicious for him because of his honor and modesty as his beauty is limitless. I need a mouth as wide and large as the sky in order to praise him of whom the angels are envious. Even if I get such a mouth, rather such hundreds of mouths, they will fail to explain about his honesty.

“Be sure my believer, if I do not make such praises of my beloved, the glass of my heart will shatter into pieces because of my love for him. As the glass of the heart is very fragile, I tear off many shirts to give solace to it. [Lovers tear off their shirts to control the pangs of their hearts thinking, as otherwise the hearts would burst. Some cooling effect has to be given to it.]

sections.heading: Madness of Love
paras: “My beloved! You may know that I go mad on the first three days of the month, there is no doubt in this madness of mine. [First three days of the month have this significance. Hajjaj bin Yusuf, governor of Iraq once asked a shepherd about his opinion about Hajjaj. Not knowing him to be Hajjaj, the shepherd cursed him for his cruelties. When Hajjaj told him that he was Hajjaj, the shepherd instantly said that he was mad, and his madness becomes much more on the first three days of the month and that day was the first day. His wisdom pleased Hajjaj and he gave a grant to the shepherd —Qazi Sajjad Hussain].

“Be sure today is the first of these three days. It is a day of success; rather it is a gem. One who is in love with this king(Ayaz) has his entire time as the first day of the month, a day of madness.”

chapters.title: A Hint Sufficient for the Wise
chapters.subtitle: To explain that whatever stated is the apparent aspect of the story which is fit for the seers of the apparent and their mirror; and I feel ashamed of narrating its hidden intricacies which would spoil my head, beard and pen. A hint is sufficient for the wise

paras: The narrative of Mahmood with the character of Ayaz has gone out of synchronization, as I have gone mad. I have become like an elephant which sees India in its dream as it originally belongs to it. Therefore, give up hope of any system in what I say just as any revenue cannot be expected from a ruined village. How can I get a poem with syllables, when the base of my peace is disturbed? I do not have just one madness because of my disturbed mind, but I have a madness within madness within madness. My body has melted down because of its refences to so many connections ever since I got the taste of existence in annihilation.

sections.heading: Love Cannot Be Explained
paras: O Ayaz! I have turned thin like a hair in your love. I am no more capable of narrating my affairs. Now, you may take charge of this narration. I have read the story of your love with all enthusiasm, because of which I have myself become a story. Now, you may read me or my story. You are the one obeyed and heard by others, but you have now to read for yourself. I am like the mount Tuur, and you are like H. Musa with the sound and its echo. What can the poor mount know about the discussion that H. Musa had as it has no capacity to hear and talk. But you as Musa understand the discussion, but not the helpless mount. Yet do not think that the mount of mine does not know at all. It understands a little as a body can, as per its capacity, but my spirit knows everything.

sections.heading: Body, an Astrolabe for Love
paras: Body is a measure of knowing the status of the soul. It is like an astrolabe for the soul. Through it, distances of sun and moon are calculated. The astronomer is in need of astrolabe, as he does not have piercing sight to see the distances. So also, one without piercing sight is in need of a person who can make an astrolabe for him, so as to know about the affairs of sun. He can know only about the distance of the sun but cannot know about the worth and value of sun and the heavens. When you see things through the astrolabe of your eyes, you are certainly incapable of seeing the inner, hidden realities. You see the world only according to the limitations of the eyes, but not its realities. Do not be proud of what limited knowledge you have about it. Those gnostics who have seen the hidden inner aspects have an eyeblack which would make your narrow stream into eyes wide and large like the ocean.

sections.heading: Senselessness Before Beloved
paras: As for me, if I were to have even a little wisdom and sense, I would explain everything clearly. But I have lost these and therefore, I am talking like a mad man. I am not at fault for incoherent talk as I have lost my wisdom, mind and sense. So also, that the beloved of mine is not at fault who has taken away my wisdom because, that is his greatness that every wise man loses his wisdom before him. O the one causing bewilderment to wisdom and putting the sense in turmoil! There is no hopeful place for wisdom other than you. Ever since you have maddened me, I have never desired for wisdom. Ever since you have decorated me, I have not felt jealousy for beauty. Rather, my madness is stronger in you love. Give recognition to what all I have said and pray to God to give a reward to me.

What all the beloved tells is actually what the lover tells, whether he tells in Arabic or in Persian. It is just for hearing his voice and not to enter into its meanings. The wine provided by the beloved is not worthy to be drunk by everyone. Everyone cannot put on the yoke of his slavery. Now, once again the spell of madness is falling on me Go soon to bring a chain to control my madness. But this chain should not be of iron but of your tassels, as I shall break and smash even two hundred iron chains. The feet of my love are already in shackles. Any sermon and advice will not have impact upon me. The story of love has no beginning and end. Its poem does not have its first verse and similar to it, it has no last verse.

chapters.title: Of What Is Man Created?
chapters.subtitle: Wisdom of looking at the sandals and torne coat by Ayaz, as has been said: so, let man consider of what he is created: Falyan zhuril insaana mimma khuliqa: (Tariq: 86: 5)

paras: Now, let us turn to the narrative of the love of Ayaz, as he is a treasury full of many secrets. Every day he used to enter into the room to look at his old torne leather coat and sandals. He felt that wealth brings about much recklessness, that wisdom goes away from head and modesty from the heart. Lakhs of years ago, excess of wealth had distracted the people from the right path who from that stage resorted to dacoity. It was with his intoxication of great status that Satan was misguided thinking: as to why Adam could be my leader. I am a leader, son of a leader. I have lakhs of abilities in me, and I can bring about lakhs. I am no less than anybody in my abilities. Then, how can I stand humbly before my competitor. I am created by fire, and he is created by slush. What is the status of slush before fire. Where was he in this world when I was presiding over the world and was its honour?

chapters.title: Satan Created from Fine Fire
chapters.subtitle: Explanation of the ayat: He created Jinns from fire free of smoke: (khalaqnal Jaanna min maarijin min naar (Al Rahmaan: 55: 15) and God’s statement in respect of Iblis, may curse be upon him: He was one of the jinns, and he broke the command of his lord: Kaana minal jinni fafasaqa ‘an amri Rabbihi: (Kahaf: 18: 50)

sections.heading: God Needs No Causes
paras: Fire of the worthless Satan was flaming high as he was born of fire; and a son is carrier of the secrets of the qualities of the father. Nay! I said wrong! He was the personified calamity of God! How can we attribute cause to Him? God’s work has no causes. It is not dependent upon causes. It is everlasting and prior to time or beginning settled from the very beginning itself (azal). There is no scope for a cause for the coming into existence of a new thing along with an already existing one, when the perfectness of the making without cause is already in action. What are the secrets of the father (H. Adam) when our father himself has been His creation? Act of making is the real pulp, and father is only a shape, being a product of making in the form of rind. One with a beautiful body should consider love as the pulp of life and not the body; and love alone as the friend, since love is the life of your soul which crushes your body which is like the rind. That is, love causes growth and freshness of the soul but crushes the body.

sections.heading: Body Burns, Not Soul
paras: One who befriends and takes care of body and skin belongs to hell as God says that He changes the skins. We shall soon cast into fire: as often as their skins are roasted through, we shall change them for fresh skins: sawfa nusliihim naaran. Kullamaa nudhijat juluuduhim baddalaahum juluudan ghairihaa: (Nisa: 4: 56). Meaning and pulp is a commander upon fire, but your bodies (rinds) are the fuel for fire. A vessel made of wood containing the water of the stream, when kept upon fire gets into the total control of fire. The reality of man, that is, the soul is a commander upon fire. Malik the in charge of hell cannot destroy the man’s reality (soul). Dry wood as a body is the fuel for fire but the soul of dry wood has command over fire. It does not get burnt. It is only the body of dry wood that is its fuel. Therefore, do not develop your body but develop its meaning (soul), so as to become a commander of fire like Malik, the in charge of hell. Instead of this, you go on adding skin upon skin; and therefore, you will burn and get converted into smoke like the rind. The food of fire is nothing but rind. Taking care of the body results in pride; and God’s dominance cuts off the neck of pride. Pride is a product of the body and therefore, it is in love with wealth and status.

sections.heading: Pride Related to External Qualities
paras: What is pride? It is discarding of the spirit and soul of things and development of body in the form which submits itself to the sun. When the sun shines upon it, it ceases to be ice. It becomes soft, hot and flows away fast. This is due to the discarding of the soul of coolness and submitting to hot sun. But when the spirit and soul of things are found out, body ceases to take interest in itself and becomes greedy in entirety, to go in for its spirit and soul. It falls in love with the spirit and soul, and stands before them in humble manner, as it is said that a greedy person becomes humble and degraded. When he does not see the pulp of things, he remains contented with the rind and this contentment holds him up within itself as the saying goes that contented person lives in a prison. Contentment keeps one bound within limits and is another kind of pride.

This is for this reason that pride due to the beautifying of the body is irreligious and humility in faith. So long as the rock of the body is not crushed, it will not shine just a stone shines upon rubbing, scratching and polishing. You are like rock and proud of strength, even though the time of your humility and annihilation is fast approaching.

Pride is in search of wealth and status for the reason that it is like a furnace and the furnace takes pride on the quantity of dried dung that it consumes. Greater the dung consumed, larger is the heat in the furnace. Wealth and status are like foster-mothers who develop flesh, skin and fat of the body and consequently increase pride and arrogance.

sections.heading: People Ignore Pulp
paras: People have not cast their looks upon the pulp of the pulp but only looked upon the rind and considered the rind itself as pulp. The leader in this path was Iblis, who became the first victim of status. Wealth is like a snake and status like a python. Company of godly persons is like the protection of emerald for them. This results in the injury of their eyes, and they become blind as is commonly believed. They become blind and the followers of the godly persons get protected. But this leader of this path, Iblis, has spread thorns on the way and whoever gets injured sends curses upon him. He says: “This trouble has come to me because of his treason.” He is the leader and guide of treason.

sections.heading: Initiator and Follower of Sins
paras: After him epochs upon epochs came and passed off, and everybody started following his practice. Whoever started a bad precedent becomes responsible for the sins of all those who blindly follow his path, because he was the head and others are the root of the tail. But H. Adam brought forward his torne coat and sandals and said: “I am made of mud”. This is what Ayaz also did: that looking at his torne coat and sandals was his daily ritual and inevitably, it had an appreciable result.

Self-denial provides a plain field for the workshop of creation. Non-existence and vacant space are absolutely required for things to come up. No one will write on an already written paper or plant a tree in a place where a tree already stands. The writer searches for a plain paper without any writing on it. A seed is sown in a place where another seed is not sown. Therefore, my brother, you should become an unsown place and a unwritten plain paper in order to be honored by the pen and ink-pot of nature and for the sowing of seed by the Master of Graces, God. Do not taste the sweet meat prepared in the kitchen and consider the kitchen as though not seen by you, As the sweet meet creates drowsiness; torne coat and sandals will go out of your memory. And you will think of them only when death knocks at your door, upon which you will take long sighs of regrets.

So long as you do not sink in the tide of a vice, you will not get a boat for your rescue. That is to say, you will see the realities only upon your complete destruction. You will not even think of the boat of truth. You will not see the torne coat and old sandals. When you get caught in the whirlpool of troubles, you will start repeatedly crying: “Ah, I was cruel to myself!” Then devil will say: “Look at this fool” He is like a cock that crows at the inappropriate time. Cut off its head.”!

This was not the conduct of Ayaz that he acted after the allotted time of his job passed off. His prayer was not devoid of humility and sincerity. He was a cock of the heaven from the beginning itself. All his callings were at the appropriate times.

chapters.title: Meanings of Statements and Verses
chapters.subtitle: To explain the meanings of the statements: show us the things as they are: (Imam Abu Hanifa). And: in such a manner that there should not be any increase of certainty if the curtains are removed: (Hazrat Ali). And meaning of the stanza: Anyone you look upon as bad is upon the shape of your own self; and of the verse: A crooked object casts a crooked shadow

paras: O cocks! You may learn crowing at the appropriate time from Ayaz as he crows for the sake of God and not for money. The false dawn appears, but it does not cheat those who are capable of knowing the good and bad for them. Worldy people have imperfect wisdom and so they misunderstand false dawn for true dawn. False dawn has destroyed those caravans who marched on the way hoping that the day has arrived. May not God make false dawn as a guide to anyone, which destroys the caravans.

One who holds the false dawn as a guide, should not consider the true dawn also as false and consider his own wrongs as the wrongs of others. You commit wrongs considering to be good. This is a form of hypocrisy; and therefore, you consider others to be wrong. A suspicious person is always vicious, and he reads his own record of vices as that of his mate. The non-believers of the days of all prophets were themselves vicious and therefore considered them as magicians and wicked.

Similarly, the ministers and leaders around Ayaz were wicked and suspected the room of Ayaz as a place where he has buried and hidden treasures. They should not have seen others in their own mirrors. The king was well aware of the sincerity of Ayaz but he ordered for searching of his room for their satisfaction. He told them: “O leaders! Open the door of his room at midnight as he would not come to know of it, so that his treacheries may be exposed, and I may give him the necessary punishment. I give over to you all the gold and gems found there. I do not want them. You may just inform me.”

He said this, but his heart was in turmoil for the sake of Ayaz, as a like of him does not exists in the world. He was thinking: “I am the one from whose mouth these trouble-giving words have come. What will he feel if he comes to know that I have said so?” Yet again another thought comes to him: “True to his faith: his status is so great as not to think ill of me and be unhappy with my thinking bad of him. He is not unaware of my purpose and object. A man in troubles does not feel the burden when he comes to know of the reasons. Ayaz is a good, patient interpreter and observer of the oceans of conclusions, like Yusuf, who considered the dreams of his co-prisoners. Their interpretations were very well understood by him. [One had seen himself to be carrying a basket full of bread upon which birds were falling and picking bread. He said: “This means that you will be hanged on the scaffold”. The other man said that he was crushing grapes. He told him that he would become a close servant to the king and his cupbearer. Both these dreams come true — Qazi Sajjad Hussain].

The king continued to think: when a man cannot interpret his own dream, he cannot interpret the dreams of others. Ayaz is so convinced of my concern for him that even if I hit him a hundred times with the sword as a test, he will not reduce his connections with me. He will feel that those strikings of the sword were upon my own body. The truth is: he is me and I am he.

chapters.title: Connections Between Opposites
chapters.subtitle: To explain that the lover and beloved are one with each other, even though they are the opposite of each other like the devout and devotee. A mirror is plain without a face, and facelessness is the opposite of face. Yet there is a unity between them. Its explanation is very long and wide. But a hint is enough for the wise

paras: Once Majnun fell sick due to the separation from his beloved resulting in excessive heat of blood caused by the flame of intensity of love, and his throat choked. The physician, to treat him said that the only treatment is by bloodletting with surgical incision into a vein. This is required to reduce blood; and an expert bloodletting surgeon was called. He tied his arm and held it before him for incision. Majun instantly cried out and told him to take his fee and not to open the vein. “Does not matter if I die. You may say an old body has gone.” The surgeon told him: “Why are you afraid of this, when you are not one to fear the lion in a thick forest. Lions, wolves, bears, jaguars and wild beasts go around you for the whole night. They do not feel any fragrance of man in you, because of the excessive love and sorrow you have in your liver. Wolves, bears, lions know what love is and one who has no love in him is worse than a dog.”

“But Qitmir, the dog of the companions of the cave is an exception. It had a vein of love, because of which it entered into the depths of the hearts of the companions. Those of his species are also physically dogs but they are not well known in the world. You did not get the fragrance of the heart of one of your species, and therefore you cannot get the fragrance of the heart of wolves and goats.

sections.heading: Love, the Cause of Existences
paras: “Had there been no love, nothing would have come into existence. Bread would not have been available to you, and you would not have been alive! Of what is your bread made? It is made of love and desire as otherwise bread would not have found its way into your life. It is love that gives life to the lifeless bread. It makes the decaying life to live forever.”

Majnun said: “I am not afraid of the pricks. My patience and tolerance are greater than the rocky mountain. I am a victim of pains. My body cannot rest without injuries. I am in love, and I roam about in search of injuries. But my body is filled up with Laila. My body is an oyster for the pearl like attributes of Laila. I fear that if you pierce my vein, it will instantly pierce Laila. The wisdom, which is brightened knows that there is no difference between me and Laila. Who am I? it is Laila! Who is Laila? It is me. We are two souls in one body.

chapters.title: Becoming One Like God or God Inhering in One
chapters.subtitle: A beloved asked her lover: you befriend yourself or me? He said: On my own I am dead and alive only through you. I do not exist, on my own with my qualities, I exist through you. I have forgotten all my knowledge and through your knowledge only, I know. I have destroyed all my authority and I have authority only through you. If I befriend myself, I befriend you. If I befriend you, I befriend myself. “Whoever has a mirror of certainty, though he sees himself, he sees God”. Go to My creatures with My qualities. Whoever sees you, sees Me. Whoever intends for you, intends for Me. Whoever loves you, loves Me. Consider everything on this basis

paras: In order to test him, a beloved asked her lover in the morning time: “You so and so, son of so and so, tell me, you proud fellow, whether you befriend me more or yourself. Tell me the truth, as I find you in great sorrows.”

sections.heading: Merger of Beloved in Lover
paras: He replied: “I have lost myself in you in such a way that from head to foot I am occupied by you. In me, there is nothing of mine in existence except the name. O fortunate one! There is nothing other than you in my existence. Due to this I have lost myself so much as vinegar that is lost in the ocean of your honey upon which I totally became honey. It is like a stone that has become pure ruby getting filled up with the qualities of sun. It loses all its stony character and gets filled up from front to back with the qualities of sun.
