Thereafter, if the stone loves itself, it is in fact, a love for the sun. and it is in fact, a love for the sun. And if it befriends the sun, it is certainly friendship with itself. Pure ruby, whether loves itself or loves the sun: in either case, there is no difference in love. On either side there is nothing but the light of sun.”

sections.heading: Loss of Identities
paras: So long as the stone does not become ruby, it is an enemy of the sun, because there is not one in this case, but there are two different entities. Because stone is dark, and darkness is the opposite of light. In such a case, if the stone loves itself, it is an infidel as it is a rejector of God the Greatest sun. Therefore, it is not proper for the stone to project its independent existence. It is personified darkness and is in the process of annihilation. For this reason, when a Pharaonic fellow says: “I am the Truth” (Anal Huqq) he makes himself lowly and the same saying of (anal Huqq) by Mansoor Hallaj is at elevated level. The former takes one backward step with the curses of God; and the latter is mercy and benevolence of God. This is because the former was a black stone, but the latter is a Yemeni ruby. That was an enemy of light, and this is a lover. This “I” (Anaa) in reality is “He” because of the mingling of His light in it (Ittihad), and that is identification with God and not due inherence (Huluul).

sections.heading: Explanation of Identification (Ittihad) and Inherence (Huluul)
paras: [The word ‘Ittihad’ is translated by different translators as identification (to consider as the same or equivalent), union, assimilation; and the word ‘Hulul’ as inherence (existing as inseparable part), indwelling (inhabit). Al ghazali (1058-1111), in his al-Maqsadal asnaa if sharh, asma Allah al husnaa, translated by David B. Burrel and Nazih Dahar as ‘Ninety-nine beautiful names of God’ (Islamic Text Society, Cambridge, 1995) considers inherence (Hulul), as that God inheres in man as invalid. Inherence between two bodies with their space is itself impossible. An accident can subsist on a substance; for example, a writing can subsist on paper. Paper and writing can be said to inhere. But two sheets of paper, which ore two different substances cannot inhere. Similarly, one man’s body cannot inhere into another man. Such being the case, there cannot be inherence between man and God.

sections.heading: Identification (Ittihad)
paras: So also identification, that one thing becomes another is also impossible. The saying: “this is identical with that” is a loose and figurative speech for enhancing the understanding as the poet says: “I am whom I desire and the one I desire is I”. This is to say: he is not immersed in concern for himself.

As Abu Yazid Bistami said: “I have sloughed off myself as the snake sloughs off its skin, and I looked and behold! I am He”. He meant to say: “I sloughed off the passions of my soul, desires and concerns, there is no room remaining for anything but God. So, when nothing remains in heart but God’s majesty and beauty, he gets immersed in them, he becomes as though “He were He’, but not as he actually is God. There is difference between our saying “as though he were He” and our saying “He is He”, just as the poet says: “I am the one I desire.” If there is no firm footing on rational things, looking upon the perfection of His essence, he will think that he is He (God) and say: “I am the Truth: (Anal Huqq) (as was told by Mansoor Hallaj).

This is like a child’s thinking of the image of a man in a mirror as man himself is in the mirror, or if it sees colors in it, as the colors of the mirror itself. Similarly, one not familiar with glass or wine upon looking a red wine in the glass does not notice the difference and say: there is no wine or it is only glass in red color.

sections.heading: Meaning of Subhannii Maa A’znam Sahhnii
paras: Similarly, Abu Yazid Bistami said: May I be praised, for how exalted is my nature (Subhaanii Ma A’zam Shaanii). There can be the following four interpretations of it.
It may be that he was overheard reciting the ayat of Quran: La illaha illaa anaa fa’ budni: (Taha: 20: 14).
Or he could have noticed the perfectness of his share in the attribute of holiness, imagined and sensed and spoke of his holiness, when he said so.
He might have compared his holiness with the rest of the people, with no relation to the holiness of God.
It might have been uttered in a state of inebriation and ecstasy, and after returning to the state of balance he was cautious.
This utterance by him cannot be taken in support of the claim of man’s identification with God. We should not regard the positions of the so highly to give credence to what is impossible.

sections.heading: Man’s Share in God
paras: Man’s share in God should be for him to become God-like, that is his heart and aspiration be taken up with God that he should not look towards anything other than Him nor pay attention to what He is not, neither implore nor fear anyone other than Him.

It might be said that words of the Sufi’s are based on versions revealed to them in a stage of friendship (tawr al wilaayea) and reason falls short of grasping that. This should not involve exercise of reason. However, anything not judged by reason cannot be accepted. For example, if a holy man hears that someone will die tomorrow, it may come true, as it is only foretelling of the event, and reason can accept it. But it is not possible to be revealed that God will create someone like Himself, as reason sees this as contrary, rather exceeding it or that he will create me like Himself, and more far-fetched that God would make me like Himself or make me become Himself, or make me a creator of heaven, or make me eternal. All these are exclusively His attributes. God could not reveal to a holy man that Shari ‘a is false, that He would change it, He could make all sayings of the prophets false. These matters are quite opposed to reason and cannot be revealed. Taken from pages 149-158: The ninety nine beautiful names of God — Translator]

sections.heading: Dullness to Brightness
paras: Therefore, put your efforts to reduce your stoniness, so that your stone may shine like a ruby. Have patience while putting these efforts and see immortality step by step in annihilation. Your stoniness will get reduced every moment and quality of the ruby will increase. Qualities of existence only for the sake of body will go away and the quality of inclination toward the inner aspect will increase. Therefore, you may become a personified ear to hear so that the earring of rubies may be put on your ear.

Become a bold man to dig earth to sink a well with the aid of this mud itself of which you are made so as to reach to water. This, you have to do now. If your attention toward God results in God’s absorption for you, even without sinking well, water will gush forth from the earth. However, go on doing the work and do not be lazy and dig out mud slowly to sink the well. This work of digging of the mud is actually a work to be attentive to God and become an ear to hear from Him. Whoever works hard gets wealth. Whoever persisted became fortunate. The noble Prophet has said: Prostrations and bowings in Salat are like the ringing of the chains of the door of God to seek the objectives. Wealth comes out to whoever that taps His door. [The contents of this caption require repeated reading and deep thinking to understand and digest. That is meditation — Translator]

chapters.title: Finding Nothing by Investigation
chapters.subtitle: Coming of the nobles of the king along with soldiers at midnight and opening of Ayaz’s room and seeing sandals and old coat hanging, and their thinking that it was treachery and hiding. Their digging at every corner of the room they suspected. Their further suspicion, and bringing well-diggers and putting holes in the walls and finding nothing and feeling ashamed and sorrowful. They felt ashamed just as those with false suspicions and thoughts about prophets and saints saying that they were magicians and imposters seeking greatness, and after investigation feeling ashamed which was of no use

paras: Those nobles came at the door of the room in search of gold and the earthen pot. They opened the lock in their madness for wealth along with two hundred soldiers and a few wise men. This was for the reason that the lock was very strong, complicated, well selected out of many, not for the protection of gold, silver and wealth out of miserliness, but for hiding the secret from the people, as some of them would have bad suspicions and some others would call him as treacherous.

sections.heading: Conflict of Wisdom and Greed
paras: Secrets of the soul of the strong people are more worthy of protection than the mines of rubies. Gold is more valuable than life in the view of fools but in the view of the kings of piety it is only a means of charity. Greed of these searchers was asking them to be fast, but their wisdom was telling them to be slow. Greed was making them run toward the mirage uselessly to seek water, but wisdom was telling them, to carefully see that there was no water. In this conflict, greed was victorious, and gold became precious like life and the voice of wisdom was ignored as greed convinced that this worthless thing, was most worthy. The voice of greed became hundred times louder and wisdom and its instructions were dominated by greed in order to make them fall into the well of misguidance, as it is the fate of those who do not hear the voice of wisdom. When self-imposed bonds of their net broke down with their greed, their accusing-self dominated over them to warn them of their misdeeds.

sections.heading: Futile Exercise
paras: So long as a man’s head does not dash against a wall, his deaf ear will not hear the advice of his heart. Greed of almonds, sweet dishes and sugar makes both the ears of the children deaf for good advice. When the sore starts giving pain, their ears open for advice.

With hundreds of greed’s and madnesses, they opened the door and entered as a crowd into the room just as insects fall into rotten butter milk with great expectations but cannot eat anything in it. Both of their wings get tied up in it. These people looked on their right and left side. They found in surprise only torne sandals and an old, leather coat. They said: “This place cannot be without honey. Sandals are here only as a ruse to confuse and misguide. Get sharp digging rods, dip up and look into the holes and the drains.”

They dug up everywhere and searched into deep holes and trenches. The holes and trenches told them: “O foolish fellows! We are empty moats.” Because of their suspicions, they were feeling ashamed. They filled up the moats. Then they started putting holes in the walls in their foolishness and ignorance. In every breast of theirs there was the voice of resentment of “La howla” (how regrettable). The bird of the greed was without grains. Pits and walls were the back biters of their foolish acts. There was no scope for the replastering of the walls. There was no possibility of denial of their acts before Ayaz. If they were to deny their sins, walls and the floor were witnesses against them. They were all anxious as to what excuse they had to plead, so as to get their souls out of this whirlpool. At last, with the loss of all hopes, they started beating their foreheads like women and returned before the king, with pale and shameful face full of dust.

chapters.title: Blackened Faces
chapters.subtitle: Return of the backbiters from the room of Ayaz toward the king with empty pouches in shame like the suspicious ones of the prophets upon the exposure of their innocence and purity as happens on the day when some faces will become fair and some faces black as stated in the Quran: On the day when some faces will be lit up with white, and some faces will be black: yawma tabyadhdhu wujuuhun: (Aal Imraan: 3: 106); and also: on the day of judgement will you see those who told lies against God: their faces will be turned black: wa yawmal qiyamati tarallazina kazabu ‘ala Allahi wujuhu hum muswaddatun: (Zumar: 39: 60)

paras: The king deliberately asked them: “What is the matter? Your armpits are empty of pouches and bags of gold! Even if you have kept hidden the asharifis and coins, your mouths and cheeks are without joy but in worries. Though the roots of a tree are hidden under ground, their leaves are green like faces of the noble ones as stated in the Quran: On their faces are their marks being the traces of their prostration: simaahum fi wijuuhihim min ath(s)aris sujuud: (Fath: 48: 29). The leaves of the tree make a loud call and declaration of all the sugar and poison that the roots have swallowed. Though roots themselves are devoid of leaves and wealth, how green are the leaves upon the trees? Mud puts a seal upon the mouth of the roots, but branches of the tress are like the hands and feet that stand up to give evidence.”

All the leaders sought pardon and became prostrators like the shadow before the moon forgetting their enthusiastic claims, self-praise and ego. They stood before the king with the sword and shroud in the hands just as the criminals do to say that they are prepared to take the punishment of death! They were biting their fingers out of shame. Every one of them was telling: “O king of the world! You are entitled to flow our blood. It is perfectly justified for you. If you forgive, it will be a great gift and reward. We have done what was worthy of our character. What do you order, O great king? O the brightener of the hearts, if you forgive us for our crime, it will be like your day doing its bright acts, and our dark night doing its dark nightly acts. If you forgive us, it is like narrow despair getting broadened in hope. Otherwise, hundreds like us are worthy of sacrificing their lives for the king.”
The king said: “I shall not give the reward or punishment. It is a privilege of Ayaz.”

chapters.title: Ayaz to Punish or Pardon
chapters.subtitle: Handing over of the backbiters and openers of the room to Ayaz for their punishment, disciplining and warning or accepting their excuses as those crimes were committed against him

paras: The king continued: “this sin is committed against the person and honor of Ayaz. The injury is inflicted upon the veins of his noble character. Though myself and he are a single entity in respect of our souls, but from the point of view of our loss and gain we are different. Any allegation made against a king’s servant does not affect the king’s honor. Yet, if the servant commits a wrong, he does so on the expectation of king’s forgivance. There is a possibility of the king’s forgiving of the offence and also of gracing and granting and making the offender rich, as his offence brings him nearer to the king. He gains some recognition (good or bad) from the king. But a non-committing person can never expect any of these things. Do not consider the king to be ignorant of anyone’s actions. He knows, but his own generosity and liberality are the only recommendations before him.

sections.heading: Boldness Due to Hope of Pardon
paras: Mistakes basically occur on the expectations of his sense of fair play as otherwise, no one dare do anything while keeping fear in view, just as one becomes bold to commit a murder in the confidence that the murdered person’s heirs may wave the crime by taking blood money. Initially, our manly sense was overdominated with our feelings of receiving pardon and forgievance resulting in lack of precaution, because of which Satan was bold enough to fool us. If God’s forgievance was not spilling over like the spilling of wine by the cub-bearer, Satan would not have been bold enough to contradict H. Adam. Adam’s knowledge was much more than that of the angels. He was a master of the knowledge of critical analysis of matters to decipher truth and falsehood. There was no scope for him to be misguided by Satan. As he had also drunk the wine of forgivance from God, he was forgetful in paradise, and was overtaken by Satan for the commission of the offence. He had learnt the lesson of God’s goodness that made him smart; wise and intelligent, but the opium of His forgievance and liberality stupefied him resulting in the thief’s commission of theft on His possessions. Then his wisdom came back to him to protect him from the hope of excessive forgievance telling him to behold it as it was initially from him but having been later ignored by him.

chapters.title: Retaliation and Forgievance
chapters.subtitle: King’s advice to Ayaz to choose between revenge and pardon because whether it is revenge or forgievance, both are proper in this case as there are a thousand benevolences in taking revenge as stated: And there is life for you in retaliation: wa lakum fil qisaasi hayaatun (Baqar: 2: 179). One who hates retaliation looks at the life of one murderer but not at the life of a lakh of innocent frightened people, who are safe in peace in the fort of protection caused by fear of punishment

paras: The King said: “O Ayaz! Render Justice to the criminals. You are clean with the effect of hundreds of pious acts that you have done. Even if I incite you two hundred times to do an act, I shall not find a single defect in the froth of your excitement. Many people are ashamed of the trials they have undergone. So also, these people are in shame. You are not just personified knowledge, but a bottomless ocean of knowledge. And you are not just knowledge, you are as well a mountain upon mountain of mildness.”

sections.heading: God’s Grants Are Samples
paras: Ayaz said: “I know all this, but it is all granted by you as otherwise I am just a pair of sandals and an old torne leather coat. It is for this reason that noble Prophet has said: “Whoever understands himself, understands God”. Sandals and old coat have been my beginning and, all the rest is your grant. The beginning of everyone is humble, with semen and menstruation blood is like coat. All the rest, my Lord; is God’s grant. This much is given by God to you so that you may ask for more. Do not think that He does not have anything more than this much. A gardener shows a few apples to make one know about the trees and the income from the garden. One gives a handful of wheat to a buyer to enable him to know about the quality of the lot. A teacher tells about a single point to you so as to make you know of the worth of knowledge and seek its increase. If you say: it is enough for me and the teacher has only this much, he will throw you, away from himself just as he throws a scrap of grass stuck in his beard.”

sections.heading: ‘No to Emphasize ‘Yes’
paras: The king said: “O Ayaz! Go forward now, and do justice and keep the foundation of a wonderful justice for the world to follow. Your criminals are worthy of being given punishment of death, but they are standing before you in the hope of your pardon and mildness, so as to see whether mercy dominates or wrath. The water of kauth(s)ar dominates over the flames of fire. Both these qualities are there to attract men with their branches right from the beginning, from the day of “Am I not? (Alastu). This is a word, with both positive and negative meanings mixed up in it. Its construction: “am I not”, actually means “I am”. That is, positive and negative are both found in one. It has a, interrogative dominant ‘yes’ dominating over ‘no’. Leave it at this. Let it remain at that. This is a dish for the elite. Do not keep it on the dining sheet of the commoners.

sections.heading: Opposites Exist Together
paras: Opposites also exist together, just as wrath and mercy, and fresh breeze and polluted air. One is a magnet that attracts iron, and another is a kahruba, (a leaf upon rubbing and warming attracts other grass). Truth attracts the rightful toward guidance; and untruth attracts the vicious toward misguidance. Stomach is desirous of sweets. It pulls sweets towards it, but a bilious attracts vinegar. A warm floor eliminates the chill of the one who sits upon it and a cold floor swallows his warmth. When you look at a friend, you look at him with kindness; and when you look at an enemy, wrath and efforts to dominate fall from you. This is so with fire and light. Looking at light brightens you, and in looking at fire coupled with smoke, you see darkness. Everything in the world goes along with its connections be it friend and enemy, light and fire, honor and disgrace, throne and scaffold, heat and cold, flower and thorn, ant and snake, weft and warp, songs and cries. You may take everything in this manner.

chapters.title: Great Worth of Inner Qualities
chapters.subtitle: King’s advice to Ayaz to pass the order soon, and not to keep them waiting; and not to say: “there are many days between us”, as waiting is a red death. And Ayaz’s reply thereto, expressing his inability

paras: The king continued: “O Ayaz! Complete this job sooner, as making one wait is also a kind of revenge.”

Ayaz said: “O king! All commands are from you only. Stars get lost in the presence of the sun. what is the worth of Venus, Mercury or a Meteor that they should come before the sun? Had I not gone beyond the level of wearing torne coat and sandals, I would not have sown the seed of condemnation by putting the lock on the door in the midst of a hundred thoughts of the jealous. They put their hands in the stream in search of a dry lump of mud. Every one of them is like this. How can there be a lump of dry mud in the river? How can the fish be disobedient to water? They had unnecessary suspicions upon a helpless fellow like me. I am such that honesty feels ashamed of me.”

sections.heading: Secrets Known After Great Efforts
paras: (The following is Rumi’s explanations)

Where I to be not worried about the incapable fellows? I would have said something about honesty. The people of the world look for doubtful and physical shapes; therefore, I talk only about the matters out of the rind. They have no capacity to go deep into the pulp. And, if you crush your outer body which is like the rind, you will become the pulp and hear about the subtle talks relating to it. As solid nuts, remain within the rind of apricot, they shake within it and create sounds. But their pulp and oil do not create any sound. Of course, they have the sound, but that is not capable of being heard by the ear. Their sound is hidden which can be heard by the ear of consciousness. Had there not been the sound in the pulp, there would have been no sound of the rind. It is the oil and pulp of the apricot seed that makes the sound audible to the ear with the aid of rind. You bear with the crackling sound of apricot to silently penetrate into the pulp.

Therefore, be one for sometime without the ear and lips and maintain silence and therefore befriend sounds sweet like honey that will out of your lips. You have talked very much of secrets in prose and poetry. Take a trial and test yourself by becoming deaf for a day. You have cooked many bitter, pungent, saltish, and sour dishes. For a day, you may cook a sweet dish as a trial. You have eaten many sweet and fatty dishes. Fast for a few days for a trial. You have been a prisoner of sleep for many nights, and you may remain awake for a night and collect the wealth that discarding of sleep gives. You have spent many days in fun and for gains for personal ends. Spend two days and try to be smart for other finer things.

chapters.title: Thinking Over in Silence
chapters.subtitle: A narrative to explain that we have tested discussions for so long. And we test the patience required for remaining silent for sometime

paras: [There is advice to think in silence about many matters. The same is stressed in the following lines]

On the day of judgement, a person happened to get the record of his black acts of sins in his left hand. Its top was black like the message of the mourning of death, as the contents and margins were full of misdeeds. In entirety, there were references of sins and misdeeds, and of rejections and infidelity as in a battlefield. Such a record full of filth and troubles cannot reach the right hand. It reaches the left hand only. That person had to read the black record of his misdeeds.

sections.heading: Good and Bad Acts Are Clearly Visible
paras: In similar manner, you may see the record of your deeds here itself in this world and find out whether it is worthy of reaching the right hand or the left. When you go to a shoe shop, you can very easily find out the left shoe even without any testing. So also, if you find yourself not worthy of the right hand, you may conclude that you are worthy of the left hand only. You can very easily distinguish between the sounds of the lion and monkey without efforts.

However, you may note that, the one who makes the flower beautiful and fragrant, with His mercy can make left as right. He converts the bad qualities of the left into the good qualities of the right. He is the One who provides flowing water to the ocean. If you are worthy of the left hand, become one worthy of the right hand in order to see the dominance of His graces. Think whether you feel it proper to get the degraded record of the left hand to come over to the right hand? Think also whether a record full of cruelties and excesses is worthing of passing to the right hand?

chapters.title: Difference Between Words and Deeds
chapters.subtitle: Narrative of a pious man and his self-respecting wife; and his cohabitation with the maid, which is similar to a person’s claim whose words and acts do not tally, like the words of infidels whom if you ask as to who created the heavens and the earth, they will say: God. Wa la’in sa’ala tahum man khalaqas samaawaati wal ardha layaqulunna Allah: (Luqman: 31: 25). Yet, they serve the idol of stone and sacrifice their wealth and life for it. Is it right for that soul which knows that the creator of the heavens and earth is God, who is Hearing-Seeing- Attending- Guarding-Dominant and Self-respecting?

paras: A pious man had a wife beautiful like a hoor. She was envious of his conduct and very self-respecting, for the reason that she had a maid beautiful like the moon. There was a fire of love for her in the pious man’s heart. Out of her envy for her husband, the wife used to be watchful of her husband and would never leave the maid nearby to him in his loneliness. For a long time, the wife was watchful of both, so that they might not be together in loneliness. This went on until the command of God and fate came forward, when the wife’s wisdom and watchfulness became ineffective. When God’s command comes abruptly without any warning, of what account is wisdom? Even the moon gets into eclipse.

She was once in a public bath. Suddenly she thought of the missing water bowl when the husband was at home. She told the maid: “Take care: Go fast like the bird and bring the silver bowl from the house.” When the maid heard this command, she felt as though a new life entered into her that she would go to the master. The master is at home and there is loneliness. She ran with all joy toward the house. She was having a desire for six years to meet the master in such privacy. She ran fast toward the house and found the master alone in the house. Both the lovers were so much overtaken by lust that they forgot to bolt the door and to take care, in great pleasure. They penetrated into each other. The soul of each other entered into other in cohabitation.

At this moment the wife realized her mistake as to why she sent the maid toward the house. She thought: “I have myself put cotton into fire. I have myself set the male goat upon the female.” She washed her head of the washing clay and ran senselessly after the house, dragging her head mantle now and then which was falling down from her head.

sections.heading: Difference Between Gnostics and the Pious
paras: There was much difference between the two women. The lady was running in the fear that her husband was getting lost, but the maid was full of love. Similar is the difference between the pious and the gnostic, (one learned in good hood). Every moment of the gnostic reaches the throne of God, but the reach of the pious takes a month to cover the distance of a day. The journey of a day is also quite great for him. His one-day cannot be as large as fifty thousand years as in the case of gnostic. A single day of the gnostic engaged in the thoughts of God is equal to a period of fifty thousand years as per our calculation. The Gnostic’s engagement is due to his love for God, but the concern of the pious is due to fear of hell. Gnostic’s time is different from the time of the worldly people. People’s time is serial and arithmetical calculable in terms of seconds, minutes, hours, days, months, and so on, but that is not the time in respect of those engaged with God. Theirs is spiritual time and wisdoms remain outside its door and cannot understand and reach it. If disbelief and suspicion are not ready to accept this difference of time, let it not! Who bothers? The beliefs emanating from the world of spirit upon the human soul are different from the thoughts emanating from the brain.

There is not even an iota of fear in the matter of love. All religions, principles and doctrines, fail to cast their impact upon love, because love is an attribute of God, that is, it is a godly trait, but fear is a quality of the fellows in the affairs of the urges of sex and stomach. When you hear the phrase: “Whom He will love” (yuhibbuhum) in the Quran, read along with it: “as they will love Him”: (yuhibbunahu) that is yuhibbuhum wa yuhibbunahu. They love Him and He loves them. (Maida: 5: 57). That is, love is reciprocal. That is from both sides. Therefore, consider love as an attribute of God; and so also Ishq. So also, be sure that fear cannot be an attribute of God. (as in the case of the pious, who are pious out of the fear of hell).

sections.heading: Explanation of Ishq
paras: [ “Ishq is a feeling of extreme love in which there is no expectation of reciprocity. It can be on sided. One possessing Ishq does not concern oneself for what the thing loved feels or does for one. There is no equivalent word for it in English. At the most, it can be taken to mean infatuation which is explained as inspiration or filling up foolishness, shallow or extravagant passion. This can be taken as an enhanced stage of love, which can be reciprocal, or otherwise.

This is an Arabic word derived from the word ‘Ishqa, a creeper or vine that grows by creeping upon another tree, as a result of which the tree creeped upon dries up. This plant is also called surrounding plant (Ishq-e-piaichan). Therefore, any person afflicted with the extravagant, ardent love or affection is said to be creeped by this creeper. Ishqa, which thins, sickens and weakens him. Physicians and Psychologists of earlier days considered it as madness. That is why, Qaise, the aashiq of Laila is nick named Majnun meaning afflicted with madness or mad. Many incidents of his ‘Ishq. The Math(s)navi also contains many incidents relating to majnun. Majnun is symbolized ‘Ishq used to explain the meaning and impacts of ‘Ishq. ‘Ishq is considered to be unexplainable but known through feeling. And only one in ‘Ishq understands it and his actions and words, considered as blabberings of Majman, are taken as the meanings and expression of ‘Ishq.

sections.heading: Love of the Real and Unreal
paras: Ishq is considered to be of two types: Majaazi (unreal) and Haqiiqii (real). Love for material objects including man or woman is ‘Ishq-e-majaazi, as the word ‘Ishq in isolation is too great to be attributed to materials. It is attributable only to God; in which case it is Haqiiqii (real or of the Real entity). However, ‘Ishq-e-Majaazi is considered as a steppingstone to ‘ishq-e-Haqiiaii, for the reason that love for material bodies including man woman may develop into ‘Ishq in which case the physical person of the beloved (Ma’shuuq) is of no concern. The ‘Ishq becomes one for non-material or spiritual on non-tangible things in which case the ‘aashiq (lover) has no concern of himself. The non-material objects may be the inner qualities of the beloved, religions faith, ideologies, countries, principles, and long-dead personalities like the Prophet, his companions and great historical personalities, who live in the memories of people. This is a stage between ‘Ishq-e-majaazi and ‘Ishq-e-Haqiiqii. ‘Ishq-e-Haqiiqii, that is, ‘Ishq of God is at the highest level and the real object of ‘’Ishq. Sufi literature is full of this and explained in various manners some of which are taken as blabberings of madmen (Shatahaat).

sections.heading: Ishq: Unexplanable
paras: Love, the preliminary or starting point of Ishq itself is unexplainable but can only be felt, as the mother’s love for children, love of animals for their young ones and even an man’s love for a woman and vice-versa. These are only demonstrable. Poets make efforts to explain it in words and illustrations in various ways. But the subject never comes to conclusion. When the starting point (love) itself is so powerful and unexplainable, the difficulty in the explanation of the feelings of the in-between stages of greater intensity (‘Ishq) and of the final stage of ‘Ishq-e-Ilaahi can well be imagined. Imam Al Ghazali has discussed very elaborately on the subject of love, Ishq and ‘Ishq-e-Ilaahii in both kimiya-e-Sa’aadat and Ihya-ul-‘uluum. Here, Rumi explains in nutshell that love for God is reciprocal. Man loves God and God loves man quoting from the Quran yuhibbihum wa yuhibbunahu: (Maida: 5: 57). He loves them and they love Him — Translator.]

sections.heading: Love Has No Limit
paras: The attributes of God are absolutely uncomparable with those of man. Man is just a handful of mud and so also his qualities. At what level are the qualities of a creature in comparison with those of the Creator? God is at the perfect level of all qualities and creatures have a fraction of them. So also, the quality of love, which upon attainment of higher level becomes Ishq. The quality of Ishq in man is only a reflection of the Ishq of God. If I continuingly explain about Ishq, it will never end even after the passing of a hundred doomsdays one after another, because there is a fixed time upon which it occurs. But where is the end of the qualities of God. They are limitless, and eternal Ishq has five hundred feathers, and each feather is as large as the distance from God’s throne to the depths of earth.

sections.heading: Limits of Intellect
paras: The worshipper of God runs with his feet but an ‘Aashiq of God flies faster than wind and lightning. What is the value and worth of the speed of wind and lightning when the lover spreads his feathers on his march towards God? Those worshippers of God who worship him out of fear can never reach up to the dust of the feet of His lovers as the pangs of ‘Ishq convert the sky as its floor. However, if the grants of God’s light provide support, they can also free themselves of material concepts of this world. Stop building your body and beautifying yourself. That is, come out of the concepts of predestination and free will. These are intellectual discussions. Enter into the field of ‘Ishq, because it is the falcon of ‘Iahq that can reach up to the King. Love and attraction of the friend are far above the intellectual discussions of predestination and free will.

chapters.title: Organs of Body Speak Truth
chapters.subtitle: The housewife’s entering into the house, separating the pious man and the maid and their feeling ashamed

paras: When the housewife reached the house, she opened the door. The sound of the door’s opening entered into their ears. The maid felt embarrassed and jumped away, and the man also jumped and stood up for salat. The housewife found the maid extremely anxious, upset, worried and confused; and her husband standing up in prayer. This situation put her in great suspicion. She pulled his tights (lower garment) and found his organ and glands smeared with semen. The left-over semen was dripping from the organ and thighs and knees were unclean and wet with semen. She gave a beating on his head and said: ‘O lowly fellow! Are the glands of a man in prayer like this? Is a pudendum like this fit for engagement in prayer and attendance before God? So also, such dirty pudendum and thighs. Do justice to yourself and say whether such a record of cruelty, sinfulness, infidelity and misbehavior worthy of being given in the right hand.

sections.heading: Organs Will Speak Out
paras: If you enquire with an infidel as to who is the creator of the sky and all other creatures in the world, he will say that those are created by God and His creatures are the evidence of this fact. So also, his infidelity, sins and cruelties are worthy of giving evidence of their belonging to him. Such being the case, is it alright for the truthful to commit lowly and shameless acts? Such acts stand against his truthfulness entitling him for torture and frightful situations. He gets established as a liar from head to foot; and I feel it regrettable to explain all this. On the day of Judgement, all hidden things get exposed, and every committer of sins gets disgraced. His hands and feet will give evidence against him in full detail before God. The hand will says I committed theft of such, and such things and lips will say: I kissed in such and such a manner. Feet will say: we went towards such and such of the acts and the sex organs will say we committed fornication. Eyes will say: we made unlawful gestures, and ears will say: we heard such offensive words. Thus, you will be established as a liar head to foot as your limbs stand against you.”

This is the way you got exposed in the salat full of light, as treacherous with the evidence of your organs. You should do such acts in which your acts should be witnesses in your favor without spoken words. So that every part of yours may say: I stand as witness in your profits and losses. A slave’s walking behind the master speaks of his status that he is a slave, and he is the master.

sections.heading: Doors of Repentance Are Open
paras: If you have blackened your record of actions of the entire life, you may repent on what you have done earlier. Do not think that the entire life is lost in sins, and nothing can be done in the end. Give up this thought. No doubt that the entire life is lost, but its root is still intact. It may be dry yet pour upon it the water of repentance. Pour water upon the root of life so that the tree of your life may remain intact. All wrong acts of the past may become good acts. Poison of the past may become sugar of the present day. God has changed all your sins into good acts of obedience. O master! Make repentance with sincerity and try to do this with your body and soul as God has said: Turn to God with sincere repentance: Tuubuu illa Allahi taubatun nusuuhan (Tahrim: 66: 8). Hear from me the explanation of this sincere repentance. I know you are after it. Now, you may go more after it.

chapters.title: Acceptance and Non-Acceptance of Repentance
chapters.subtitle: Narration to explain that sincere repentance (Taubatun nusuuh) (Tahrim: 66: 8) is like milk that comes out of the breast but does not get back into it again. Similarly, whoever, makes sincere repentance, will never remember the sin with pleasure but will hate it every moment. This hatred is a proof of the fact that his repentance has been accepted and he has received the pleasure of acceptance. The earlier pleasure of sin has gone away and the pleasure of acceptance has occupied its place. Love of one thing cannot vanish other than with the love of another. Why do you not search for another beloved? And if the heart yet again thinks of the earlier pleasure of sin, it establishes the fact that pleasure of acceptance of repentance has not come about and occupied its place. It has not gone into the category of: “We will indeed make smooth for him the path to bliss. Fasa nuy assiruhu lilyusraa (Lail: 92: 7). As against that, he is still in the category of: We will indeed make smooth for him the Path of Misery: fasa nuyassiruhu lil ‘usraa: (Lail: 92: 10). Path of bliss is still to come to him. So we will provide such qualities for him that will take him toward hell

paras: In the earlier days there was a man by name Nusuh and his means of livelihood was massaging of women in the bath. His face was soft like the cheeks of women, and he kept hidden his manhood from them. He was doing massage work in various baths of women and was well versed and experienced in treachery. For years together, he carried on this profession, and no one could get a hint of his lustfulness, as his face and voice were womanly. He has put on a veil, head scarf and mantle to cheat them being full of lustfulness and arrogance of youth. In this manner he used to massage and give bath to the girls of the royal family, by massaging well.

sections.heading: Routine Repentance
paras: However, he was conscious of his sinful nature and used to repent many times and again go back to earlier habit. His infidel self-used to break his repentance. Once he went to a godly scholar and requested to pray for him without revealing his sin. The saint became aware of his hidden sins, but he did not reveal with godly kindness. He had a lock on his lips and many secrets in his heart. Lips are silent but the heart is full of voices. Saints have drunk a cup from God. They come to know of many secrets which they do not reveal. Whoever is taught of the secrets of God puts a seal on his mouth and lips by God. The saint smiled at him and said: ‘O ill-natured fellow, may God give you the inclination for repentance of all that you are aware.’

chapters.title: Inclination to Repentance
chapters.subtitle: To explain that the supplication of a saint is acceptable by God, and his request is like the request to God by God Himself, the acceptance of which is inevitable just a hadith(s) says about a person who attains nearness to God, God becomes his ears, eyes, tongue and hands. And also, God’s statement: you did not throw when you threw, but God threw: wa maa ramaita iz ramaita walakinnallaaha ramaa: (Anfal: 8: 17). There are many verses of Quran, ahaadith(s) and reports of sahaaba to explain God’s creating causes in this regard to such an extent that God caught hold of the ears of Nusuh and dragged him toward repentance

paras: The saint’s supplication pierced through seven heavens and that seeker’s job became good. The saint’s supplication is not like other supplications. He is mortal but his words are like the words of God. When God seeks for Himself from Himself, how can he reject His own prayer?

sections.heading: Cause Came About for True Repentance
paras: The one with majesty and grandeur created a cause, which relieved the fellow from his burden and troubles. When he was filling a bowl in the bath, a pearl belonging to a princess was lost. It fell down from her ear and all the women started searching for it. Then they shut the door of the bath tightly so as to search for it where the bather’s clothes and other things were kept. They searched, but the pearl was not found and the thief could not be caught. Then they started searching with greater efforts in the mouths, ears and in every hole of the body. They searched in every hole, up and down and everywhere, taking them as oysters containing pearls. Both men and women searched for a proper oyster and pearl. They directed all those present to remove their clothes whether old or young. The matron of the bath started the search to find out that pearl.

sections.heading: Sincere Repentance
paras: At this, Nusuh went into seclusion out of fear that his reality would be exposed, and he would be in great danger. His lips became bluish and face pale out of fear. He saw death right in front of him and started shivering like a leaf. He said: “O my lord! Many a times I have repented and turned back and broken my promises. I have done such things which did not suit me to such an extent that a flood of blackness has arrived before me. If this searching approaches me, so many hardships would come about. Can my soul bear those hardships? There are hundreds of sparks in my heart and my prayers are smelling the smell of my burning heart. Let not such a worry come even to an infidel. I have however held on to the lapel of Your mercy. I seek your indulgence.

“How good it would have been, had my mother not given birth to me; or a lion eaten me off in the forest. O God! Do that for me that is suitable to Your grand state as a serpent is biting me from every hole. I have a stony soul and a heart of iron, as otherwise under this sorrow and pain, I would have turned into blood. My time is narrowing down. O hearer of grievances, hold on to me and rid me of my troubles. If you hide my sins at this time, I shall repent from the commission of every kind of foolish acts. You have heard my repentance many times. Hear it at this time also, so that I may ready myself to hold on firmly to it to maintain it. If I commit any other breach this time, You may not hear me anymore and respond to my prayer.”

He was lamenting in this manner and hundreds of tears were falling from his eyes, further stating: “I am not caught by the policeman and executioner. May not even a foreigner die like this. May not even an atheist face this situation.” He was lamenting upon his soul in this manner having seen the face of Izra’iil, the angel of death, right before him. He went on crying ‘O God, O God’ for so many times that even the walls and doors joined his company.

chapters.title: Looseness After Tightness
chapters.subtitle: Coming of the occasion of the searching of Nusuh with the voice: we have searched everyone. Bring Nusuh before us. And Nusuh’s falling down unconscious and the solving of the matter after extreme tightness as the Prophet used to say, when suffering from sickenss or sorrow: O troubles become tighter so as to become loose

paras: While Nusuh was saying O Lord, O Lord, there came a voice from among the searchers: we have searched all persons. O Nusuh, you may come forward now.”

sections.heading: Soul Went to God
paras: He fell down unconscious and his soul flew off. He fell down like a broken wall and his sense and wisdom became nonfunctional and he became lifeless like stone. As his consciousness left his body, his soul slowly merged into God. He was empty of all senses and his existence was non-existing. The falcon of his life was called by God before Him. Then the boat of his hopelessness touched the coast of mercy of God. His soul allied with God as soon as he fell unconscious when the ocean of mercy was in full flood. When his soul got rid of the grossness of the body, it marched in all joy towards its place of origin. Human soul is like a falcon flying high, and body is like a prison in which it is held with its wings bound and feet broken, and like a slave. When his consciousness left him, his feet became free, and the falcon started flying toward the king.

sections.heading: Impacts of God’s Mercy
paras: When the oceans of mercy rise in flood, rocks also drink the life-giving water. Their tiny particles become large and full of wonders and lively. Earth’s ground becomes a plain silk fabric interspersed with silver and golden threads with greenery and colourful flowers. A man, dead a hundred years before, comes out of the grave, and the ugly devil becomes as beautiful as to be envious for the hoor. The entire face of the earth becomes fertile and dry branches of trees sprout flowers. All hates and cruelties vanish, and wolves start drinking wine along with lambs. Sickly fellows having lost all hopes of health become healthy with strong nerves and muscles.

chapters.title: Repentance Accepted
chapters.subtitle: Finding of the pearl and seeking of pardon from Nusuh by all the servants and maids of the princess and their kissing his hands and head out of reverence, and pleading excuses

paras: Then came a cry that: “There is no more anxiety, that priceless, rarest of the rare pearl has been found out.” After this, there was no fear of life and destruction, as this happy announcement was not of the finding of the pearl alone, but of the regaining of Nusuh’s life. They said: “Sorrow came to end, and we are all bright with joy. Give us a reward as we found out the pearl.” The entire bath echoed with the joyous words, cries and clapping’s. There was no anxiety anymore.

Unconscious Nusuh regained his consciousness. His eyes saw a light that was brighter than the combined light of a hundred days. Everyone started seeking his pardon and kissing his hands with reverence.” They said: “We all had a suspicion upon you and spoke ill of you by backbiting about you which is akin to eating a dead brother’s flesh. This was for the reason that you were closer to the princess than all others.”

Nusuh was a special massager of the princess. Thery were like one soul in two bodies. If at all anybody stole the pearl, it must be he alone as there was none as near to her as he was. The first to be searched was he in this effort, but they delayed the job in order to keep his honour intact, so that, if possible, he might throw it somewhere during the searching and protect himself from blame.

Anyway, they were repeatedly seeking his pardon standing before him and pleading excuses. He told them: “It was all God’s grace, as, in fact, I am worse than what all has been said about me. There is no need for anyone to seek pardon from me. I am a greater criminal than anyone else in the world. What all bad things have been said about me are just one of the thousand crimes and wrong doings of mine. All my sins and wrongs are known to me or to God, the Hider of all sins. Earlier, Satan was my master and later he became my follower. God saw all these and made them invisible so that I may not become pale-faced out of disgrace. He stitched my torne garments to hide my sins and gave me a scope for repentance, as precious and sweet as one’s life. He undid all that I had done, and attributed to me all those acts of worship which I had not done. He made me as free as the cypress and lilly, and pleased my heart with great fortune and wealth. He entered my name in the list of the noblemen. I was one for hell but granted He paradise to me. He pardoned me of all my crimes and sins. My black record was converted into a white record and so also my face.

“I took a long sigh, which became like a long rope that hanged in my well, holding which I came out with all freshness, fatness and victorous-red-face. I was a prisoner at the bottom of the well crying and wailing day and night. In the madness of my passions, I was helpless in a dark narrow street, and now I am so free that the whole world cannot be large enough to hold me. Praises and praises upon You, my God. You have instantly separated me from all sorrows. Even if every hair of my body becomes a tongue and engages in saying thanks to You, all the thanks will be deficient. I am now, raising my voice loudly among the gardens and founts calling upon the people: Ah me! Would that my people knew what I know! — For that my Lord has granted me forgiveness and has enrolled me among those held in honour: Yaalaita qawmii ya ‘lamuuna bima ghafarlii rabbi wa ja ‘alanii minal mukra mina: (Yasin: 36: 26-27)

chapters.title: Impacts of Firm Repentance
chapters.subtitle: Recalling of Nusuh by the princess for massaging after his repentance held on firmly; and his giving excuses, refusing and seeking pardon

paras: After this, a messenger came to him telling: “king’s daughter is calling upon you to wash her head. She does not want anyone else to massage her body and bathe her”. He said: “Please go back. My hands have become useless. Your earlier Nusuh has fallen ill now. Please search for someone else sooner, as I swear upon God, my hands have become useless.”

He was telling within his heart: “My sins have gone beyond limits. Their heat and burning sensation cannot go out of my heart. I have already died once and come back to life. I have tasted the bitterness of death and non-existence. I have truthfully repented before God. I shall not go against it so long as my soul is in my body. Who else can think of those sins again, and to step in toward risk of ways other than a donkey?

chapters.title: Forgetting of Repentance
chapters.subtitle: To explain that whoever repents after feeling ashamed and then forgets the shameful acts, and test something already tested once again, fells himself into lasting loss and gets disgraced as the saying goes: one testing the already tested one, gets disgraced. When the stability of his repentance, its strength, taste, acceptance and support are not available to him, he is like a tree that has lost its roots, rendering its leaves yellow and dry every day. We seek the support of God from this!

paras: There was a washerman who had a donkey. The donkey’s back was injured. It was very weak and hungry for days and night in a rocky land, without any support and security. It had nothing other than water to drink. Its days and nights were dark and blue due to loss. The roundabout area was a forest full of bamboo trees where there was a lion which was injured in a fight with a male elephant and incapable of going for hunting. For a long time, it did not go for hunting because of its weakness, and other animals depending upon its leftover food were in deprivation. They were deprived of their food because of the lion’s sickness. The lion told a fox: “Go out and become a hunter for me. If you find a donkey around the forest, use your magic spells upon it and bring it near me. Or even you may bring a cow using the tricky spells known to you. When I become strong enough after eating their flesh, I shall go for hunting for another prey. I shall eat a little and provide a tiffin for you. Use your sweet, tricky words to soften that pray and bring it fast near me.”

chapters.title: Qutb and Lion Compared
chapters.subtitle: Comparison of the Qutb, who is gnostic and companion of God, who releases the food of grace and pardon to the people according to their status under God’s inspiration, with the lion which eats its own earned food and others are dependent for food upon it, depending upon their nearness to it. Nearness is not spatial but of character, and other explanations are many. And God is the Guide

paras: [ The word Qutb means pole or arsh around which something moves like the earth on its axis between North pole and south pole. In human affairs, Qutb is a man of extraordinary wisdom and godly knowledge who can guide and control human affairs. This is given as a title to saints of highest caliber with large numbers of followers, following whose influence is upon all saints of his days — Translator]

Qutb is one who has found out the truths of God, and the others are the receivers of his grants like the lion who catches the pray and other animals receive their food from it. You must try to keep the Qutb pleased to the extent possible by you so that he may become stronger to receive more and more knowledge. People will become helpless if he is displeased.

sections.heading: Wisdom Is Qutb of the Body
paras: The food of all people is in the hands of wisdom. The food of wisdom of all the people is his leftover food like the lion’s leftover food. Keep this in mind if you have a desire to go in for more and more instructions.

He is similar to wisdom in the body, and the people are like the limbs of the body. Entire organization and management of the body is connected with wisdom. Weakness of the wisdom (qutb) is due to the body and not due to the soul. Weakness comes about in the boat and not in its rider like H. Noah. H. Noah may be considered as the rider in the boat like wisdom in the body. Qutb is one who rotates around itself; and this revolution of the heavens is around him. The connection between his body and soul similar to that between Noah and the boat. Provide support to him to repair the boat and become his specially closeby servant. You can do this only if you are obedient to the wisdom of your own and to the Qutb. Your giving support to him will increase your own strength and not his, as God has said: If you help God, He will help you: In tansurullaha, yansurukum: (Muhammad: 47: 7). Therefore, go for hunting like the fox and sacrifice your prey for him just as it does for the lion. So that you may catch thousands of preys in recompense. Hunting by the disciple is like the hunting by the fox, and their rejectors are like hyena that goes for the flesh of dead animals. If you take a dead body to him, it will get a new life just as filth, as manure, becomes a fruit in garden

chapters.title: Answer of the Fox to the Lion

paras: The fox told the lion: “I shall be obedient to you. I shall use such designs which would uproot wisdom. Playing tricks and casting magic spells is my profession. My job is to cheat and misguide”.

From the hilltop she ran toward the stream and found a weak, tired donkey there. She saluted him enthusiastically and stood before this simple-natured-poor fellow and said: “Why are you here in this dry desert full of rocks.”

sections.heading: God Provides Food to All Creatures
paras: The donkey said: “Whether I am in troubles or in paradise, I am thankful to God for whatever He has allocated as my share. I am thankful to the Friend in prosperity and adversity as under the laws of God, if there is one bad thing, there is yet another one that is worse than it. As He is the distributor, it would be infidelity to show unhappiness upon what is given out. One should be patient with that, as patience is the key of grants. Certainly, patience is the key to expansion and increase. Patient people never get into hardship and deficiency. I am fully contented with the provisions made by the Distributor as He is the master of all elites and commons. All elites and commons enjoy the share of grants provided by Him, be they wild beasts, insects, or worms. Birds and fish eat what is given to them. Ants and snakes also get their food. His dining sheet has surrounded the entire world and all His creatures are wonderstruck at His dining sheet. They are all eating but there is no deficiency anywhere, anytime. Tell me, who is in this world without his allocated share?

sections.heading: Everything Has a Better and Worse
paras: If you are with a lively heart, you should be contented. He sends the food needed by everyone of His creatures. He is the only friend and others are enemies. How can you speak of your dissatisfaction with the friend to the enemies? Be thankful that you may not get worse than what you got, as otherwise you will be in difficulties like the donkey caught in slush. When He provides buttermilk to me, I shall remain satisfied and will not desire for honey, because every better thing is attached with some troubles. There cannot be a treasure without the snake nor a flower without thorn. Pleasure is not available in the bazaar of the world without pains. I recall a story told by my father, who told me one day: my son!”

chapters.title: Desiring for Unknown Things
chapters.subtitle: Narrative of the water-carrier’s donkey which looked at the well- decorated Arabian horses in the stable, desiring for the same against the advice that nothing other than God’s pardon and favor should be desired inspite of hundreds of hardships, because pleasure of recompense is sweeter and better enjoyable. If you desire for other things without first testing them, there will be sufferings invisible to you just as the grains spread on the net. The net being hidden from sight. You are in such a net with a desire for the grain without knowing about the net.

paras: “A water-carrier had a donkey which had become semi-circular in shape because of hard work. It had ten injuries on its back because of the carrying of loads and these pains had made it fall in love with death and craved for it. Millet was too great a thing for it, even dry grass was not available to it to fill its belly. Every time it was beaten on the back by an iron rod. The head of a royal stable, who was a friend of the watercarrier took pity on it, saluted his friend and enquired about this condition of the donkey, as to why it is curved like the Arabic letter daal. He replied: “It is because of my poverty and carelessness as millet cannot be provided to this mouth-tied fellow.”

The stable warden told him to leave it with him for some days so as to become strong in the royal stable. The water-carrier left the donkey with him and thought that it got rid of the troubles. And it was tied in the royal stable.

The donkey saw Arabian horses all round, fat enough, fresh and fine and well decorated. The ground under their feet was well groomed and sprinkled with water, and millet and grass were provided to them at regular timings. It saw them being groomed with brushes and well massaged. The donkey lifted its head and said: “O my Lord! Am I not your creature, even though I am a donkey? For what reason am I kept humble and weak with injured back? For the whole night I suffer with back pain and with hunger during the day. Every moment I crave for death to end my miseries. There horses are so happy and well-fed with beautiful decoration upon them. Why am I specially made to undergo torture and miseries?”

Suddenly, there was a battle cry and the time to put saddles on the Arabian horses arrived to put them on their job and they were taken away. When they came back (from battle), they came with injuries caused by arrows pierced here and there on their bodies. After coming back, they fell down on the floor of the stable. Their legs were tied with ropes and the horseshoe makers (veterinarians) stood in line to attend to them. They cut open their wounds with syringes to remove the arrows.
When the donkey saw this, it started telling: “My God! I am quite contented with poverty and safe life. I am disgusted of the comfortable life and these large wounds.”
Anyone seeking safety gives up the world.

The fox said: “Search for lawful food is made a duty to be obeyed. This world is a world of causes and food is not available without efforts. Efforts have to be put. The phrase in the Quran: Seek of God’s bounty: wa abtaqhu min fadhlillahi: (Jum‘a: 62: 10) is a command. This is for the reason that one may not have to pounce like a leopard on food. The noble Prophet has said: “The door of food is kept closed and there are locks put on it. Our actions, movements and earnings are the keys of the locks and curtains. There is no scope to open the door without the key. Providing food without one’s putting efforts is not in the conduct of God. If you go and sit at the bottom of a well, how can food come over to you”?

The donkey said: “All this is due to weakness of trust in God. Otherwise the One who gives life also gives bread. One has to struggle to seek kingship and victory in the world; but the piece of bread is not lessened for him and is certainly provided. Carnivorous and herbivorous animals are all eaters of food. They neither collect their food nor carry upon their backs. The provider of food provides to all and keeps their share in front of them. Food of its own, reaches one who sits in patience. Your efforts and struggle are due to your lack of patience.

chapters.title: Reply of the Fox to the Donkey’s Saying: “I Am Contented with What Is Provided to Me”

paras: The fox replied: “This type of trust is very rare. There are very few who are experts in trust. Moving around rare things is foolishness. Everyone cannot reach this level of trust which is the special quality of the kings of sincere dependence on God.

The Prophet has called “contentment as a treasure”; but everyone cannot get a hidden treasure. Take into account your limitations and do not fly too high so that you may not fall into the pit of miseries and mischiefs. Put efforts and search for provisions when you do not have the trust and patience of the great one.”

chapters.title: Donkey’s Further Reply to the Fox

paras: The donkey said: “Your talk is perverse. Miseries and mischiefs are caused by greed. Nobody has died by holding on the contentment; and nobody became a king due to greed. Food does not remain far from dogs and pigs. Rains and clouds are not the makings of man. Just as you are in love with food, so also food is in love with its eater. If you cannot run up to food, food itself will come to your door. If you run after it, it will cause headache to you.

chapters.title: Testing Effectiveness of Trust
chapters.subtitle: Narrative to explain the meaning of trust: a pious man was testing trust. He cut off all means and went out of the city and from highways, roads and people, and reached the root of a barren hill; and in the extremity of hunger kept his head on a stone; telling within himself: O God! I have trust upon Your making of causes and providing of food; and kept myself away from efforts, to test the effectiveness of trust

paras: A pious man heard the Prophet having said: Food certainly reaches a living being. Whether you want it or not, your food will run in your love and reach you. In order to test this statement that man went toward a forest and slept at the root of a hill. He said to himself: “I shall see whether my food reaches me or not so that my thoughts about food may become stronger.”

A caravan lost its way and came near the place where he was found sleeping. The travelers said: “Why is this man alone here, in the forest away from the main road and city? This is very strange. It is difficult to know whether he is alive or dead! He does not seem to have any fear of the wolves and enemies.” They came near him and patted hand on him. But he deliberately did not say anything. He did not move, nor even shake his head, and did not even open the eyes to see what was happening. Then those people said: “This unfortunate fellow is very weak and is lain unconscious due to hunger. They brought bread and food in a vessel to put into his mouth and throat. But he deliberately shut his mouth so as to see the truth of the statement.

The person serving him food felt all the more pity thinking that he is totally helpless and destructible due to hunger and caught between death and annihilation. They brought a knife and forcibly opened his mouth. Then, they put soup with bread pieces crushed in it and put it in his mouth. Then the pious man said to himself.: “O my heart! Though you do not resort to control your body, you have come to know the secret meaning of the statement, yet you are pretending to be ignorant.” His heart told him: “I know! Yet I am deliberately pretending. I know that God is the provider of my life and food.”

What greater trial can there be than this that food reaches very well toward the patient to convince you. Therefore, do not give up trust in God. Greed for food is due to donkishness. After this, the pious man opened his mouth and said: “I have conducted a trial on food! Whatever that clean hearted Prophet has said is true and there is no doubt whatsoever in it.

chapters.title: None Can Do All Jobs
chapters.subtitle: Further attempts of the fox to persuade the donkey toward profession

paras: The fox said: “Keep this story away! Engage your hands in work and not in arguments. God has given hands to engage them in work, carry on a profession and help another one in his work. Whoever engages himself in work for himself also works for the good of friends. It is not possible for all professions to be done by one man such as to become a carpenter, watercarrier and weaver. The order of the world is based upon co-operation and mutual help. Everyone does a job as per his need and ability. Do not run away from the middle path as it is unreasonable. Conduct of the Prophet is not to cut off professions and earnings.”

chapters.title: Trust Is the Best of Professions
chapters.subtitle: Donkey’s answer that trust in God is the best of the professions as everyone is dependent upon and works upon trust and prays to God to make his job right. And supplication is a profession, which is not dependent upon other professions

paras: The donkey said: “I am not aware of any profession in both worlds as better than trust in God. Neither I know, nor I see any profession other than that of thanksgiving and gratefulness to Him. This act of thanksgiving to God drags further food from God towards us. Trust itself is the best of the professions, as every professional trusts in God and rises his hands in prayer to grant him success. This prayer itself is trust. You may rest assured of this. There is no need for any investment and efforts and anything else in the profession of trust. One is rid of the accounting of production, profit and loss.
Thus, there were great arguments between them and both of them got tired of questions and answers.

Therefore, the fox said about putting of one’s life in destruction saying there is a command in the Quran not to make your own hands contribute to your destruction: Laa tulquu bi aidiyakum ilat tahlukati: (Baqara: 2: 195). Patience in a dry, rocky desert is foolishness, when God’s world is so long and wide. Go away from here toward greenland and taste greenery along the stream. There are green lands like paradise, where grass grows up to the height of your waist. All those animals are fortunate who go over to such places. Grasses are so tall that even camels can become invisible in their midst. There are fountains everywhere and all animals are well-fed and in peace.”

sections.heading: Fox Outbeats Donkey
paras: But any way, a donkey is a donkey. It could not say to the fox: “O accursed one, when such is the pleasurable situation there, why are you in such wretched condition. Where are signs of your grandeur, fatness and pleasures. Why is your body so thin, frail, weak and haggard? If the details of the garden are not false and wicked, your eyes ought to be intoxicated with them. But nothing of that sort is seen in you. This beggarliness and shameful craze for food is because of your being a beggar and not because of your riches and leadership. Why are you dry when you have come from the fountain? Where is fragrance of musk if you claim yourself to be like the deer’s gland. Where is the bouquet of flowers in your hands if you are coming from out of the gardens of paradise? There is no sign of anything in you that you are explaining about.”

chapters.title: Pride of Hollow Knowledge
chapters.subtitle: Citing the example of camel in respect of a person talking of great fortune, where there are no signs of greatness in him. He is liable to be accused of being a blind follower

paras: A person asked a camel: “O fortunate fellow! From where you are coming: “The camel was full of dust. But said: “I am coming from the warm bath in your street”. That man sarcastically said: “Yes, Yes! It is apparent from your thighs”.

Pharoah saw the serpent of H. Musa and felt humble at the sight and exhibited humility and sought for time (deal with the matter). Some wise men said: “At that sighting, he ought to have been more angry as he was the lord of his religion. Whether the miracle showed small snake or a large python to him, it should have increased his anger and his self-claimed godly pride. When he was a great lord on his throne in his court, why did he seek time to consider the situation upon looking a worm (snake)?”

sections.heading: Blind Following in Faith
paras: When your self is inebriated with your own drinks and snacks, you may know that you have not seen the stalks of blossoming flowers of the hidden world. Because these are the signs of the sighting of that hidden light which would protect you from this world full of treacheries. When a bird flies around a saltish lake, it means that it has not tasted fresh, sweat water. This is the situation of blind followership in the matter of faith. His is a hollow faith, and his soul has not seen the face of real faith. Therefore, a blind follower of faith is always at the risk of misguidance and dacoity on the way by the accursed satan. When he sees the real light, he remains satisfied and in peace from the anxieties of doubts and suspicions. He is like the floating material on the surface of disturbed water which upon reaching the bank attains stability, because the material is made up of muddy contents and it feels itself to be away from native soil. Water is a place of strangeness for it. One cannot remain at rest in strange locations, when one opens eyes and looks at the markings of realities, one is firm in faith. Devil will not have any control on him.

sections.heading: Borrowed, Showy Greatness
paras: Though the donkey said many hidden matters to the fox, but they were all many hidden matters to the fox, but they were all hearsay based upon blind followership. So also, a blind follower had heard of the virtues of water but was not anxious for it as he had not tasted it. He had torne clothes, scratched face like lovers, but was not a lover. So also, the excuses offered by the hypocrites. They were not sincere, as they had only spoken words in the mouths and not in the heart. These had the smell of apples but were not apples. The smell could not bring about anything other than craze.

Attacks of women in the battlefield, do not break the ranks of enemies, but upset the plans of the generals. You will see her bold like him holding the sword in the hand, but her hand will be trembling. Pity on the fellow whose wisdom is feminine, but his vicious self is masculine and assertive. Inevitably, his wisdom gets defeated, and he gets nothing but losses. Attacks by the females appear to be brave only to look at, but their troubles are like those of the donkey for its donkishness. Ultimately the donkey got trapped by the fox.

sections.heading: Masculine Wisdom, Feminine Self
paras: Animal instinct dominates over the women as they are inclined toward colours and smells like animals. They are satisfied with colours and smells and do not go into the depths of the matters. That person is praiseworthy whose wisdom is masculine and his vicious self is feminine lacking peace. His wisdom being masculine dominates over the female self and absorbs it within itself. The donkey heard about colours and smells of the greenery of forest, got trapped and all his wise arguments passed off from it. It became like a thirsty person waiting for rain at a time when there are no clouds. His self was hungry like a man suffering from the sickness of hunger and he had no patience.

sections.heading: Food for Wisdom
paras: Be it known that patience is an iron shield upon which God has written “victory assured”. A blind follower presents a hundred arguments on the basis of imagination and not on the basis of observation and experience. They are like the droppings of animals smeared with musk. There is fragrance of musk, but it’s worth is nothing but dung. In order that dung may become musk, you will have to graze in the garden of spiritual world for years together. Not eating like the donkey of washerman, but as deers eating the fragrant flowers of Khutan, the well-known forest where musk deers roam about. Do not graze upon anything other than cloves, jasmine and rose and go with the musk deers in the forest of Khutan. Make your stomach accustomed to Raihan (basil) and rose so as to get the food of wisdom that the prophets got. Get your stomach rid of this grass and millet and start eating Raihan and rose.

Physical stomach of the body takes you to the grazing field and the stomach of heart takes you toward Raihan to relish the food of God’s gnosis. Whoever eats grains and grass is sacrificed for food and whoever eats the light of God becomes like the Quran. Half of you is made of dung and the other half of musk. Do not increase dung but increase Chinese musk. Whatever hundreds of arguments that a blind follower brings forth through his mouth may be considered as worthless. He is lifeless. His life is devoid of the talks of secrets. His brain does not contain any pulp. When a speaker has no life, greatness and grandeur, how can there be leaves and fruits in his words. He makes the people going on the path brave by talks. His soul wavers more than a leaf of grass. Though his words are high sounding, but they cause trembling due to low contents.

chapters.title: Rainwater and Terrace Water
chapters.subtitle: Difference between the callings of the perfect guides and of the claimants of false greatness who take from others and appropriate to themselves

paras: A perfect guide informs the people of the path of God and also makes his light as a comparison on the path. Try to absorb this light within yourself so that your words may be full of light. Whatever gets boiled in the grape syrup absorbs it within itself and becomes like the syrup itself. Whether those are carrots, apples, peaches or apricots —all get the taste of grape syrup. When your knowledge gets mixed up with God’s light, a misguided, quarrelsome community gets the light of guidance from you. Whatever you tell becomes bright and spreads light all around just as the sky does not fell anything other than pure clean water. Become one like the sky, cloud and fell rainwater as against water from the terrace which is of no use. Water from the terrace is borrowed water and not original and natural like the water from the clouds and seas. Consider the thoughts and ideas as water from the terrace; and pure, revealed knowledge as cloud and sky. Rainwater gives hundred colors to the garden but water from terrace gives rise to quarrels with the neighbors.
Now, I again revert toward the fox and the donkey to show how the fox put the donkey on the wrong path.

chapters.title: Donkey’s Getting Defeated by the Fox in Its Greed for Grass

paras: The donkey offered two-three more arguments, but only from blind followership. It got cheated by the fox. It did not possess creative thinking, insight and consequent assertiveness. The fox’s treacheries flabbergasted it, and the greed for food degraded it, and inspite of five hundred arguments, it was defeated.

chapters.title: Lessons from Petty, Mean and Things
chapters.subtitle: Story of a homosexual and a sodomite; and the sodomite’s asking him during the sodomous act as to why he has a dagger with him. He said: “it is to tear off the belly of anyone who thinks ill of me”. The sodomite while going up and down upon him sarcastically said: “May God be pleased! You do not suspect me of ill will for you! “Verse: My verses are not a small room, but a large open space. My making fun is not for fun but for teaching. God’s statement: God does not disdain to coin the similitude of a gnat or even anything above that (in smallness): Innallaha laa yastahii an yadhriba math(s)alan maa bauudhatan famaa fawqahaa: (Baqarah: 2: 26). Thus famaa fawqahaa: “even smaller than the great is referred to bring changes in the selfs of men even after rejections of wisdom, who say: “What means God by this similitude: Maazaa araa dhaltaahu bi haazaa math(s)ala? (ibid). to this he answered: “By it He causes many to stray, and many He leads into the right path.” Yudhillu bihii kath(s)iirun wa yahdi bihii kath(s) iiran: (ibid) [this is the breakup of the single ayat: Baqarah: 2: 26 to clarify the meaning]. This is because every trial is a balance through which many come out successful with bright face and many meet failure. Were they to ponder over these even to a little extent, they would have found great benefits?
