paras: A homosexual took to his home a sodomite, laid him upside down and wriggled him and engaged in sodomous act. That accursed fellow saw a dagger tied to his waist and asked him about it. He replied: “This is to tear off the belly of ill-natured fellow who would try to be bad with me.” The sodomite sarcastically said: “Praise be to God! I do not have any ill intention and mischievous mind for you (to face that danger)!

sections.heading: Boldness and Courage Matter, Not Weapons
paras: “What is the good of a dagger, when you are not a man. You are only half-man, being a homosexual. It will not give you any benefit, when you do not have a brave heart. You may happen to get the sword, Zulfiqar, which H. Ali had inherited from the Prophet, but do you have the arms of H. Ali, the Lion of God? You may remember the supplication of H. Isa to bless the people, but where do you shameless fellow have lips and teeth of H. Isa. You can make a ship by collecting donations and gifts from the people, but where is a shipper like H. Noah? I agree, you have broken the idols like H. Ibrahim, but how can you burn the idol of yourself in fire like H. Ibrahim. If you have any evidence of your capacities, you may bring them forth and make a wooden sword like Zulfiqar. Those arguments and evidences that come in the way of your actions are a miserable torture from God to you.”

sections.heading: Boldness Comes from Heart
paras: You make the fearful men bold with your talks, but yourself remain as a coward, more trembling in secret than anyone else. You advise others to have trust in God, but yourself speak of trying to pierce the syringe in the mosquito’s vein, that is flying in air. O eunuch! You are in the vanguard of the army in the forefront, but your lies, beard and testicles are witnesses of your cowardice. When the heart gets filled up with cowardice, beard and moustaches become a cause of ridicule. Repent and shed tears like rain and protect your beard and moustaches from shame. Take the medicine for bravery so that you may become the hot sun in the constellation of Taurus, when it sheds the hottest rays upon the earth. Treat yourself to become bold and do not be impotent, so that many beautiful faces may take birth. Forget your stomach and take care of your heart so that salutations may come from God in the open without curtains in between.

If you want to be a brave man like Rustam of the other world, hold on to the dagger for the killing of your selfish desires; and if you are inclined toward impotency, you may put on the mantle upon your head like women and live in privacy. If you want to be brave, you have to put on the coat of mail; and as against this, if you want to be a coward, you may sell your backside like a homosexual. It is difficult to start to walk on the path of the other world. But you may put a few steps with efforts, so that love may drag you within its lap. Stand like a bold man in the battlefield, so that you may remain protected from the scaffold. How long do you want to wear feminine dresses like women, stand erect like a spear and come and join the ranks of men?

chapters.title: Victory of the Fox Over the Donkey’s Self-Protection and Defense, and Dragging It Toward the Lion’s Den

paras: The fox stood upon her feet, caught hold of the beard of the donkey and dragged it.

You have already heard about the quawwals beating their tambourines repeating the tune and singing “the donkey has gone; the donkey has gone”. You know the loss caused to the Sufi upon the going away of the donkey. So also heard the story of the rabbit, how it felled the lion in the well. When such kind of foolery goes on, then how can the fox remain without taking the donkey toward grass?

sections.heading: Saints Inviting Toward Goodness
paras: This was all due to the sweet, slippery words of the tricksters. Therefore, be careful keep your ears shut and do not hear fooling spells, excepting the spells of the grievance-redressing saint and friend of God, who is your master and guide? His spells are better than the sweets given by others because there are hundreds of sweets under the dust of his feet. There are vessels full of royal wine which have received the wealth of wisdom from his lips. It is he only who loves wine, who has not heard the words from the intoxicating -ruby-like lips of the saint. Only a blind bird that has not tasted free flowing sweet water, can remain hovering over saltish water. H. Musa’s soul makes a breast strong like the Mount Sinai. He can give sight to such blind birds and make them see fresh sweet water. The shaikh, as king, Khusro, lover of the sweet Shirin has beaten the drum that sugar is now available cheap in the city. Handsome Yusuf of the hidden world have declared that the bags of Egyptian sugar have come to the market.

Camels from Egypt have come towards us with the bells of their necks jingling, declaring their arrival, inviting the parrots to respond to their jingling declaring that your city will have large supplies of sugar tomorrow making it cheaper as time passes on. O sweetmeat makers fly toward the stocks of sugar like the parrots. Do not be like the fellows with yellow bile who do not love sweets. Crush the sugarcanes and be engaged only in this work and extract sugarcane juice and devote your life for this job. This is the best job for you.

There will not be a single sour person in our city now, as many kings have come over here like Khusro in search of Shirin (sweet) who has settled here. Snacks upon snacks and wine upon wine of the gnosis of God are available now. Climb upon the minaret and make an announcement of the matter. There is so much sweetness here that vinegar seasoned for nine years with extreme sourness, will become sweet here. Plain white marble will become red like ruby and yellow like gold. The sun is beating upon the door of the sky and particles are dancing about like lovers intoxicated with the wine of love. Eyes are as though drunk with the intoxicating greenery of the garden with twigs full of blossomed flowers. Wealth of the eyes is acting as magic spells. Souls are intoxicated with the love of God to such an extent that they are telling: Anal huqq (I am the truth) like Mansoor Hallaj. Elderly Zulaikha has become young in the love of Yosuf.

These are the impacts all around. Therefore, start enjoying these pleasures and continue to do so. Create a fire in your heart and burn the black grain in it to protect yourself from evil eye as is the practice of the people to burn black grain to ward off evil. Be pleased with your own attainments so as to reach your object in the world of souls.
If the cunning fox cuts off the head of the donkey, tell her to do so. But do not behave like the donkey and put yourself into difficulties and sorrowful situations.

chapters.title: Ignorance Causes Fears
chapters.subtitle: A person entered into a house in great fear. His cheeks had turned yellow like saffron, lips blue like indigo, hands trembling like leaves of the tree. The owner of the house asked as to what happened? He said: “Donkeys are being caught for free labour”. He said: “you are not a donkey. Why do you fear? He replied: “They are crazy and senseless. I am afraid, they might mistake me for a donkey”

sections.heading: Senseless Rulers Cause Fear
paras: A person in terrible fear dashed into another’s house, with pale face, blue lips, having lost all his facial charm. The owner of the house asked him as to what happened. Why your hands are trembling like a thin cane. What is wrong of, why have you run away? Why has the color of your cheeks gone?” That man replied: “For free service of the cruel king, donkeys are being caught outside.” The house owner was surprised and said: “O elderly man! They are catching donkeys and you are not a donkey. Why should you fear?” He said: They are so harsh and fast in catching that it would not be wrong if they mistake me for a donkey. They have spread out their hands so much to catch donkeys that their sense of discrimination is lost. As senseless people are our leaders, they will catch the owner of the donkey mistaking him for a donkey.”

sections.heading: No Fear of the Other World’s King
paras: But know about the affair of that city. The king of our city is not senseless. He has the sense of discrimination. He is hearing and seeing. Therefore, become a man here and do not be afraid of the catchers of the donkeys. You are not a donkey, but an Isa of the time. You need not fear. The fourth heaven where Isa resides is full of light. May you be in that heaven. May not your place be a stable.

You are higher above the heavens and stars, though for a particular purpose you are kept in a stable. The caretaker of the stable lives in the stable, but he cannot be called as a donkey just because he lives with the donkeys. The manager of the stable is different from the donkeys for whom the stables are made who are put in there. He is different from the donkeys.

sections.heading: Talks About Other Things
paras: We have been held up all through from sometime in donkey talk. We should stop this now and start talking about gardens, and fresh flowers. We should talk about pomegranates, oranges, lemons and the twigs bearing apples. We should talk about wine and countless beloveds and observers. Or about the oceans whose waves are pearls, which are talking to us and observing our acts. Or about the birds that are picking up flowers and laying eggs of gold and silver. Or about the falcons who take care of the partridges flying flat on their breast as also on their backs.

There are many unseeable ladders in the world which lead us step by step to the heights of the heavens. Every rung of the ladder has another ladder. For every step there is a different heaven. Everyone is unaware of the affairs of another. There is a large land which has no boundaries which did not have a beginning, nor will it have an end. Each one of them is unaware as to with what is the other one pleased. The other one is unaware as to of what has kept the other one in puzzle. The regions of the world of God are very large. Every tree has its own patch of land to stand upon. Upon the trees are the twigs and leaves which are expressing constantly thanks and praises to God as to what a wonderful kind of land He has made and how long and wide it is. Bulbuls are moving about the inflorescences of flowers asking them as to what they eat to live. There are no visible food items that you are eating. Give a little of that food to us also.”
There is no end to this explanation of the various aspects of nature. Let us stop at this and go to know about the hunger and sickness of the fox and the lion.

chapters.title: Hastiness Causes Loss
chapters.subtitle: Taking of the donkey toward the lion by the fox, and the donkey’s running away from the lion, the fox’s getting angry with the lion, saying: “the donkey was still far off. Why did you pounce upon it.” Lion’s seeking of pardon and entreating the fox to bring it back by another trick

sections.heading: Haste and Fastness Spoil Programs
paras: As the fox took the donkey near the grassland so that the lion may attack the donkey and tear it to pieces, it was far away from the lion and the lion did not have the patience to wait till it came nearer. The lion jumped upon the donkey from a heigh as it was very weak. It did not have enough strength to jump up from the ground. The donkey saw the lion from a distance, took an about turn and fled toward the bottom of the hill and was lost. The fox told the lion: “O king of ours! Why did you not have patience at the time of attack, so that, that misguided fellow could come nearer to you? So that, with a slight attack it could be overtaken. Haste and fastness is a treachery of Satan. Keeping patience and control upon oneself is a grant from God. The donkey was at a distance, saw the attack and ran away. Your weakness got exposed and you lost your honour.”

The lion said: “I was under the impression that my strength is intact; and I was myself foolish and blind because of my weakness. But I said to myself that my strength may be intact, and I may not have weakness in my hands and feet. That apart my hunger and need had gone beyond limits. And because of hunger, my patience and wisdom had been lost. It will be very good if you use your wisdom and bring it back to me again. I shall be very much obliged to you. Try again. Perhaps you may bring it back with your tricks. If God grants the donkey to me as my food, I shall regain my strength and grant you many preys.”

The fox said: “Yes! If God helps! He will put a seal of blindness on the donkey’s heart. It will forget the frightening situation that it has seen. Forgetfulness is not far away from his donkishness. But, when I bring it back, do not be fast to run on it, so that your haste may not destroy the scheme.”

The lion said: “You are right. I have found out now, that I am very sick, and my muscles are very weak. Until the donkey comes very near to me, I shall not move and be in pretended sleep as has been the usual.”

sections.heading: Seeking Confidence from God’s Words
paras: The fox left saying: “O king! Wait till heedlessness dominates over the donkey’s wisdom. It might have made many repentances with God and promised Him that it would not fall to the treachery of every trickster. But the donkey’s wisdom is a toy in the playground of our tricks. Its thoughts are like a soft playful bow in the hands of our children. We shall break its repentance and promise to God with our tricks. We are enemies of wisdom and periods of brightness. A herd of donkeys is a ball for our children to play and its thinking is a toy of our treachery. The wisdom that is a product of the movements of Saturn (as is believed) has no standing before the total absolute wisdom of God. The donkey is made of the wisdom from Saturn and Mercury, and we have received wisdom from the benevolent God.

“The border of the writing of our wisdom has the phrase: taught man that which he did not know: ‘allamal isaana maalam ya ‘lam (Iqra: 96: 5). Seeking of God’s knowledge is our objective. We are under the tutelage of that bright sun of ours; and that is why we always say: Holy is my High Lord (Subhaana Rabbial a ‘alla). God has further said about man: the knowledge is only with God: Innamal ‘ilmu ‘indallahi (Ahqaf: 46: 23). The donkey has passed through an experience, yet hundreds of its experiences can be nullified with our tricks. It is possible that, that lazy fellow may commit a breach of its repentance and this breach will certainly have its impacts.”

chapters.title: Transformation of Bodies
chapters.subtitle: To explain that breach of promise and repentance is a cause of trial, rather than transformation. As such, violators of sabat and the co-diners of H. Isa were transformed as stated: some of them transformed into apes and swine: wa ja ‘ala minhumul qirdata wal khanazira: (Maida: 5: 63). And in this community, it is transformation of heart. We seek God’s support against this. And on the doomsday body will be given the shape of the heart’s contents

paras: Breach of promise and repentance ultimately results into curses from God. The Jews committed the breach of promise and repentance of not fishing on the seventh day(Sabat). They were transformed and put to destruction and calamity. God transformed them into monkies as they deliberately committed breach of promise made with God.

But in this community of Muhammad, there is no physical transformation, but it is of the heart. Thus, when one’s heart becomes the heart of a monkey, the clay of which one is made, becomes more dishonorable than the heart of the monkey. If the donkey had any acquired art in its heart, it would not have been dishonorable physically and in appearance. The dog belonging to the companions of the cave had good conduct, and as such it did not meet any loss of its bodily doggish frame.

Transformation of the people of Sabath was physical, so that the open, perverted fellows falling down on their faces could see the physical change, because they could see only physical objects and changes, having no capacity to see the hearts and souls. But there are hundreds of thousands of fellows who are not physically but internally transformed into monkies and pigs for committing breach of premises.

chapters.title: The Fox’s Coming to the Donkey for the Second Time to Once Again Cheat

sections.heading: Instinctual Wrongs
paras: The fox soon came over toward the donkey, and the donkey said to her: “May there be refuge from a friend like you! What had I done to you, O coward, that you entangled me with the lion? What had I done to you that you took me in front of a python? What was the reason for your ill-will for me except the instinctual mischievous nature of yours, O my enemy? It is like the biting by the scorpion on one’s foot, without any intention to cause trouble. Or, like the devil who is the enemy of our life inspite of not receiving any trouble or loss from us. Or, it is due to his instinctual animosity for man, which gives great pleasure to him by causing man’s destruction. He never remains quiet without going after every man. He cannot get rid of his bad conduct. This is for the reason that his inner uncleanliness, without any cause, drags him toward cruelty and excessiveness. He invites you to comfortable places every moment in order to push you down into well. He tells you that there are ponds and founts of water to push you head down into the pond. Inspite of man being a possessor of greatness and splendor, he is put into mischiefs and calamities by him. Man receives all kind of noble instructions and inspirations, yet he is dragged by the devil toward the well to be felled down. Man has not given any injury to him nor committed any wrong against him, yet the devil goes on creating obstacles and sorrows on his path.”

sections.heading: Magical Scenes
paras: After hearing all this, the fox said: “What you saw there was a frightening scene created by magic which appeared to your eyes in the form of lion. You may see that my body is very weak and small in comparison with yours, but I graze in that place day and night, and nothing happens to me. Had there been no such frightening magical scenes, every gluttonous fellow would have come over there. There is a world of such hungry large, bodied fellows like elephants and hippopotamuses. Had there been no magic scenes how could there be grazing lands for others. All green lands would no longer be green. I wanted to tell you about this earlier, that you should not fear if you see such frightening scenes. But I forgot to do so, as I was more inclined toward your welfare than other things. I had seen you in extreme, never-ending-hunger, without provision of any kind. You were as though sick of the doggish hunger that never quenches by any amount of eating. I wanted to take you for medical treatment of that sickness. As otherwise, I would have spoken about those magic scenes. What you saw was only a mental imagination and not a physical body. I had forgotten to tell you about the solution of that heart shattering frightening trouble.”

The donkey said: “Go away from in front of me, O my enemy of mine, so that I may not see your ugly face. God had made you inauspicious and made your ugly face shameless and hard. With what face, you are coming before me? Such a kind of shamelessness is not shown even by a hippopotamus. You are openly after my life and blood, telling me that you are my guide to the grassland. You dragged me and I happened to see the face of Izraiil, the angel of death. Again, you have come with your well decorated, pleasing tricks. Though I am a matter of shame for the species of donkeys, or a donkey myself, I am a living animal. I possess life and, in such case, how can I appreciate these tricks.

“What I saw there created uncontrollable fright in me, so frightening, that a child looking at that would instantly become old. I lost all my courage and heart became virtually lifeless and had only the little sense to drop down myself from the hill. The fright had tied up my feet, when I looked at the torturous calamity in the open without any kind of obstacles in between. I made a promise to God, the repository of all graces, to release my feet from this gripping situation. Thereafter, I shall never fall into any body’s misgivings. I shall not swallow any kind of insinuations. I made a promise to Him to do good to all as a recompense. Then God opened up my feet in consequence of my supplication, humility, cryings and sighings. Otherwise, that male lion would have pounced upon me. Imagine, what would be the impact of a lion’s front paw on a donkey. After this, the lion has sent you back to me with treacheries. Know this, that you are a bad companion.

sections.heading: Snake Better Than Bad Companion
paras: I swear upon the holy essence of God, who needs nobody’s concern for anything, the Eternal and Absolute, that a snake is better than a bad companion. The poisonous snake takes away only life, but a bad companion takes one to the fire of hell. Even without spoken words and persuasions, heart steals his vicious conduct and character and makes itself vicious. When he puts his shadow upon you, without any investments efforts and acts, he takes your good investments rendering to indigence of all good qualities. Even if your wisdom is as great as an unconcerned python to be not affected by anything. A bad companion becomes an emerald that blinds the python, (as the common belief goes that emerald makes a snake blind). The eyes of your wisdom gouge out and fall down. a bad friend’s remarks pierce into you like spears putting you in the plague of slow torturous death. None is worse than a bad companion in the world. This is my observation with my own eyes with certainty of knowledge.

The fox said: “Our wine is filtered and quite clear. There is no residue but suspicious thoughts are not petty to be ignored. O simple hearted fellow, what all you referred to are your suspicions. I do not have any misunderstanding and ill-will for you. Do not look at me with your wrong thoughts. Why do you have baseless suspicions upon friends? Have good opinions upon clean hearted brothers, even if there are apparent harms from them. Because of wrong suspicions and improper thoughts, lakhs of friends have cut off each other’s necks. Sincere friends may commit some excess and trials, yet wisdom should not have vicious suspicions upon them. In particular, I do not have any bad instinct in me. What you saw was not bad, but your own imagination. If my thought had been bad, it required to be pardoned my friends. Or it should be taken as something decided and given to me by fate. This also renders me to be pardoned.

sections.heading: Worth and Wrongs of Mental World
paras: The world of inclinations, imaginations, temperaments and fears is a world of mind. It is a mental process, and it is not one’s making or in one’s control. It acts as a great obstacle for the searcher of truth. Mind acts as an image-maker, presents imaginations as actual images and realities in such effective manners that even a person of the strength of a mountain like H. Ibrahim was victimized. That great rejector of untruth fell into the world of imagination and inclination, got confused and said: “this is my Lord”: Haaza Rabbi (An‘am: 6: 77) by looking at the star. He made such an interpretation about the star, even though he was such a great, systematic interpreter like the maker of lace, who strings together scattered pearls in a coral. The world of thoughts and blind folding imaginations tumbled down such a great mountain from its place. When such a conclusion as “This is my Lord” came out as his statement, what can be said about a goose and a donkey.

sections.heading: God Alone to Protect from Mental Delusions
paras: Great mountain-like-wisdom sank down into the whirlpool of the oceans of imaginations and thoughts. Look at the well settled wisdom of H. Ibrahim, which was misled by imagination to make such a statement. “This is my Lord”. Great mountains of wisdom have been lowered by the deluge of suspicions and doubts and there is no peace for them other than in the Nooh’s Ark. Misguiding thoughts are dacoits on the road toward certainty. It is because of them that this community of Muslims is divided into seventy-two groups. That is why the Prophet said: followership of my conduct is like the Noah’s Ark for safety.

Man with certainty and firmness of faith remains secured. He does not consider the hair of his eyebrow dangling before him as crescent. One who has no insight of H. Umar gets misled by the hair of the eyebrow. [This incident is already narrated in earlier pages]. Lakhs of boats, out of fear and shocks of suspicions were shattered into pieces in the river of suspicions. The lowest example is of bright moon like, who inspite of his smartness and rational thinking got eclipsed in the constellation of suspicions.

sections.heading: Pimp of the Wife
paras: No one can know of a prostitute whose pimp is her own husband except the husband, who knows, but does not suspect of his being a pimp. He has no suspicion upon his misconduct. Were he to think so, he would not be a pimp for his wife. Your suspicions have put you in great estrangement and confusion, but you do not suspect them but go after the suspicions of others. When I am helpless and defeated by my own egotism, why do you sit before me with the pride of your own ego.

sections.heading: Crush Egoism and Egotism
paras: One who knocks at the door of his ego and egotism, is in love with oneself. He moves around self-destruction. I am in search of one, who has no egoism and egotism so that I may become a ball for his bat to bat me. One who has crushed his ego, becomes a personified virtue. He ceases to be a friend of himself and becomes a friend of all. He becomes a clean, precious mirror, as he becomes the exhibitor of all appearances. One has to go in search of such a master for guidance.

chapters.title: Narrative of Shaikh Muhammad Sarrazi Ghazanavi, May God Clean His Honorable Soul

sections.heading: Craze for Death
paras: There was a pious man in Ghazni, tasteful of wisdom by name Muhammad alias Sar-razi. He was called as Sar-razi (tender shoots of the grapevine) as he used to break his fast every night by eating tender shoots of grapevine. He was engaged in his struggle to see God for seven years. He saw many strange things from the King of existents, but his object to see the beauty of God, was not fulfilled. Having not seen after so much struggle for such a long time, He got disgusted and climbed at the peak of a hill and called upon God: “Show Yourself to me or otherwise I shall drop myself down”. A voice came to him: “That honorable time has not come yet. You will not die if your fall down. I shall not allow you to die.” Inspite of this, he dropped himself down out of love for God, and fell down in the depths of water. For not having died inspite of falling down, he felt all the more disgusted and started crying in his separation from death, because this life appeared to him as death. This was a situation quite the opposite of the general attitude. He used to beg for death and shout: there is life in death. He became one to seek death as against others who seek life. He was totally committed for the end of his life, as he was sure that he would see God after death. As in the case of H. Ali, sword and dagger were his diet. Flowers like narcissisus and Nasreen (eglantine) were considered by him as enemies.

sections.heading: Begging to Crush Ego
paras: Then a voice came to him from across the forest to go to the city. Apart from its high and low pitch, the sound was very strange. He questioned: “O knower of all my secrets, what service have I to do in the city?” The reply came: “The service is for the purpose of disgracing your ego. Make yourself a beggar like Abbas Dabas. [Abbas Dabas was a famous beggar who used to play various kinds of tricks in begging and had made it into an art. With his begging expertise, he used to make the people cry at times and at times laugh. He had become very famous. Many narratives of his artistry in begging are narrated in a book, Jami-ul Hikayaat. He is also referred to as Abbas Doos, and is said that he belonged to the tribe of Doos — Qazi Sajjad Husain].

“Collect money from the rich for sometime and give that to the poor dervishes. Till an appointed time, this alone will be your job.” He said: “I heard the command, the Protector of life! I shall obey it.” There were many questions and answers between the creator and the creature, between the pious man and the Lord of world and creatures for a long period of time. The result was that the earth and sky were full of light and all that is narrated in the book Maqaalaaat. But I am shortening the matter so that every mean fellow may not hear about the secret science. [Some people consider the book Maqaalaat as one written by Rumi — Qazi Sajjad Husain].

chapters.title: Shameless Begging with Greed
chapters.subtitle: Arrival of the shaikh from the forest into the city of Ghazni and circulating his begging bag on the hidden instructions, and distribution of the collected alms among the poor

paras: [I came to know in Qounia, where the tomb of Rumi is located, that in his maulawia chain of tasawwuf, there is still a practice to make new entrant to beg for forty days before inducting into the group — Qazi Sajjad Husain].

sections.heading: Begging for the Sake of God
paras: For the person who stands in attendance and says: “Yes! I am before you. I obey you”, there will be letters after letters and messengers after messengers. The one obedient to the command of God (Muhammad Sar-razi) turned toward the city of Ghaznin with his brightened face. People out of greet joy, want forward to great him, but he entered through a hidden path. All leaders and great men stood up to receive him and decorated their palatial houses. He said: “I have not come here to exhibit myself. I have come here for no other purpose than begging and getting disgraced. I am not in a mood to speak and hear. I shall go from door to door with the begging bag in my hand. I am a slave of the command from God that I should become a beggar. I am none other than a beggar. I shall bring a new word in beggary. I shall not think of any other mode than the one of the lowly beggars, so that I may sink fully in the disgrace of beggary so as to hear disgraceful words from the high and low people. Command of God is the life and soul of mine, and I am obedient to it. He has commanded me to be greedy and in such a way that contentment becomes lowly for one, who resorts to contentment. It is sinful for him to be contented, when the king of religion desires greed for me. Let there be dust on the head of contentment. He desired disgrace for me and I shall not seek honor for myself. He has desired beggary for me. How can I seek leadership? And now, beggary and disgrace are my life and soul. There are twenty Abbases in my begging bag. I shall never be satisfied with any amount of alms.”
The shaikh used to roam about with the begging bag in his hand saying: “O masters! If God has given you good instructions, for the sake of God, give me something.”

sections.heading: Prophets Begged for Support to God
paras: His inner hidden affairs were far above the kursi (Throne) and ‘arsh (the elevation above space). Yet, “give me for the sake of God” was his constant calling. Prophets also use to give such calls. People were poor and they used to beg from them. They to say: give loan to God! Aqridhullaaha: (Muzzammil: 73: 20). Their begging was by seeking loan for God. But prophets followed the practice of “give support to God”. Door to door, the shaikh pleaded his helplessness and there were open a hundred doors in the sky for him. The begging that he was carrying on was for God and not for his throat. Even if he did so for his throat, that throat was full of the light of God. His eating of bread, honey and milk was better than seclusion and three-day-fastings of hundreds of faqirs. He was swallowing God’s light, through his throat while eating bread. He was sowing lilac, though appearing to be grazing in the field. This is like fire that swallows the fat of the candle, but its swallowing gives light to the people. For the bread eaters, God said: “eat and drink but do not waste by excess: Kuluu washrabuu walaa tusrifuu (A ‘raf: 7: 31). But He did not say: “enough” (iktafuu), to those swallowing His light. Their throats are under trial and devoid of wasting, and safe from excesses. His begging was in obedience to God’s command and for His sake and not out of greed and demand. Such a soul cannot be obedient to greed.

sections.heading: Love for Body and Love for God
paras: If alchemy tells copper: “give up yourself to me”, it is not greed and excessiveness. It is for the benefit of copper only. The begging upon which he was working hard was a sign from among the many secret designs of God. From the depth of the earth to the height of the seventh level of heavens, God had placed the treasures before him. The shaikh said: “O Creator! I am in love with You! If I seek for anything other than You, I am an open sinner. If I keep the eighth heaven in my view, or perform prayers out of the fear of hell, I shall certainly be an obedient faithful seeking security and safety for myself, as both these two are for the sake of the body.”

But God’s lover eats the food of God’s love. He has no concern for body. Even a hundred bodies for him do not have the worth of the leaves of mulberry, (which are the food of silkworm, which gets imprisoned in its own cocoon). The body that the wise shaikh has attained is an entirely different thing. Do not call it a body. Can a lover of God expect any reward for his love? Can the trustworthy Jibra’iil be imagined to commit theft? Lover of the blue-black-pale Laila considered the kingdom of the entire world as worthless as a leaf. Mud and gold were of the same worthlessness for him. What about Gold? Even his life was of no worth for him.

sections.heading: Example of Majnu’s Love for Laila
paras: Lions, wolves and beasts were fully informed of him and had gathered around him taking him to be one of them and harmless to them. They thought that he is rid of animal qualities. His flesh and fat have become poisonous which destroy bestial instincts, because of which poison of the beasts becomes the spiller of the sugar of wisdom. Because goodness of the good is opposite to the badness of the bad, as a result of which lovers lose all their wisdom and sense and become like beasts. Their sugar is like the sugar spilled on the bread of bride which is of no use for her. Therefore, wild beasts do not eat the flesh of lovers. Love does not remain invisible to anyone. It is glaring and self-exposing. All good and bad people find it out. If by chance, a beast eats the flesh of a lover, he will die as it is poisonous for it.

sections.heading: Difference Between Worship and Love
paras: Everything other than love is the food of love. Love consumes everything of the world. For the beak of love, both this and that world together are just of a grain’s worth. You will never see a grain eating the bird or the stable eating the horse. Such a strange thing is the case of lovers. They are eaten away by grain and grass. Go on worshipping so that there may be a possibility of its ending in love, because worship is an act, that can be done at will, but not love. Worship maintains a distance between a worshipper and the worshipped, but there is no such distance in love. Love does not keep any distance. It does not desire to be away from the beloved. A worshipper expects a reward and honor, but the entire commitment of the lover is constant looking at the beloved. Love cannot be explained in words of speech nor understood by hearing. It is an ocean the depth of which cannot be known. Drops of this ocean cannot be counted. It is an ocean, before which all the seven oceans upon earth are small rivulets
There is no end to this discussion. Let us go to the narrative of that shaikh of the time.

chapters.title: Meaning of : I Created Heavens for You: Laow Laaka Lamaa Khalqtul Aflaak

paras: The shaikh used to call out in every sheet: “Love has no concern for anything and makes you do whatever it wants. Be careful about it! Love boils the water of oceans just like boiling in a cauldron. It grinds a mountain into sand. It tears the sky with a hundred tearings. It makes the earth shiver in an uncontrolled way. Such a sincere love was a companion of H. Muhammad, that God told him: But for you I would not have created the heavens.” This great statement was made for him as his love for God was extreme and unique. Other prophets also had love for God. But his love was specifically referred to by God. It was in response to his great love that the heavens were brought into existence. “I have made the heavens high aloft in order to make you realize the height of love as nothing is higher than heavens. Further, there are other benefits from the heavens. These benefits are like the eggs which further give the benefits of chicks.

sections.heading: Feelings Compared with Physical Objects
paras: “I have made the mud lowly to make the lovers know of their low state. At the same time, I have granted freshness and greenery to love that you may know that the lowly faqirs change into highly beneficial persons for others like the lowly mud. They are like hard, well settled mountains, that speak of the firmness of love in the hearts of the lovers”. What all stated here is to cite the meaning of love as only physical shapes, are nearer to your understanding capacity. This is like calling anger as a thorn. Anger is not factually a thorn, but it is as effective as a thorn is. So also, a hard-hearted man is called as of stony heart though he has no stoney heart. It is only an example. Inspite of this, if you cannot understand the reality, you may blame the example and the contents in it, and do not reject the purpose of the contents.

chapters.title: The Shaikh’s Going to the House of a Rich Man Four Times for Begging with His Bag upon Hidden Instructions, and the Rich Man’s Rebuke Over This Shamelessness and the Shaikh’s Offering Excuses

paras: One day like a beggar, the shaikh went to the mansion of a rich man for begging for four times with his bag in his hand calling: “give something for God. The Creator of life is asking for bread.” This was a reversed demand, which puts into confusion even perfect wisdom. God does not need any food. The shaikh was quite free of the need. The whole world is in need (but not God). Yet there was command to seek food from the needy people for God.

When the rich man saw this, he said: “O shameless fellow, hear me! I shall tell you something. Do not consider me as miserly. O mean fellow, why do you run about so much, and for how long for doubling food. What is this shamelessness, this shameful face, and what is this job that you come four times in a day? Old man, who is held up as your prisoner in this house? I have not seen any beggar like you. You have spoiled the honor of beggars and disgraced them. What kind of ugly beggary like that of Abbas Dabas is this? It is as though you have out beaten Abbas Dabas and made him your slave. May not anyone be a rejector of his own self respect in any religion like you!”

sections.heading: Knowledge of Astronomy, Philosophy Etc., Are Mental
paras: The shaikh said”: O rich man, keep quiet. I am only a slave to a command. You are not aware of the fire burning within me. Do not get so excited! Were I to see any greed for bread in me, I would have torne my belly. For seven years with the burning fire of love, to meet the demand of my body I have eaten shoots of the grapevine in the forest. I have eaten even dry and fresh leaves, as a result of which the color of my body has turned green. Do not look at those in love with a passing glance, so long as you are confined behind the curtains of manhood. Wise people having hair-spitting-capacities have found out the study of astronomy and gone deep into the structure and contents of heavens. Subjects of study like sorcery, magic and philosophy could not be known to them to their full satisfaction. Yet they have come to know to the best of their abilities and gone much ahead of their colleagues. Those are the products of mind.

“But love, inspite of being as bright as the sun remained hidden from them. It remained totally away from them. How such a bright thing is unseen by those eyes that saw the stars even during the light of the day. Leave off this matter at its own place. It is beyond understanding, but hear this much from me. Look at the lovers with the eyes of love. I cannot explain to you everything in detail about my love. There is very little time left. My life is in precarious situation just like the astronomers gazing at the sky in observatories. Such being the situation, I cannot explain to you about my reasonings. Apply your own mind and try to know, and do not depend upon spoken words. All things cannot be explained. Do not inure the breasts of those lovers. I tell you: you have developed unwanted suspicions in your luxurious life. Do not give the rope that has tied you up like the tying of the cattle. Hold on to it, but do not give up your own care. It is required that taking care must be of different levels at different situations. It is duteous to verify, if an infidel and sinner gives false Informations. If is given by noble people; it is not so serious. But doing so when told by prophets and God is prohibited. Therefore, be moderate in taking pare!

chapters.title: The Rich Man’s Crying upon the Shaikh’s Sincerity and Advice After His Rebuke, and Offering a Treasure to the Shaikh; and His Refusal to Take, Telling That He Would Not Take and Spend It Without Instructions from Hidden Source

paras: The shaikh said this with cries and sighs with torrents of tears flowing down from his eyes. His sincerity hit upon the heart of the rich man and caused great impression, as it happens that love cooks strange dishes every moment. Sincerity of love puts its impact upon lifeless matter and there is no reason that it would not impact upon the heart of a wise man. H. Musa’s love and sincerity impacted upon his staff and the mount (Senai) and even upon the frightfull ocean. Sincerity of Prophet Muhammad hit upon the beauty of moon and also stopped the sun from its movement.

Looking at the shaikh crying the rich man also started crying. The beggar and the rich became alike in crying. After sometime, the rich man said: “Get up, O fortunate one! You may take anything that you want from my treasure, even though you are entitled for a hundred times more than this. This is your house, and you may choose anything here as you desire, even though both the worlds are but a little for you.”

The shaikh said: “There is no permission from God that I should take what I want. I cannot do this undesirable act, on my own. I cannot interfere in the God’s command even in a friendly way.” This was a game that the shaikh played as a result of which he was the winner in this chess game. This denial was for the reason that there was no sincerity in the offer. Though the donor was truthful and sincere, without any show and fear, yet all sincerities did not come under the standards of the shaikh as they were not for God’s sake but under the impression cast by the shaikh. Therefore, he said: “This only is the order from God to me to go as a beggar and beg for bread. That is why, I entreated to you like beggars. Men like me have no concern for wealth.”

chapters.title: A Different World of Different Nature
chapters.subtitle: Directions to the shaikh from the hidden world: for two years you have collected and distributed. From now onwards, you may only give and not collect. Put your hand under the mat, as We have made it like the bag of H. Abu Huraira for you, so that you may collect whatever you want there, so that the people of the world may know that there is another world, apart from this world, in which, if you take mud, it becomes gold. A dead man becomes alive in it. Misfortunes coming within it become fortunes. Infidelity becomes faith, poison becomes antidote. This world is neither within this world nor beyond. Neither it is above nor below. It is neither mixed up with it, nor separate from it. It is not comparable to anything nor explainable in any manner without why and how. Thousands of impacts and models come out of it every moment: Craft of the hand is in the shape of what hand makes; hints of the eyes are in the shape of what the eyes intend to impact upon, clear speech of the tongue is the product of the tongue. These are not within them nor out of them. These are neither mixed up with them nor independent of them. (These are one and part and parcel of each other). Just hints are enough for the wise

paras: The shaikh was engaged in this job for two years, after which, he got a command from God: You may only give now but do not beg from anyone else. We give you this authority from the hidden world. You may put your hand under your mat and take from one to a thousand for anyone seeking from you. There is an uncountable treasure of grace underneath it. Dust will become gold in your hand. Give to everyone who asks you and do not worry about any deficiency. Consider the grants of God as more upon more. There is no loss or deficiency in Our grant. There is no cause of anxiety and fear. Keeping of your hand under the mat is for the purpose of protection from vicious eyesight. You may fold your palm as a fist under the mat and keep and spread it on the hand of a back-broken seeker. Therefore, you may give an everlasting reward. You may give a precious pearl to any seeker of it. Go forward and become like “the hand of God over other hands”: Yadullaahi fawqa aidiihim (Fath: 48: 10); and like God’s hand distribute the provisions from God, free of cost. Free the indebted persons of the debts and make the land upon the earth green just as rain does.”

The shaikh was engaged in this work only for one year of giving gold from the bag of the Lord of religion. Black mud used to turn into gold in his hand and Hatim Taa’ii, the exemplified one for generosity used to stand in the line of beggars standing before him.

chapters.title: Self-Realization of Needs
chapters.subtitle: The Shaikh’s realization of the debts of the seeker and about his creditors, without his telling as a mark of the statement: “Go before my creatures with My attributes, because one who sees you sees Me”

paras: Even without a seeker’s speaking of his need, he used to know of it and give him accordingly. Before his bright consciousness, the feelings of everyone’s heart were clear, whether he was a beggar or debtor, or one caught in other difficulties. He used to give as much as any back-broken with difficulties needed; neither less nor more. People asked him as to how he finds out the need with which any person came to him.

sections.heading: How to Know the Needs of Others
paras: He would say: “The house of my heart is empty. One who is not in need is like paradise. None occupies it other than the love of God. None resides there other than the thought of meeting God. I have cleansed my heart of all good and bad thoughts. It is full only with the love of that Unique One. Whatever I see in it is not mine, but the reflection of the seeker of help from me. If a date palm or its leaf is visible in water, it is nothing but the reflection of the tree lying outside. Whatever shape is seen at the bottom of clean water is nothing but the reflection of that which is out of it. But until the water in the pond of heart becomes clean enough, cleaning up of the streams of the body is needed, so that grasses and pollutants may not come about. Upon this, the heart becomes a trustee of others to reflect their faces.

But you are a destitute of love. You do not have anything other than slush in your heart. You are like an enemy of heart. O enemy of the heart, clean it of slush with clean water. You are engaged in sleeping and eating every time; and you pour more slush into it.

chapters.title: Basis of Realization of People’s Thoughts

paras: When water of the heart gets cleansed of pollutions, reflections of the faces outside it will be visible. Therefore, clean your inside in order to know of the inner feelings of all seekers. When your inside is unclean, devils, apes, and wild beast, will inhabit it. O the one like a donkey! You are engaged in quarrels because of your donkishess. How can you feel the fragrance of the souls like H. Isa. You continue to be a donkey even when you are owned by him. How can you know of the place from where thoughts originate in you when they come about? Body becomes physically non-tangible when you resort to pious life in order to cleanse it of vicious thoughts from it. Eliminate the crooked thoughts from your inside, so that they may not make you one remaining in the outer, apparent world, without any taste of the inner spiritual world:

chapters.title: Victory of the Fox’s Treacheries upon the Protective Measures of the Donkey

paras: The donkey put many efforts and presented arguments in defense, but the disease of dog’s hunger (which never quenches how much ever one eats) became the donkey’s hunger. Greed dominated over its patience. It has happened many a times, that throats are cutoff in the love of bread. It is reported form that Prophet with the knowledge of truths: Poverty is quite nearer to become infidelity: Kaidal faqru an yakuuna kufran

The donkey had become a prisoner of hunger. It said to itself: “If what the fox says is treachery to kill me, better hold on to death. I shall at least get rid of the continuing torture of hunger. If this life is one of hunger only, it is better that I die.”

The donkey earlier had repented and determined not to fall into the trap of the fox, but at last yielded to its donkishness and committed mistake. Greed makes one blind, foolish and ignorant and makes death appear as soft. Death appears easy for men like donkeys as they have not seen the charm and pleasure of the everlasting life. One who does not possess an everlasting life is unfortunate. His courage to face death is due to his foolishness. Do not go after death to free yourself of troubles, but try to make your life deathless and everlasting, so that the day of your death may become a carrier for the next life.

The donkey had no confidence on the Provider of food, who was showing His generosity all through, who had not kept him without food till then, though now and then, he imposed the trouble of hunger upon him.

chapters.title: To Explain the Excellence of Hunger and Diet

paras: Had there been no hunger, there would have been hundreds of sicknesses starting with dysentery (or cholera). The pain of hunger is much better than these sicknesses from the point of view of cleanliness, lightness and activeness. Pain of hunger is more cleansing and it has in particular, hundreds of profits and gains. It is a king of all medicines. Have love for hunger and keep it up, and do not consider it as mean and lowly.

All tasteless things become tasty in hunger, and all tasty things become tasteless without hunger. A person was eating a bread of corn with relish. Someone asked him: “What makes you relish it so much.” He said: “When hunger doubles up with patience, a bread of corn becomes tasty like a sweet dish. I feel like eating the entire sweet dish. I delay in eating and wait patiently for hunger to increase and convert the dry cornbread into a sweet dish. Hunger is not something that comes into the grip of everyone, as there is more food available in the grassland than needed. Hunger is a gift given to the special servants of God, so that it may make them strong and lion-like. With this, they become the spiritual lions.

Every mean beggar is not provided with hunger. As grass is not deficient, it is kept before him to eat, as it is available in plenty, saying: “You may eat this as you are worthy only of this. You are not a bird of the ocean of gnosis of God. You are a bird to catch only food. You do not have any other thought in you other than of food. Your heart has a desire of nothing other than bread. What did you get after so many years of life? Hunger for death is better than the life of your type.

sections.heading: Narrative of a Disciple Whose Inner Thoughts of Greed Were Found Out by His Master, and His Oral Advice on the Matter of Strength of Trust in God and Grant to Him of the Trust in God
paras: A shaikh with his disciple went without fear toward a city, where there was scarcity of food. The disciple had the fear of famine and hunger, which out of his ignorance was increasing moment by moment. The master became aware of the condition of his heart and told him: “How long do you keep yourself in anxiety in the thoughts of bread. You are roasting yourself for bread with your eyes shut from patience and trust in God. You are not one among those selected honorables of God who would not be kept deprived of better food like apricots and currants, which are superior to routine food. Hunger is a special food of God for His special servants. Such a food is not in the control of a foolish beggar like you. Take care! You are not among those who remain without that bread from their kitchen.

sections.heading: Food Loves You as You Love Food
paras: “There are cups upon cups and breads upon breads for all the time for the gluttonous fellow. Even upon his death, his bread goes in front of his coffin for the reason that he has killed himself out of deprivation. [Bread is carried along with a coffin toward the graveyard to feed the poor]. You have left the world, but your bread is kept for you. Get up and catch it, as you are the one who killed himself for the sake of bread.

“Rest assured! Have trust in God! Do not tremble your hands and feet. Your food has greater love for you than you have for it. It is in love with you and is calling upon you to patiently wait. Do not be silly as it is well aware of your impatience. Had you been patient, your food would have come to you, on its own, and dumped itself upon you just as lovers keep themselves entirely for the beloveds. Why do you have this fever and shivering out of the fear of hunger? You can as well, survive with a bellyfull of trust upon God.”

chapters.title: Think of Past as Regards Food

sections.heading: Narrative of a Bull Which Was Alone on a Large Island. God Used to Fill That Island with Grass and Fragrant Plants (Raihau) as Food, for It. from Morning to Night, the Bull Used to Feed upon It and Became Fat Like a Rock. During the Night, It Would Not Sleep Out of the Fear of the Food for the Next Day as It Had Eaten Everything on That Day. This Fear Used to Make It Thin Like a Toothpick. but upon Getting Up in the Morning It Would Find the Forest More Full and Thicker with Greenery. It Would Eat Out of It and Become Fat Again and During the Night Its Anxiety Once Again Would Catch It Up and Would Become Thin. Such Things Occurred for Years Together. It Sees This Daily and Still Does Not Trust God
paras: There is an island in the world full of greenery; and in it there is a single bull grazing with full pleasure. It grazes upon the whole forest from morning till night, so much, that it grows fat, large and exceptional. During the night it worries as to what to graze upon the next day resulting in it becoming thin like hair out of this worry. But it gets up in the morning, finds the forest fresh and green, with grass as high as to reach the waist, and fresh with ears of grains. The bull enters into the grassland with its never quenching hunger and eats it all till the night. Again, it becomes fat, well grown and heavy, its entire body becoming full of fat and strength. Again, at night it develops fever with fright and becomes weak out of the fear of the empty grassland on the next day, worrying as to what it should eat. This has been its situation for years together.

It never thinks for many years, I have been grazing in this greenland and on no day, there has been any deficiency of food. Why should I feel worried, when such has always been the case every night, it becomes thin and weak thinking that its stock of food has exhausted?

Man’s self is like that bull and this world is like that island; and the self becomes weak out of the fear of loss of food thinking as to: “what I should eat in future. From where I have to get yesterday’s food for tomorrow”. For years you have been eating, but there has not been any deficiency. Do not take into account the future to understand but consider the past about the provision of food. Think of the tasty, fatty food you ate earlier and keep yourself happy and do not think of future and get involved in worries.
Leave the affairs of that bull at this level and say about those of the donkey and the lion.

chapters.title: Light from Different Sources Is One Pg 164
chapters.subtitle: The Lion’s preying upon the donkey and getting thirsty due to the hard work and going toward the pond to drink water. And before its return the fox ate out the liver, heart and kidneys of the donkey because of these being tastier. The lion searched for the liver and heart and did not find it asked the fox as to where the liver, heart and kidneys were. The fox said: Had it possessed the heart and liver, how it would have come to you again after facing the ordeal of the earlier occasion? As stated in the Quran in this regard as the rejectors would say: Had we but listened or used our intelligence we would not be among the companions of the blazing fire: Laow kunnaa nasma ‘u aw na ‘qilu, maakunnaa fii ashaabis sa ‘iiri: (Mulk: 67: 10)

paras: The fox brought the donkey before the lion and the brave lion tore it into pieces. This king of the beasts got tired and thirsty with this hard work and went toward a pond to drink water. The fox took this as a good opportunity and ate this liver and heart of the donkey. When the lion returned from the pond toward the dish, he searched for the liver and heart of the donkey but did not find them. He asked her “where is the liver? What happened to the heart? All animals certainly have these two parts.” The fox said: “it this donkey had a heart or liver, it would not have come here for the second time. It had seen that horrible situation on the first occasion as a result of which, it fell down from the hill, got terribly frightened and ran away in panic. If it had the heart or the liver, it would not have come for the second time to you.”

sections.heading: Light Is One Though from Many Sources
paras: When the heart does not perform its act, it is not heart at all. When there is no soul in the body, it is nothing but mud. Glass that does not possess the soul of light may not be called as chandelier. It is just a bottle for keeping urine. Light of the lamp is a grant of the Lord of Majesty and grandeur, Holders of oil made of glass and clay for the lamps are the makings of man. They are in large numbers and designs, but the light from all of them is the same mingled up and one. This cannot be differentiated as from this lamp or that. Light from six chandeliers may be mixed up. There are no differences and numbers in their light. Light from all of them is the same and one.

sections.heading: Prophets Are Not Different
paras: Jews looked at the bodies of the prophets like the containers of oil and considered them to be different, but the faithful looked at their light, recognized their soul and reality and considered all to be the same and one. That is what is said about them in the Quran: they say: we make no distinction between one another: La nufarriqu baina ahadin min rusulihi (Baqara: 2: 285). When one’s eyes fall on the soul, one sees both H. Ibrahim and H. Muhammad as the same. When the light of the soul falls on the container, (body) H. Shaith (s) and H. Nooh are considered to be different. A stream is called as a stream when it contains water. Similarly, he is a man who has soul within him. Such soul-less men are not men but only lifeless idols and models of men, devoted only to bread and passions who live for them and sacrifice themselves for them.

chapters.title: God Controls Everything
chapters.subtitle: Narrative of a monk who carried a lamp during daytime and roamed about in bazar because of his inner hidden qualities

paras: A monk, full of the love of God, and its hot impacts roamed about in the bazaar with a lamp in his hand during daytime. An astonished person asked him: “O so and so! What are you searching for near every shop? What is this funny behavior that you are roaming about with a lamp during daytime?” the monk said: “I am searching for a man everywhere, who is living with a different kind of breath and life. I am searching for a man here and there, and to my surprise, I do not find any.” The enquiring person said: “This bazaar is full of men. O free and wise man, do you not see that they are men?”

The monk said: “I want to see a man walking straight on a double road of wrath and greed. Where is a man as a man, at the time of anger and lust I am running in search of one such in streets after streets? Where are men in these two situations. If I find one, I would like to the sacrifice my life for him.”

sections.heading: Don’t See the Obvious but Foresee Behind
paras: The other man said: “You are searching for a thing that is very rare in the world. But you are certainly unaware of the commands of fate made by God. You are looking at the branches of the tree and not at the root. We men are all branches of the tree, but commands of the fate are the roots and bases. Fate misguides the sky that is in constant circular motion. It makes fools of hundreds of writers of the fate of the sky like planet Mercury, considered as the writer of the heavens. It narrows down the world of planning. It coverts iron and hard rocks into water (liquid). You consider that the way can be traversed step by step and your progress is in various steps taken by you. You have not understood matters in a matured, firm manner. You are mistaken. Your proceedings are not by you, but you have been put across them by fate. When you see the milestone in grinding motion, you should not attribute it to the wheel. So also look at water in motion. And in the stream, you see dust moving about on the air. You should look at the air also in between the dust particles, that is making them move. You see the water of your wisdom and thoughts boiling in the cauldron of your mind. Be careful to see with your inner sense the fire that is boiling your waters.

H. Ayub (Jacob) was honorably told by God that He ahs given patience out only to you but to every hair of your body. But be careful not to be proud of your patience but look at the One who has given you the patience. (H. Ayub was a prophet who underwent many mental and physical agonies, but never lamented upon them. With extreme patience, he bore all troubles but never complained or cried at these. Ayub’s patience is taken as the finest model of patience]. You are looking at the well sweep that is dragging out water in buckets from the depth of well and pouring outside. Bring out your head and look at the person who is operating the well sweep. You claim that you are seeing things, but none of the signs of the seers are in you. [you are only seeing but not realizing about what you see].

sections.heading: Causes of Causes and Final Cause
paras: When you see the surf on the shore it is just a little glance. You are in need of a deeper and well spread-out sight to go beyond it and look at the vast ocean that has brought out the surf. From there you have to look at the reality of the ocean and then proceed to look at the One who created the ocean and its actions. Surf on the shore is only a direction for you go beyond and farther and farther. One who remains satisfied by looking at surf remains stuck at that, and one who looks at the ocean, proceeds a little beyond and gets confused, yet concludes that he has known the cause of surf formation and feels proud of it. One who goes still deeper realizes that there are causes for causes and the final cause of all causes is God. He is the real seer of everything which makes his heart so large as to conclude that everything is from God alone.

sections.heading: Cursory and in-Depth Look
paras: One who looks at the seashore sees only bubbles which are spontaneous and surf as the inevitable consequence. He gets puzzled in spontaneity and consequentiality. When he goes beyond the shore and looks at the various aspects and activities of the ocean, finds that what all he has found out is very little and there are many many things yet to be found out, and realizes his ignorance, incapacity and deficiency. This realization cleans up his heart and he became clean-hearted. He even realizes that his seeing, searching and finding are also not under his control, or his acts are but under the control of the One who has created everything and every action. The seer of the surf gets entangled in worldly affairs of profits and gains through knowledge and materials and becomes their slave, while the other having gone beyond, forgets all these and prepares to sacrifice himself for the great creator. The seer of surf is intoxicated by its wonderful qualities and the one who sees the oceans dives deeper and sinks into it, the seer of surf talks, and the seer of the ocean loses his consciousness and individuality and totally gets lost in God, the creator of everything and every act including himself and his own self and gets the fullest satisfaction and contentment. He forgets everything else.

chapters.title: Tussle Between God and Satan
chapters.subtitle: A Muslim’s offer of Islam to a Zoroastrian and his reply there to

paras: A person told a Zoroastrian to become a muslim and be careful to join the faithfuls. He said: “If God wishes so I shall become faithful, and if He becomes more benevolent towards me, I shall become more certain of faith.” That person said: “God is very much desirous of your faith in Him so as to relieve your soul from the hand of the hell. But your accursed self and the vicious Satan drag you toward infidelity and the temple.” The Zoroastrian said: “O just and discriminating fellow, as you say, they are dominant upon me, I shall follow the one who is stronger. I shall become a friend of one who is dominant. I shall go toward the one who has greater attractive power. If God desires a stronger inclination from me toward Himself, what is the good of that desire which cannot be fulfilled? You may see here that the desire of my self and of the Satan are more dominant than God’s desire. His benevolence toward me has turned into His wrath and shattered to pieces. He has no dominance upon me and them; rather they are more dominant than God.

sections.heading: Victor and Vanquished
paras: “You built. a mansion and guesthouse and made beautiful decorations in them, desiring that these should be places of worship of God, but someone came and converted these into a temple of idols. Then what happened to your desire of building a place of worship of God? You weaved thread out of raw cotton to make a good upper garment to wear, but your enemy made it into trousers. What power has the fabric to do anything of its own? It is under the control of the dominant. There is no mistake on the part of the fabric. It is under the control of others and not a controller. When someone conquers another, he destroys his property and grows thorns in it. The owner of the house becomes dishonored, and all things proceed against his wish. I shall also become dishonored with all my freshness and smartness, when I become a companion of the weak. Thus, when the wish of the self is dominant upon man, it becomes funny to say what God’s wishes come about.

sections.heading: Better to Obey the Dominant
paras: Whether I am an infidel or a shameful Zoroastrian, I would not think that God’s wish should not come about and satan should be dominant. And that anybody, against God’s wish, should fall into the disgrace of defeat at the hands of Satan and be controlled by him. And dominate upon his possessions in such a way that God the creator of every thing should be helpless before him. I would not desire that God should think of eliminating him but should not succeed in his wish, and Satan’s wrath should go on increasing. Yet, is better that one should, in such a circumstance, become obedient to Satan, when he is dominant everywhere. Because in such a case, if I become obedient to God instead of Satan, satan will become inimical to me. Can God, the benevolent in every respect be of any help of me? I such circumstance whatever that Satan wishes, comes about, and none can be of any help to me.”

chapters.title: Devil Is a Dog at God’s Door
chapters.subtitle: Illustration of the Position of Satan at the door of Rahmaan

paras: But the truth is: whatever God desired, came about, in both the worlds within space and beyond space. Nobody can do anything within his dominion other than with His command even to the extent of the tip of a hair. Dominion of this world and the next world entirely belongs to Him and within His command and that lowly Satan is just like a dog at His door. The dog of the Turkoman remains at the door of his house keeping its head and face upon it. His children pull its tail and it remains lowly at their hands. But when a stranger comes near the door, it pounces upon him like a male lion, it is through the power of Turkoman that the dog becomes dominant. Like the companions of the Prophets were strong against the unbelievers: Ashiddaii ‘alal kuffari (Fath: 48: 29). That is, flowers for the friend and thorns for the enemy. For the sake of cheap soup that the Turkoman gives, it becomes so faithful and guarding. Thus, the doggish Satan, who is created by God, and fed with varieties of food creates hundreds of mischievous thoughts and designs. He takes the honor of the people as his food in order to dishonor both the good and bad people. Honor of the people is like thin soup for him through which he gains strength.

sections.heading: Satan as Faithful Dog of God
paras: When the Turkoman’s dog is so faithful, how can this God’s dog at the door of His tent remain without obedience to Him. Groups of faithful’s and disobedient have spread their limbs flat at His door. Every particle sits in obedience at the opening of His cave waiting for his commands to perform its acts. He has placed this devilish dog at His door to test the visitors of their sincerity; and protect His door by pouncing upon and prevent the unfaithful. The teaching of “I seek God’s help”: A ‘uzubillahi: is for the purpose of self-protection when this dog with its strength pounces fast upon you. It is to call the Master of Safety of the seekers for protection to attend to the court of the Master. This calling is for the purpose of threatening this ferocious Turkoman dog, so that it may open the door, and the seeker may enter into the tent to receive gifts and honors from His generosity.

sections.heading: Those Frightened by Doggish Satan
paras: But when the Turkoman himself is afraid of his own dog, the calling of “I seek God’s help” and lamentations are of no use. So also, it is of no use when the Turk himself seeks protection of God saying: “I am afraid of the dog in my residence itself, which is dominated by the dog. And further says to his guest: “neither I can get out of the tent, nor you can enter, out of the fear of dog.” Fie upon him; and may dust be upon that Turk and his guest as a single dog has caught both of them by their neck.

But it is impossible that the Turk would be so frightened. He will give such a ferocious call, before which, after all a dog is nothing, even a lion would start vomiting blood. O the one calling oneself as a lion of God, you have been frightened of the dog for years together. This dog cannot catch a prey for you when you openly become a prey of the dog.

chapters.title: Predestination and Free Will (Jabr and Qadr)
chapters.subtitle: Reply of the Muslim believing in free will, to the infidel behaving in predestination, arguing that the right path is that on which the prophets passed, on the right side of which is the forest of predestination by looking at which its believer does not look at his authority and power and interprets to reject positive and negative commands of God. This interpretation results in the rejection of paradise and hell; O paradise being the reward of the obedient and hell being the place of punishment for disobedience. I do not want to say more on this, as hints are enough for the wise to understand. On the other right side of the path of the prophets is the forest of free will in which the authority of God is considered as lower than the authority of creatures and from this arise the mischief’s and vices, which the predestination Zoroastrian referred to.

paras: The faithful told the Zoroastrian: “O believer is predestination; you may now hear me. I now answer you all that you have said. As a chess player, you have played your game on the chessboard, and you may look at the long standing and large enough game of your opponent. You have read out the book of your objections and now you may read the explanations of the person on the right path! You have explained clearly the points of the predestinarians. Now, you may hear from me, the secrets behind this.

sections.heading: Free Will Goes with Life and Power
paras: “Definitely, we have freewill also. You cannot deny of what you see with your eyes. You may look at the free will that you have and do not be a one-sided predestinarian. You have left the right path. Come over to ti and do not go on the wrong path. Nobody tells a stone to come before him. No one tells a lump of mud to be faithful. No one tells a man to fly or a blind man to come before him and look at his face. God has said: No blame is there upon the blind. The provider of comforts does not make difficulties upon anyone. No one tells a stone that it came late or a stick as to why it struck him. Nobody puts questions to anything that is helpless and powerless and does not strike at the one who has not authority.

sections.heading: Satan and Self Under Man’s Command
paras: Positive commands, negative commands, anger, honor and punishments are not meant for anyone other than the one with authority. There is free will in causing cruelties and difficulties. One does this only with one’s intention and ability. When I speak of Satan and self, I mean only this: they both exist in you and are under your control. They are your intentions, and you use them as per your choice. This is like the women injuring their own fingers upon looking at the beauty of H. Yusuf. They had the authority on their fingers and the urge in their self. When they looked at his face, their authority and urge flew out of the control of their self.

sections.heading: Need Creates Action
paras: A sleeping dog has lost its control over itself. When it feels hungry and looks at the bone, it starts wagging its tail. When the horse looks at the grain, it starts neighing. When the cat sees meat it starts meowing. This is the situation of man’s authority. So long as there is no demand, his authority is in rest; and upon a demand, it wakes up. And the demand instantly becomes active upon finding a means to meet the demand. Looking at these things becomes the cause of actions, just like the blowing of air on fire results in the flashing out of sparks. In this manner seeing instigates your authority and acts like an agent between you and your desired object and brings the message of the beloved wish to her lover remain. As the desired object is placed before the needy, the sleeping authority wakes up and then starts a craze in your heart. Then the angel presents the force of goodness against the vicious presentations of Satan; and there results a great battle in your heart. At this, the authority of goodness starts moving. Before these two opposing presentations were made, both these authorities of commission of good and bad were in sleep; and both wake up after this. Both the devil and angel became the cause of presentations in order to put your muscles of authority in motion.

sections.heading: Conflict Between Inspirations and Insinuations
paras: Because of their noble inspirations from angels and vicious insinuations of the devil, your authority towards good and bad becomes ten times stronger. It is for this reason that at the conclusion of salat, it is required to salute the angels as because of their supplication and inspiration, the free will of non-performance of salat had come to an end. So also, after committing a sin, you curse the devil as it was, he who had made you crooked at that time. These two opposing presenters are hidden behind the curtain of hidden (non-material) world. when the hidden curtains are removed (on the doomsday) you will clearly see the facts of these two go-betweens. You will clearly recognize their voices and say that it was they who were playing their respective roles.

sections.heading: Thoughts Are Devilish or Angelic from Behind
paras: The devil will tell you: “You were the prisoner of your body and instinct. I have only presented my version to you. I had not compelled you to do what you did.” And the angel would say: “I had clearly told you that this pleasure will later result in sorrows. Had I not told on that day that the way toward paradise is on the other side? I had also told you that we angels were the loves of your soul and desirous of strengthening it. We are those who were sincere to and prostrators of your father, H. Adam. Even now, I am at your service and for this purpose, I call you toward me to offer my services. That knotty fellow (Satan) was an enemy of your father who had refused to obey the command of God to prostrate him. But you looked at what he places before you and ignored our presentation. And failed to recognize the rights of our services. At this moment both of us are before you. You may see both of us with your eyes, and also identify us through our voice and style of talking. You heard the cries of your friend at midnight, but failed to see him, but during the daytime, when you hear his voice, you recognize him through his voice. Two new persons bring some news to you in the darkness of night, and you do not see them; but in the daytime when you hear their voice you clearly identify them with their voice. You heard the sound of the lion and of the dog during night, and not seen them in the darkness, but during the daytime, you recognize them with their sounds. The sum and substance is that the presenters of thoughts are the devil and angel, but butting them into action is purely by your free will.

There is hidden free will in us, which goes into action when it sees two objectives. Teachers punish their pupils, but not black stones, as they know that the pupil has free will but not the stone. You never tell a stone to come tomorrow warning that you will punish it if it does not come. A wise person never gets angry with a stone or lump of mud.

sections.heading: Conflict Between Logic and Observation
paras: Wisdom considers predestination as more disgraceful than free will, as a believer of predestination is a indirect rejector of his own senses, because when everything is predestined, what role do the fine senses have for him?
